retrieved_entities.label: Armed forces occupations
retrieved_entities.description:
Armed forces occupations include all jobs held by members of the armed forces. Members of the armed forces are those personnel who are currently serving in the armed forces, including auxiliary services, whether on a voluntary or compulsory basis, and who are not free to accept civilian employment and are subject to military discipline. Included are regular members of the army, navy, air force and other military services, as well as conscripts enrolled for military training or other service for a specified period.
Occupations in this major group are classified into the following sub-major groups:
01 Commissioned Armed Forces Officers
02 Non-commissioned Armed Forces Officers
03 Armed Forces Occupations, Other Ranks
Excluded from this group are: - jobs held by persons in civilian employment of government establishments concerned with defence issues; - police (other than military police); - customs inspectors and members of border or other armed civilian services.
Notes
Many jobs performed by members of the armed forces are similar, in terms of the nature of the work performed, to civilian occupations such as medical doctors, radio operators, cooks, secretaries and heavy truck drivers. Conceptually, it may be appropriate, therefore, to classify such jobs in the armed forces with similar civilian jobs. This approach is adopted in several national occupation classifications. Typically such classifications also identify a number of military-specific occupational groups. In many countries, however, it is not possible to produce information about the nature of the work performed by members of the armed forces. In adapting ISCO-08 for national purposes countries may wish, therefore, to consider what approach best suits their circumstances and user needs. For purposes of international comparability, however, where data pertaining to members of the armed forces are reported and classified by occupation, they should be included, where possible, in ISCO-08 Major Group 0: Armed Forces Occupations.

The occupation **Horticulture production team leader** (ID: 8e24c53a-9dc6-46d1-986b-48a93f20df2a) requires a wide range of skills and knowledge, which are categorized below:

### Skills/Competences
*   **Planning and Management:** Develop agricultural production plans, manage agricultural staff, manage production enterprise, assign duties to agriculture workers, recruit personnel, and optimise production.
*   **Technical and Operational:** Drive agricultural machines, operate horticulture equipment, use gardening equipment, maintain gardening equipment, maintain technical equipment, maintain storage facilities, coordinate greenhouse environment, and maintain the greenhouse.
*   **Crop and Plant Care:** Grow plants, nurse plants, propagate plants, harvest crop, prune hedges and trees, prune plants, execute fertilisation, prepare planting area, apply sustainable tillage techniques, and execute disease and pest control activities.
*   **Administrative and Financial:** Keep task records, carry out work related calculations in agriculture, negotiate sales contracts, manage contracts, and make independent operating decisions.
*   **Quality and Safety:** Perform on-farm product processing, ensure quality control in packaging, store crops, store products, supervise hygiene procedures in agricultural settings, and food plant design.
*   **Customer and Sales:** Promote farm products, sell flowers, pick orders of agricultural products, present the farm facilities, provide agri-touristic services, manage agritourism activities, create flower arrangements, prepare flower arrangements, place orders for flower products, and advise customers on types of flowers.
*   **Advisory:** Create soil and plant improvement programmes, advise on plant fertilizer, ensure soil fertility, and implement landscaping projects.

### Knowledge
*   **Scientific and Agronomic:** Agronomy, agroecology, ecology, soil structure, crop production principles, horticulture principles, fertilisation principles, plant propagation, plant species, plant harvest methods, pruning techniques, and pruning types.
*   **Pest and Disease Management:** Pest control in plants and plant disease control.
*   **Infrastructure and Technology:** E-agriculture, greenhouse types, types of storage facilities, quality criteria for storage facilities, aeroponics, and hydroponics.
*   **Business and Management:** Agricultural business management, budgetary principles, project management principles, and leadership principles.
*   **Regulatory and Safety:** Food safety principles, food legislation, environmental legislation in agriculture and forestry, and health and safety regulations.
*   **Tourism:** Agritourism.

cypher_result.j.title: Summer job 2025;     Tractor driver for Widegrens Gård on Gotland
cypher_result.j.description: About usWidegrens Gård on Gotland specializes in the organic cultivation of potatoes, carrots and onions with our own packing plant where we wash, sort and pack the products. In addition to this, there is also the cultivation of grain and rapeseed. Our carrot packing house is in Atlingbo and our potato and onion packing house is in Follingbo. The cultivation, which is completely organic, is spread over central Gotland. We are today 45 employees who work together all year round towards high goals. Today, 12 machine operators work in our cultivation team, led by our team leader Marcus and cultivation manager Jakob. In the summer, we are reinforced by around 180 summer workers in manual cleaning of our organic cultivations. the coffee room. We are a smoke-free company. As an employee with us, you get the work and protective clothing you need in your role with us. We have a management team that is seen continuously where we constantly try to develop and improve the company. The management team includes the following roles CEO, cultivation manager, HR manager, Team leader Sylfaste, Team leader Atlingbo, Team leader Cultivation, We ourselves would like to describe ourselves as a stable growing company where much is still undone and the opportunities are great. We are informal and straightforward with a short chain of command in a flat structure. We are aware that our employees are the most important thing we have and that it is people who build the company. Together as a team, we try to implement the goals and visions we have for the business. About the position Until the summer of 2025, we are looking for tractor drivers for summer jobs to cover vacation times for our regular staff and to catch up when the field work is most intensive. You should be very interested of crop cultivation and agricultural machinery. Inspired by the feeling of being part of a larger work team where you share challenges together, strive towards high goals without having far to laugh. The work consists of many different tasks in crop cultivation where you contribute to trying to get the crop to reach its full potential. We solve a large part of the tasks in teams, but there are also many tasks that are solved on your own when you get warm in your clothes. It is a prerequisite that you have experience of driving agricultural machinery, that you can perform them with skill without damaging either the crop, the machine or the surroundings. Your attitude and desire to develop with us is strong and the commitment to do your best is a matter of course. .The position can be filled before the application deadline.Joining date for the position by agreement based on how your conditions look like for the coming summer.Salary according to increase.For the right applicant who currently does not live on Gotland, we can actively help find accommodation through our local network, several people in our existing team have come from the mainland in recent years. The application is emailed to jobb@widegrens.se

cypher_result.j.title: Tractor and machine operator for Widegrens Gård on Gotland
cypher_result.j.description: About usWidegrens Gård on Gotland specializes in the organic cultivation of potatoes, carrots and onions with our own packing plant where we wash, sort and pack the products. In addition to this, there is also the cultivation of grain and rapeseed. Our carrot packing house is in Atlingbo and our potato and onion packing house is in Follingbo. The cultivation, which is completely organic, is spread over central Gotland. We are today 45 employees who work together all year round towards high goals. Today, 12 machine operators work in our cultivation team, led by our team leader Marcus and cultivation manager Jakob. In the summer, we are reinforced by around 180 summer workers in manual cleaning of our organic cultivations. the coffee room. We are a smoke-free company. As an employee with us, you get the work and protective clothing you need in your role with us. We have a management team that is seen continuously where we constantly try to develop and improve the company. The management team includes the following roles CEO, cultivation manager, HR manager, Team leader Sylfaste, Team leader Atlingbo, Team leader Cultivation, We ourselves would like to describe ourselves as a stable growing company where much is still undone and the opportunities are great. We are informal and straightforward with a short chain of command in a flat structure. We are aware that our employees are the most important thing we have and that it is people who build the company. Together as a team, we try to implement the goals and visions we have for the business. You who apply to us should enjoy teamwork in a lively environment with lots of humor and laughter in a serious world between too little or too much rain at the right or wrong time. About the positionWe are now looking for new important pieces of the puzzle for our cultivation team! The team currently consists of 12 machine operators, but when this year's cultivation season is over, two valued employees in the team move on to their own businesses. It is the most common reason that people leave us, they come from agricultural school or another job and stay with us for a few years and then move on to their own business. You should be very interested in crop cultivation and agricultural machinery. Inspired by the feeling of being part of a larger work team where you share challenges together, strive towards high goals without having far to laugh. The work consists of many different tasks in crop cultivation such as, for example, rotary harrowing, sowing of root vegetables, planting potatoes and onions, stone rowing, mechanical weed control, harrowing, chopping, milling and cupping, ploughing, cultivation, sowing of cereals, harvesting of potatoes and root vegetables, transport of products from fields to our cold storage, moving and commissioning irrigation machines and much more. The growing season with us runs roughly between 1 April- 15 November and as a machine operator with us, during this period you are basically all the time in a tractor in a field to help the crops reach their full potential. At other times of the year, it is service and maintenance of the machinery in the workshop, improvements to outbuildings, trucking and transport between our various warehouses. We solve a large part of the tasks in teams, but there are also many tasks that are solved on your own when you have warmed up in the clothes. It is a prerequisite that you have experience driving agricultural machines, that you can drive them skillfully without damaging either the crop, the machine or the surroundings. Your attitude and desire to develop with us is strong and the commitment to do your part the best is a matter of course. You are welcome to describe yourself as driven, humorous, in a good mood even if you are busy and that you have your heart in the relationship with colleagues, products and partners. The position is a full-time position all year round. the application is positive. The position can be filled before the application deadline. For the right applicant who does not currently live on Gotland, we can actively help find accommodation through our local network, several people in our existing team have come from the mainland in recent years. The application is emailed to jobb@widegrens.se

For the occupation **Horticulture production team leader** (ID: `8e24c53a-9dc6-46d1-986b-48a93f20df2a`), the following skills and knowledge are required:

### Skills/Competences
*   **Agricultural production planning:** Develop plans for planting and calculate input requirements for all growth stages.
*   **Assigning duties to agricultural workers:** Assign duties such as cultivation, irrigation, or harvesting, and supervise packaging/grading and equipment maintenance.
*   **Managing agricultural staff:** Recruit and manage staff, define job needs, ensure health and safety, and develop staff competencies.
*   **Supervising horticultural crews:** Plan, assign, and evaluate daily activities for horticultural crews.
*   **Managing production enterprise:** Organize and instruct staff, plan production strategies and sales, manage stocks/inputs, and control budgets using business economics and project management principles.
*   **Performing on-farm product processing:** Transform primary farm products into food products while respecting hygiene and security rules.
*   **Executing fertilisation:** Perform fertilization tasks manually or with equipment according to instructions and regulations.
*   **Operating horticulture equipment:** Operate horticultural equipment and assist with servicing.
*   **Maintaining technical/gardening equipment:** Perform daily maintenance on tools/equipment and report faults.
*   **Maintaining the greenhouse:** Perform maintenance such as cleaning windows, drains, and gutters.
*   **Coordinating greenhouse environment:** Manage heating and cooling and oversee irrigation system maintenance.
*   **Grow plants:** Carry out plant growing activities and growth control.
*   **Harvest crop:** Mow, pick, or cut crops manually or with machinery according to quality and hygiene criteria.
*   **Prepare planting area:** Prepare soil and planting areas, sow, and plant.
*   **Store crops:** Store and preserve crops according to standards and regulations.
*   **Execute disease and pest control activities:** Use conventional or biological methods while following safety and environmental regulations.
*   **Ensure soil fertility:** Analyse soil to determine fertiliser needs.
*   **Keep task records:** Organise and classify records of reports, correspondence, and task progress.
*   **Carry out work-related calculations in agriculture:** Calculate on-site requirements regarding marketing and budgets.
*   **Present farm facilities:** Perform customer-adapted presentations of farm organization and processes.
*   **Make independent operating decisions:** Make immediate operating decisions based on circumstances and legislation.

### Knowledge
*   **Horticulture principles:** Standard practices such as planting, pruning, and fertilisation.
*   **Crop production principles:** Principles in growing crops, natural cycles, growth conditions, and organic/sustainable production.
*   **Agronomical production principles:** Techniques and methods of conventional agronomical production.
*   **Agroecology:** Application of ecological and agronomic concepts to production systems.
*   **Agricultural business management:** Business principles behind production and marketing.
*   **Budgetary principles:** Principles of estimating and planning business forecasts and reports.
*   **E-agriculture:** Application of ICT solutions in agriculture and horticulture.
*   **Food safety principles:** Scientific background on the preparation, handling, and storage of food.
*   **Food legislation:** Laws related to the food industry (hygiene, safety, labelling, etc.).
*   **Health and safety regulations:** Necessary standards and legislation rules for the sector.
*   **Plant species:** Characteristics of various plants, trees, and shrubs.
*   **Soil structure:** Diversity of soil elements and their relation to plant growth.
*   **Fertilisation principles:** Study of plant, soil structure, and environmental issues.
*   **Plant propagation:** Knowledge of propagation methods and materials.
*   **Plant disease/pest control:** Understanding features and control methods for pests and diseases.
*   **Greenhouse types:** Knowledge of various horticultural facilities.
*   **Project management principles:** Elements and phases of project management.

cypher_result.j.title: Växthusarbetare till food tech-bolag
cypher_result.j.description: Do you have a genuine interest in plants? Are you attracted by independent physical work in a lovely environment? Apply for a position as a greenhouse worker for one of Sweden's most exciting food tech companies. Your future challenge Agtira is an innovative food tech company that supplies and operates vegetable farms. Right now, the company is in a growth phase and will therefore start a new facility in Kramfors in early 2025. For this facility, we are now looking for greenhouse workers who want to be involved from the start to build up this exciting business. Within Agtira, we are a total of 31 people who are distributed across five different facilities in Sweden. We are a tightly knit team that works together to develop the urban farms of the future. We do this by offering our customers Farming as a Service. In the role of a greenhouse worker, you will be responsible for daily plant care, quality assurance and biological control. Tasks that occur are: Planting Weeding Pruning Harvesting cucumbers Packaging cucumbers Who you are We are looking for you as has a genuine interest in plants. You also need to have an eye for details and like independent and physical work. It is desirable that you have previous experience with growing plants as well as with greenhouse equipment and scissor lifts. Good knowledge of Swedish and English is a requirement. You are over 18 years old. About the companyAgtira is a food tech company that supplies and operates facilities for sustainable and profitable food production. By growing cucumbers, tomatoes, herbs and other vegetables directly adjacent to stores, we eliminate the transport route and ensure that consumers can eat fresh vegetables all year round. Our Farming-as-a-Service (FaaS) business model means that we build and operate a tailor-made facility for the products the customer wants. The customer buys his entire needs at fixed prices for a longer period, up to 15 years. Our facilities are currently located in Härnösand, Sundsvall, Östersund and Skellefteå, as well as a new facility in Haninge that will open this autumn. Our ambition is to be a world leader in cultivation in urban environments and constantly develop both cultivation methods and software support. Click on the link to find out more! Agtira - Here-grown vegetables every day, all year round (youtube.com) Contact person If you have questions about the position, contact: Lisa Fagerström, recruitment consultant Cre8 Future, lisa.fagerstrom@cre8future.se , 076-8241789 Warm welcome with your application! cypher_result.j.title: Foreman, Agricultural machinery
cypher_result.j.description: Are you technically interested with experience in servicing and repairing heavy machinery and motivated by leading work and engaging others? Then there is now the chance to become our new foreman at Swedish Agro in Skara!WHAT WILL YOU BE A PART OF?Swedish AgroAt Swedish Agro, we create value for Swedish agriculture by being a comprehensive supplier for the individual farmer and offering inputs, feed and machinery of the highest quality. We represent the industry's leading brands CLAAS, HORSCH, METSJÖ, RAUCH, SPEARHEAD, SCANSTONE, AVR, AGXEED and DALBO and have one of Europe's most modern feed factories and manufacture feed for several animal species. We have a common belief that we are stronger together and work for the long term, quality and profitability. We continue to grow and are now looking for a second foreman for our team in Skara, which is one of our largest facilities in the country. As a foreman, you will be a key person in the workshop by leading and driving the business forward in close cooperation and will be part of a committed team that is passionate about agriculture and our customers. YOUR PRIMARY WORK TASKS Technical guidance with a focus on service As a foreman, you will be responsible for lead and distribute the work in the workshop and out in the field by supporting the entire department in the technical work. In this role, you are part of the workshop management, which consists of the workshop manager and two foremen, where you work together with the service department's 10 technicians towards clear qualitative goals. We work in a technologically modern environment that requires qualifications to administer business systems and digital aids.  Your tasks will include: Plan and lead the work in the workshop and out in the field Close cooperation with the workshop manager, sales, spare parts and other departments in the company Contact with customers Administer work orders Lead and participate in readiness during high season Machine logisticsYOUR PROFILEProblem solver who likes to lead and collaborateWe are looking for you who have a great technical interest and knowledge of heavy machinery. As a person, you like to have a lot of balls in the air, work in a varied role and have the ability to see solutions instead of problems. Collaboration comes easily to you where you have clear leadership and enjoy guiding, engaging and supporting people around you to create a good team spirit. To succeed in the role, we believe that you are motivated by challenges, have a strong drive of your own where responsibility and development are something that you are attracted to. We would like to see that you have a strong technical interest and a broad knowledge of agricultural machinery. If you have experience in agriculture, we also see that as an advantage. Furthermore, we see that you have: Experience from the agricultural/machinery industry Meritorious with technical training, preferably heavy vehicles/agricultural machinery High social skills with an understanding of customers' needs and wishes Are computer literate and a good administrator Good knowledge of Swedish and English in speech and writing B driver's license is a requirement WE OFFER Stronger together At Swedish Agro, our foundation is based on cooperation and we have a fundamental belief that we are stronger together. We thus offer a workplace where we develop together - across departments, skills and national borders. Our employees are our most important resource and we strive to create the best framework for well-being, development and influence. With us, you get the opportunity to undergo internal and external training so that you gain knowledge of the latest technology - we work with the most high-tech the products on the market with well-known brands ARE YOU INTERESTED? How to apply If you think the position sounds exciting, please send your application and CV today or as soon as possible by clicking "APPLY". We expect to hold interviews continuously and we stop the search when the right candidate has been found. We believe that diversity strengthens the solution of tasks. We therefore invite all interested parties - regardless of background - to apply for the position. We hope to hear from you! AN INTERNATIONAL GROUP We want to create value! For agriculture, for the farmer and for our employees. Swedish Agro is part of the Danish Agro group, with more than 5,000 colleagues spread over 100+ companies in 15 countries. From the field to the screen, our employees are at the core of our ability to create value and develop the agriculture of the future and ensure that we can play a decisive role in the industry's digital and green transition - and that we help the farmer grow world-class food every day. We do this by strengthening, growing and developing the industry - and not least each other. And we need you too! Are you more curious about the Danish Agro group? Watch our group film here!

cypher_result.j.title: Lantbrukare med huvudansvar för jordbruk och djurhållning
cypher_result.j.description: Tasks: We now need to supplement the workforce with you who want to contribute to the development of the cultural reserve Stensjö village. It is a unique opportunity to, together with colleagues on site and with the support of management advice and external expertise, participate in the development work and work towards the cultural-historical target image. During the changes of the seasons, you will contribute to recreating the experience of old-time small farms in the Småland forest region. The position involves primary responsibility for agriculture and animal husbandry in a landscape characterized by natural grazing, mowing fields, small fields and large forest areas. All cultivation is organic. You must be prepared to take on managerial responsibilities. The permanent staff at the farm consists of four people with different areas of responsibility (agriculture, forestry, garden, landscape), one of whom is site manager with overall responsibility for the property. During the growing season, the workforce is supplemented by one to two seasonal workers. The animal supervision on the weekends rotates between the staff so that work takes place according to schedule every third to fourth weekend. Common, ongoing work tasks consist of all tasks occurring within a farm with an ecological orientation and a focus on cultural-historical landscape care. An important task is to continuously document the work that is done. Passing on knowledge of the uniqueness of Stensjö village to visitors and groups is also part of the work. Participation in management councils and ongoing contacts with the County Administrative Board regarding issues relating to the cultural reserve are included, as well as administrative work and authority contacts related to the duties, such as EU and other applications, reporting and registration. Programs used at Stensjö include Dataväxt, Växa Sverige, CDB, Elitlamm etc. About Stensjö village Stensjö village comprises 576 hectares of which 14 hectares are arable, 81 hectares of pasture, 417 hectares of forest and 44 hectares of impediment. The large contiguous areas with natural pastures are distinctive for Stensjö village. A typical feature is the kilometre-long hedgerows that enclose holdings, pastures and cattle lanes. Small fields, mowing fields, pastures and open fields with forest grazing characterize the landscape. The village's great importance lies in the fact that houses and property form a unit that is original. Residential houses and outbuildings, a total of about 50 in number, are gathered in a cluster village, which was common in many places in Småland before legal transfer was carried out in the 19th century. In the village there are about fifteen cows and a bull of the red kulla breed as well as about 30 Helsingo sheep, some pigs and chickens. During the summer months, hired cows walk in the forest pastures. The field cultivation consists of paddy, potatoes and cultivated crops, mainly older cereals but also flax. The land has been cultivated organically since the Vitterhetsakademien took over the property in the 1960s. Since 2020, Stensjö village is a cultural reserve. The management plan aims to show Stensjö as it looked at the turn of the century in 1900. The land types that existed at that time should be well represented in the form of pastures, fodder dikes, gardens, ancient fields with cereal crops, natural hay fields and forest pastures. Long-term work is underway where the management plan is the guiding principle with the aim of recreating an older land use. Stensjö village is to be developed into a knowledge and development center for historic landscape use. The management plan can be found on the website under the Management plan and documents tab. To support the work, there is a management council that meets at Stensjö twice a year. The maintenance council consists of 5-7 people with experience in practical landscape and garden maintenance and building maintenance, as well as representatives for research in relevant areas. Administrative support such as finance, communication etc. can be found at the Vitterhetsakademien's office in Stockholm. Qualifications Requirements for the position You must have documented, solid experience in crop cultivation and animal husbandry Ability to work both independently and together with others Good verbal and written communication skills in Swedish Experience in administration and authority contacts regarding farm support, animal husbandry, EU applications etc. Driving license BMeritandEducation in agriculture and animal husbandryEducation/experience in organic farming with crop rotations Experience of work management Education/experience of: Landscape care with a cultural-historical focus, scythes Work with horses Forestry with clear cutting methods Machine maintenance Building care/property care with an antiquarian focus Experience of museum operations and outward-looking, public activities Basic interest and knowledge of small farms; nature, history and culture, and preferably more specifically about Småland's conditions Driving license BEChainsaw driving license A and BHunting licensePersonal characteristicsWe attach great importance to personal suitability. You can work independently and intensively when required, but also be a good colleague and partner with Stensjö's best interests at heart in all internal and external contexts. You have a great sense of responsibility and can flexibly change between the various tasks. Employment and other information about the work The position is a permanent, full-time position that begins with a six-month probationary period. The work involves scheduled working hours, which includes work on evenings, weekends and public holidays. The academy applies individual salary setting. The workplace is Stensjö village, 10 km north of Oskarshamn. There is an opportunity to live in Stensjö village. The Vitterhetsakademien's office is in Stockholm. Support functions such as finances, administration, communication, IT support, archives, etc. is there. The property manager, who is the immediate manager, has his main place of work in Stockholm but is on site in Stensjö village several times a year. In between, meetings and contact take place via Teams and telephone. Collaboration and meetings with colleagues at the other cultural properties take place regularly, including in connection with joint property meetings twice a year. The members of the Vitterhetsakademie have a great interest in the cultural properties and many regularly visit Stensjö village. There is guest accommodation for them at each cultural property, which enables overnight stays.

cypher_result.j.title: Researchers in ecosystem services in strip cultivation
cypher_result.j.description: The Department of Bio Systems and Technology Som Jobs It is important to reduce the unilateral cultivation of a few crops in large fields, and instead increase the diversity of crops to benefit biodiversity and increase ecosystem services such as biological control. In this project we will assess whether strip cultivation, where two or more crops are grown next to each other in strips adapted to the width of modern sowing machines, can strengthen biological control, reduce the use of pesticides and maintain harvests compared to when each crop is grown alone on the field. In addition, we will validate the experiment with trials on farms, where farmers themselves decide the management. We are looking for a motivated person with a few years of experience as a researcher and with the ambition of an academic career, who also has a great interest in developing knowledge about the effect of the strip cultivation on biological Control of pests and the return on economically important agricultural crops. The candidate is expected to investigate what potential strip cultivation in practically applicable care has to mitigate the harvest loss of the pest. This means, among other things, planning a cultivation attempt at the university's experimental station, field work, collaboration with Swedish and international partners and to investigate agricultural acceptance of innovative cultivation systems such as strip cultivation. We attach great importance to personal fitness and are looking for you who have good cooperative ability but also be able to work independently. You are looking for you who have: • Doctorate in biology with a focus on insect ecology and their ecosystem services in diversified cultivation systems, or equivalent • demonstrated research experience in the subjects insect pollination and biological control of pests, insect diversity in legumes and rapeseed and effects of co -cultivation • High skills in statistical processing and handling of ecological data • showed ability to publish research results in international scientifically examined magazines • Excellent knowledge in written and oral communication in English and oral Communication in Swedish • Effective communication skills, a strong work ethic and shown experience in collaborating with stakeholders outside the academy • Granted applications with the Research Council are qualified if you also have: • Experience in international collaborations • Experience in project planning, field work and project management • Experience in supervision T .ex.  Knowledge of the functioning of European EAFRD programs and funds;  Use and design of specific computer applications and use of office tools; Relational skills internally and externally, ability to popularize complex technical elements and to speak in public; cypher_result.j.title: Sales manager north, Väktodling
cypher_result.j.description: Are you passionate about Swedish agriculture, are you a good leader with a strong business sense? Do you want to work in a driving role in crop cultivation and be active in the market? Then there is the chance to become our new sales manager at Swedish Agro!WHAT WILL YOU BE A PART OF?Swedish AgroSwedish Agro is undergoing strong growth and we are now looking for a driven sales manager in the field of crop cultivation with a location in one of our locations Skänninge, Skara, Enköping or Kumla . Swedish Agro is also looking for a trained Safety Advisor, which is meritorious competence for this position. At Swedish Agro, we create value for Swedish agriculture by being a comprehensive supplier for the individual farmer and offering inputs, feed and machinery of the highest quality. We represent the industry's leading machinery brands CLAAS, HORSCH, METSJÖ, RAUCH, SPEARHEAD, SCANSTONE, AVR, AGXEED and DALBO and have one of Europe's most modern feed factories that manufacture feed for several animal species. We have a common belief that we are stronger together and work for the long term, quality and profitability. YOUR AREA OF RESPONSIBILITY As a sales manager, you run the day-to-day sales, which means that you lead and support around 10 plant cultivation salespeople in their work by being a sounding board for business decisions. The role means that you will drive sales efficiency, coach both new and experienced salespeople and manage change processes within the organization. Support for the sellers includes follow-up of key figures, development of existing staff and conducting employee interviews. In the role, you will also have product manager responsibility for mineral fertilizers within Swedish Agro, and we thus see that you are to some extent active in the market with own customer responsibility and own sales targets. You thus have your own sales responsibility and work flexibly with the opportunity to both be out in the field and work from the office. As a sales manager, you report to the Sales Manager for plant cultivation Sweden. YOUR PROFILE As a person, you are driven and interested in business towards agriculture in order to create added value together with the customer and our salespeople. Experience or training in agriculture is essential to assume the role of Sales Manager in crop cultivation at Swedish Agro. Furthermore, we see that you are thorough, responsive and structured in your way of working and have a great interest in motivating and developing others. To thrive in the role, you have a coaching and supportive leadership style where you encourage your employees to take responsibility and initiative in their roles. You are also used to effectively, clearly and transparently communicating and reporting to management. We place great emphasis on your personal qualities and driving forces. Furthermore, we see that you have: At least 3-5 years of experience in the agricultural industry Experience in sales or trade (B2B) Proven leadership skills Merit with post-secondary education focusing on agronomist/farm manager/agrotechnician or similar Merit with experience in personnel responsibility Good knowledge of Swedish both verbally and writing B driving license WE OFFER Stronger together At Swedish Agro, our foundation is based on cooperation and we have a fundamental belief that we are stronger together. We thus offer a workplace where we develop together - across departments, skills and national borders. Our employees are our most important resource and we strive to create the best conditions for well-being, commitment and influence. ARE YOU INTERESTED? How to apply If you think the position sounds exciting, please send your application today or as soon as possible by clicking on "APPLY". We expect to hold interviews continuously and may stop the search when the right candidate has been found. If you have any questions about the position, please contact Patrik Persson, Sales Manager, Swedish Agro on 072-535 30 17. AN INTERNATIONAL GROUP We want to create value! For agriculture, for the farmer and for our employees. Swedish Agro is part of the Danish Agro group, with more than 5,000 colleagues spread over 100 companies in 15 countries. From the field to the screen, our employees are at the core of our ability to create value and develop the agriculture of the future and ensure that we can play a decisive role in the industry's digital and green transition - and that we help the farmer grow world-class food every day. We do this by strengthening, growing and developing the industry - and not least each other. And we need you too! Are you more curious about the Danish Agro group? Watch our group film here!

retrieved_entities.description: Tasks: We now need to supplement the workforce with you who want to contribute to the development of the cultural reserve Stensjö village. It is a unique opportunity to, together with colleagues on site and with the support of management advice and external expertise, participate in the development work and work towards the cultural-historical target image. During the changes of the seasons, you will contribute to recreating the experience of old-time small farms in the Småland forest region. The position involves primary responsibility for agriculture and animal husbandry in a landscape characterized by natural grazing, mowing fields, small fields and large forest areas. All cultivation is organic. You must be prepared to take on managerial responsibilities. The permanent staff at the farm consists of four people with different areas of responsibility (agriculture, forestry, garden, landscape), one of whom is site manager with overall responsibility for the property. During the growing season, the workforce is supplemented by one to two seasonal workers. The animal supervision on the weekends rotates between the staff so that work takes place according to schedule every third to fourth weekend. Common, ongoing work tasks consist of all tasks occurring within a farm with an ecological orientation and a focus on cultural-historical landscape care. An important task is to continuously document the work that is done. Passing on knowledge of the uniqueness of Stensjö village to visitors and groups is also part of the work. Participation in management councils and ongoing contacts with the County Administrative Board regarding issues relating to the cultural reserve are included, as well as administrative work and authority contacts related to the duties, such as EU and other applications, reporting and registration. Programs used at Stensjö include Dataväxt, Växa Sverige, CDB, Elitlamm etc. About Stensjö village Stensjö village comprises 576 hectares of which 14 hectares are arable, 81 hectares of pasture, 417 hectares of forest and 44 hectares of impediment. The large contiguous areas with natural pastures are distinctive for Stensjö village. A typical feature is the kilometre-long hedgerows that enclose holdings, pastures and cattle lanes. Small fields, mowing fields, pastures and open fields with forest grazing characterize the landscape. The village's great importance lies in the fact that houses and property form a unit that is original. Residential houses and outbuildings, a total of about 50 in number, are gathered in a cluster village, which was common in many places in Småland before legal transfer was carried out in the 19th century. In the village there are about fifteen cows and a bull of the red kulla breed as well as about 30 Helsingo sheep, some pigs and chickens. During the summer months, hired cows walk in the forest pastures. The field cultivation consists of paddy, potatoes and cultivated crops, mainly older cereals but also flax. The land has been cultivated organically since the Vitterhetsakademien took over the property in the 1960s. Since 2020, Stensjö village is a cultural reserve. The management plan aims to show Stensjö as it looked at the turn of the century in 1900. The land types that existed at that time should be well represented in the form of pastures, fodder dikes, gardens, ancient fields with cereal crops, natural hay fields and forest pastures. Long-term work is underway where the management plan is the guiding principle with the aim of recreating an older land use. Stensjö village is to be developed into a knowledge and development center for historic landscape use. The management plan can be found on the website under the Management plan and documents tab. To support the work, there is a management council that meets at Stensjö twice a year. The maintenance council consists of 5-7 people with experience in practical landscape and garden maintenance and building maintenance, as well as representatives for research in relevant areas. Administrative support such as finance, communication etc. can be found at the Vitterhetsakademien's office in Stockholm. Qualifications Requirements for the position You must have documented, solid experience in crop cultivation and animal husbandry Ability to work both independently and together with others Good verbal and written communication skills in Swedish Experience in administration and authority contacts regarding farm support, animal husbandry, EU applications etc. Driving license BMeritandEducation in agriculture and animal husbandryEducation/experience in organic farming with crop rotations Experience of work management Education/experience of: Landscape care with a cultural-historical focus, scythes Work with horses Forestry with clear cutting methods Machine maintenance Building care/property care with an antiquarian focus Experience of museum operations and outward-looking, public activities Basic interest and knowledge of small farms; nature, history and culture, and preferably more specifically about Småland's conditions Driving license BEChainsaw driving license A and BHunting licensePersonal characteristicsWe attach great importance to personal suitability. You can work independently and intensively when required, but also be a good colleague and partner with Stensjö's best interests at heart in all internal and external contexts. You have a great sense of responsibility and can flexibly change between the various tasks. Employment and other information about the work The position is a permanent, full-time position that begins with a six-month probationary period. The work involves scheduled working hours, which includes work on evenings, weekends and public holidays. The academy applies individual salary setting. The workplace is Stensjö village, 10 km north of Oskarshamn. There is an opportunity to live in Stensjö village. The Vitterhetsakademien's office is in Stockholm. Support functions such as finances, administration, communication, IT support, archives, etc. is there. The property manager, who is the immediate manager, has his main place of work in Stockholm but is on site in Stensjö village several times a year. In between, meetings and contact take place via Teams and telephone. Collaboration and meetings with colleagues at the other cultural properties take place regularly, including in connection with joint property meetings twice a year. The members of the Vitterhetsakademie have a great interest in the cultural properties and many regularly visit Stensjö village. There is guest accommodation for them at each cultural property, which enables overnight stays.

retrieved_entities.description: Tasks: We now need to supplement the workforce with you who want to contribute to the development of the cultural reserve Stensjö village. It is a unique opportunity to, together with colleagues on site and with the support of management advice and external expertise, participate in the development work and work towards the cultural-historical target image. During the changes of the seasons, you will contribute to recreating the experience of old-time small farms in the Småland forest region. The position involves primary responsibility for agriculture and animal husbandry in a landscape characterized by natural grazing, mowing fields, small fields and large forest areas. All cultivation is organic. You must be prepared to take on managerial responsibilities. The permanent staff at the farm consists of four people with different areas of responsibility (agriculture, forestry, garden, landscape), one of whom is site manager with overall responsibility for the property. During the growing season, the workforce is supplemented by one to two seasonal workers. The animal supervision on the weekends rotates between the staff so that work takes place according to schedule every third to fourth weekend. Common, ongoing work tasks consist of all tasks occurring within a farm with an ecological orientation and a focus on cultural-historical landscape care. An important task is to continuously document the work that is done. Passing on knowledge of the uniqueness of Stensjö village to visitors and groups is also part of the work. Participation in management councils and ongoing contacts with the County Administrative Board regarding issues relating to the cultural reserve are included, as well as administrative work and authority contacts related to the duties, such as EU and other applications, reporting and registration. Programs used at Stensjö include Dataväxt, Växa Sverige, CDB, Elitlamm etc. About Stensjö village Stensjö village comprises 576 hectares of which 14 hectares are arable, 81 hectares of pasture, 417 hectares of forest and 44 hectares of impediment. The large contiguous areas with natural pastures are distinctive for Stensjö village. A typical feature is the kilometre-long hedgerows that enclose holdings, pastures and cattle lanes. Small fields, mowing fields, pastures and open fields with forest grazing characterize the landscape. The village's great importance lies in the fact that houses and property form a unit that is original. Residential houses and outbuildings, a total of about 50 in number, are gathered in a cluster village, which was common in many places in Småland before legal transfer was carried out in the 19th century. In the village there are about fifteen cows and a bull of the red kulla breed as well as about 30 Helsingo sheep, some pigs and chickens. During the summer months, hired cows walk in the forest pastures. The field cultivation consists of paddy, potatoes and cultivated crops, mainly older cereals but also flax. The land has been cultivated organically since the Vitterhetsakademien took over the property in the 1960s. Since 2020, Stensjö village is a cultural reserve. The management plan aims to show Stensjö as it looked at the turn of the century in 1900. The land types that existed at that time should be well represented in the form of pastures, fodder dikes, gardens, ancient fields with cereal crops, natural hay fields and forest pastures. Long-term work is underway where the management plan is the guiding principle with the aim of recreating an older land use. Stensjö village is to be developed into a knowledge and development center for historic landscape use. The management plan can be found on the website under the Management plan and documents tab. To support the work, there is a management council that meets at Stensjö twice a year. The maintenance council consists of 5-7 people with experience in practical landscape and garden maintenance and building maintenance, as well as representatives for research in relevant areas. Administrative support such as finance, communication etc. can be found at the Vitterhetsakademien's office in Stockholm. Qualifications Requirements for the position You must have documented, solid experience in crop cultivation and animal husbandry Ability to work both independently and together with others Good verbal and written communication skills in Swedish Experience in administration and authority contacts regarding farm support, animal husbandry, EU applications etc. Driving license BMeritandEducation in agriculture and animal husbandryEducation/experience in organic farming with crop rotations Experience of work management Education/experience of: Landscape care with a cultural-historical focus, scythes Work with horses Forestry with clear cutting methods Machine maintenance Building care/property care with an antiquarian focus Experience of museum operations and outward-looking, public activities Basic interest and knowledge of small farms; nature, history and culture, and preferably more specifically about Småland's conditions Driving license BEChainsaw driving license A and BHunting licensePersonal characteristicsWe attach great importance to personal suitability. You can work independently and intensively when required, but also be a good colleague and partner with Stensjö's best interests at heart in all internal and external contexts. You have a great sense of responsibility and can flexibly change between the various tasks. Employment and other information about the work The position is a permanent, full-time position that begins with a six-month probationary period. The work involves scheduled working hours, which includes work on evenings, weekends and public holidays. The academy applies individual salary setting. The workplace is Stensjö village, 10 km north of Oskarshamn. There is an opportunity to live in Stensjö village. The Vitterhetsakademien's office is in Stockholm. Support functions such as finances, administration, communication, IT support, archives, etc. is there. The property manager, who is the immediate manager, has his main place of work in Stockholm but is on site in Stensjö village several times a year. In between, meetings and contact take place via Teams and telephone. Collaboration and meetings with colleagues at the other cultural properties take place regularly, including in connection with joint property meetings twice a year. The members of the Vitterhetsakademie have a great interest in the cultural properties and many regularly visit Stensjö village. There is guest accommodation for them at each cultural property, which enables overnight stays.

cypher_result.j.title: Administrators and advisors with a focus on farm animals
cypher_result.j.description: The county board's approximately 300 employees work as the government's representative at regional level. Our mission is to develop the county and work to ensure that the national political goals have an impact in the county. We work to be an authority free from discrimination and want to take advantage of the qualities that diversity brings to the business. The rural unit is one of the county board's seven units with approximately 40 employees. The unit is responsible for project and investment support, animal and area-based support, advice and courses for agricultural companies, supervision in agriculture, register checks on animals, land acquisition permits for agricultural and forestry properties and monitoring of basic paid services. Within the unit there is also the Interreg Sweden Norway program for which the County Administrative Board of Jämtland County is the managing authority. The unit has overall responsibility for rural issues and is responsible for the agricultural and rural focus in the cross-sector collaboration at the County Board. We work with experts in these fields who are happy to share their knowledge. We work with respect, professionalism and openness for the county's residents - together for a sustainable future! The county. This includes, among other things, counseling and skills-enhancing activities aimed at the county's farmers. Our current pet consultant is now retiring and we are therefore looking for her successor who wants to work with skills development for the county's farmers with a focus on the farm's animal husbandry. Job duties You will be part of a group that works with planning, implementing and leading skills development within the common agricultural policy in the form of advice, courses and information to farmers. The work entails partly independently carrying out competence-enhancing initiatives such as courses, counseling and farm meetings with exchange of experience and partly coordinating other actors that the county administrative board has procured for various activities. You write applications for project funds and, together with colleagues, carry out the procurement of competence development efforts. The work includes financial accounting and reporting of measures taken. You collaborate with industry actors and organizations and have close cooperation with other county administrative boards as well as with various functions at our county administrative board. You may be part of cross-sectoral groups where you need to be able to combine your expertise with a holistic perspective. You participate in the work of responding to referrals and contributing with the perspective of agriculture on various issues. Depending on experience and competence, other tasks at the unit may also be part of the position. Your work is independent and requires you to be self-motivated, results-oriented and good at collaborating and creating relationships. You are sensitive to the needs of different clients. In your dialogue with farmers, you need to be service-oriented and have a good understanding of the companies' conditions in the county and have the ability to see the whole. You have a few years of work experience, experience from consultancy and government work is advantageous. You have work experience with a focus on agriculture and farm animals. If you also have experience in project management and work with skills development, as well as experience in working with small business owners, this is advantageous. You have the ability to communicate clearly in both speech and writing and have an established network within the agricultural industry. You are structured and solution-oriented with good computer skills. The position involves travel, mainly in the county, but longer trips with overnight stays also occur. A driver's license for a passenger car is required. We offer you meaningful work with varied tasks. You will make a difference to our county and society. The County Board is a broad authority, which means that you constantly have the opportunity to develop and learn new things. This applies in several policy areas. As an employer, we have a strong focus on good employment conditions, active work environment work and health-promoting wellness activities. We are keen on cooperation with our union partners and can offer remote work. In case of permanent employment at the County Board, you will be placed at war with the authority. Depending on the service, this may include serving in crisis staff and security classification. We usually start with trial employment for permanent positions. cypher_result.j.title: Agricultural adviser to the Councilors in Sjuhärad
cypher_result.j.description: Do you want to work with cattle and crop production? Advise on feed for milk and meat production from sowing to feed table? Then this could be something for you! About the service The service is a unique combination of crop cultivation, mainly fodder, and advisory services to farms with milk or meat production. You will be part of working groups with pet advisors and crop advisors. There is also the opportunity to work in various projects connected to agriculture. About you We are looking for you who are agronomists, land managers or have equivalent education. You must have experience in both crop cultivation and cattle. You need to enjoy having customer contact and like working in a team. Great emphasis is placed on personal suitability. We offer We have a wide range of activities in finance, crop cultivation, forestry and animal production. The advisers also have a department with pet technicians who perform farm-related services and are based in Ulricehamn. We have a close collaboration with the Sjuhärad Farming Society, where research and experimental activities are carried out as well as training through the Strömma Naturbrukcentrum. The head office is at the Rural Advisory Center in Länghem, a few miles from Borås. We offer a fantastic work environment with committed colleagues and short decision-making paths. Qualifications You need to have a driver's license and access to a car and be trained as an agronomist, land master or equivalent. Welcome with your application!

Preventive Maintenance: Carry out regular checks to ensure the good condition of machines and prevent breakdowns. Implement a maintenance plan and ensure that interventions are carried out on time.3. Installation and Commissioning: Install new equipment and machines on farms, ensuring their conformity and proper functioning. Train users in the use of machines and basic maintenance.4. Parts Stock Management: Monitor and manage the stock of spare parts and consumables necessary for machine maintenance. cypher_result.j.title: Application expert
cypher_result.j.description: Arevo is a development-driven company with roots in pioneering research into plant nutrient uptake. We want to change the way the earth's resources are used by enabling more sustainable and efficient plant cultivation. Our market is growing and we therefore want to strengthen the company with an application expert for our head office in Umeå. Arevo offersAt Arevo, you get to help develop business in an international context and at the same time contribute to real sustainable growth. We are a growing company with an inclusive atmosphere, where your thoughts and ideas can have a big impact. Arevo offers varied and challenging tasks as well as great personal responsibility and you have great opportunity to develop within the company. Your new work as an application expert As an application expert, you will be responsible for establishing and supporting both new and existing customers together with the responsible salesperson (Key account). Today, a large focus is on Nurseries in the forestry sector, but our plan is to grow in other sectors. You will, together with our salespeople, be on site at our customers and carry out a current situation analysis and then recommend measures to improve the customer's cultivation results. This is followed by implementation and follow-up during the season to ensure the best possible results. The work also includes being part of our product development in the form of the link between the customer and our developers. The service is based in Umeå. Arevo is located, with both production and lab operations, in modern and bright premises just outside Umeå city centre. The position involves some travel primarily to the Nordic countries, but may later also include Europe. If necessary, opportunities are given to work remotely. Are you who we are looking for? We believe that you have education in forestry, agronomy or a related field as well as a few years of experience in plant production or other relevant experience from commercial cultivation on a large scale. You should also have knowledge of plant nutrition, especially in connection with forest plant production. The role requires fluency Swedish and English in both speech and writing. You have a practical and solution-oriented approach and enjoy working in an advisory and supportive manner according to the customer's needs. You should also be both interested in and have the ability to carry out current situation analysis as well as analyze and interpret cultivation data, among other things. We assume that you have a structured way of working and good knowledge of the Microsoft Office package. Your application Arevo collaborates with Vedea and Åsa Holmström, 072-050 52 80. It is also possible to contact Arevo CEO, Niklas Åström, 070-669 34 44. You are warmly welcome with your application - marked Arevo - no later than November 27 via www. see. se/CVArevo - our business Arevo offers completely unique biostimulants and plant nutrition products that simplify cultivation and favor sustainable growth of plants. Arevo has its starting point in Professor Torgny Näsholm's pioneering and award-winning research on how plants can use the amino acid arginine as a natural nitrogen source. Our environmentally friendly products i The arGrow range stimulates root formation and growth of viable plants, provides low nitrogen leakage and enables good soil health. In total, over 95 million forest seedlings have been planted and over 600 million pine and spruce seedlings have been grown with Arevo's products. Development is underway for more species in forestry, gardening and agriculture. Simple, effective and climate-smart. Arevo was founded in 2015 as a spin-off from SweTree Technologies and is today owned by a. of Fort Knox, Navigare Venture, Industrifonden and Kempestiftelserna. Our strongly growing market consists of forest owners and growers worldwide. Please read more at www. arevo. see

cypher_result.j.title: Business manager for the new center for sustainable primary production
cypher_result.j.description: The unit for cooperation and development Do you want to take a key role in the development of knowledge for a sustainable primary production of food? Through an investment in the future, in collaboration between Sparbanken Skåne and SLU, this knowledge center is now being established, which will take advantage of Skåne's excellent conditions for sustainable food production through knowledge, innovation and new technical opportunities in collaboration between academia and the agricultural and horticultural industries. We are now looking for you to lead the center's development from the start, in close collaboration with SLU's research and education and with the support of management functions. You will be the operative spider in the network to take advantage of synergies and secure progress in the business. Read more in SLU's press release: 50 million invested in new knowledge center for sustainable food production in Alnarp | Externwebben (slu.se) About the job SLU and Sparbanken Skåne's center for sustainable primary production The formation of the center will promote sustainable primary production and work for a robust food chain that benefits economic growth and development in Scania in the long term. Through outstanding research and education, the center will collaborate with business and public actors to develop, disseminate and utilize knowledge and new solutions for a transition that balances economic, ecological and social sustainability. The center has four overarching goal areas for the operation.• Increased knowledge and innovation for increased sustainability in primary production• Increased collaboration in research and development• Higher level of technology in research, education and industry• Strengthen Skåne's contribution to the development of primary production in Sweden The center shall contribute to creating collaborations in order to make use of competence and resources which, in the long run, lead to even more results in primary production companies and in research and education. Duties Your area of ​​responsibility as business manager is to, in dialogue with management functions, be responsible for the centre's whole and sub-projects and to be the contact person towards Sparbanken Skåne and other partners to ensure business progress and goal achievement. A particular focus is to • develop the center with support from the steering group and advisory board • ensure the center's progress in line with the operational plan where coordination of sub-activities and utilization of synergies within the center and with other activities is included as a significant part • represent the center in contacts within and outside SLU • work to ensure that the business can be strengthened by, for example, taking initiatives for collaborations with relevant actors and research applications for supplementary funding• work actively for the business's contribution to making a difference for primary producers in Skåne• work for the center's mutual benefit for academia and practice Your manager is the head of unit at the unit for collaboration and development. Your background As an applicant for the position, you must have an academic degree in subject areas relevant to the future development of primary production and related areas. You must have experience of having coordinated collaborations in a leading position and also have worked in or in contact with academic environments. You must have documented leadership experience with financial responsibility. You must be responsive and goal-oriented with an inclusive, communicative and process-oriented way of working. Furthermore, you must be a driven person who is used to working independently while participating in teamwork. Good ability to express oneself verbally and in writing in Swedish and English is a requirement. As networking is an important part of the work, a driver's license is a requirement.  For us, personal suitability is crucial. About us LTV Faculty - Landscape Architecture, Horticulture and Plant Production Science The center has its organizational home at the LTV Faculty. World-leading research in landscape architecture, horticultural science and plant production is conducted here. The faculty offers several educational programs, including the agriculturist program, the horticultural engineering program, and the agroecology program. The LTV faculty is mostly located in Alnarp, in the middle of Sweden's most dynamic agricultural, horticultural and food region. The position will have its operational residence at the unit for collaboration and development in Alnarp. The unit is a cooperation-supporting resource with the task of developing and supporting SLU's internal and external cooperation in order to strengthen the quality and social relevance of SLU's research, education and environmental analysis. Since the cooperation should lead to mutual benefit, the activity should also contribute to knowledge-driven development of companies and relevant organizations in society. At SLU, you take your walk-and-talk meetings and lunchtime walks in the unique Alnarpsparken. Watch the film about our campus at https://www.slu.se/alnarpsfilmen Read more about our benefits and what it's like to work at SLU at https://www.slu.se/om-slu/jobba-pa-slu/ Location: Alnarp Form of employment: Permanent employment. SLU applies 6 month trial employment Scope: 100% or according to agreement Access: According to agreement Application: Welcome with your application via the application button below no later than 2024-10-31. Union contact persons: https://internt.slu.se/min-anstallning/facket/kontaktpersons/ The Swedish University of Agriculture (SLU) has a key role in the development of sustainable living, founded in science and education. Through our focus on the interplay between humans, animals and ecosystems and a responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable social development and good living conditions on our planet. The main locations are Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, but operations are also carried out at research stations, experimental parks and educational locations throughout the country. SLU has just over 3,000 employees, 5,000 students and research students and a turnover of over three billion kroner. The university invests in attractive environments on its campus areas. We work for an equal and inclusive work environment where open conversations between people with different experiences lay the foundation for science, creativity and development. We therefore welcome people with different backgrounds and perspectives to apply for the current position.

cypher_result.j.title: Chef till funktionen Jordbrukarstöd
cypher_result.j.description: The County Administrative Board's approximately 300 employees work as the government's representative at regional level. Our mission is to develop the county and work to ensure that the national political goals have an impact in the county. We work to be an authority free from discrimination and want to safeguard the qualities that diversity adds the business. The country countryside unit is one of the County Administrative Board's seven units with approximately 40 employees. The unit is responsible for project and investment support, animal and area-based support, advice and courses for agricultural companies, supervision in agriculture, register checks on animals, land acquisition permits for agricultural and forestry properties and monitoring of basic payment services. Within the unit there is also Interreg Sweden the Norway program for which the County Administrative Board of Jämtland County is the managing authority. The unit has overall responsibility for rural issues and is responsible for agricultural and rural focus in the cross-sectoral cooperation on the county administrative board. With us, experts work in these areas who are happy to share their knowledge. We work with respect, professionalism and openness to the county's residents - together for a sustainable future! Descriptions The newly formed function of agricultural support we are now looking for a manager. The function consists of between 10 -15 Employees depending on the season and work mainly with handling and control of animal and area-based support for agriculture, register checks on animals and land acquisition permits for agricultural and forestry properties. The function also participates in cross -sectoral collaborations on the county administrative board and acts as experts when answering referrals and when preparing various issues linked to the county's agriculture. Work tasks as a function manager will be your role to lead the work based on our assignment and in accordance with the county administrative board's overall priorities. In daily work, you are a present manager who practices a trust -based leadership to create a good workplace for your employees and colleagues. You have target and results responsibility for the function and work closely with the unit manager and deputy unit manager on issues related to financial follow-up and strategic planning. You are part of the unit's management team and together with other managers take overall responsibility for the unit's operations and development. Collaborations with other function managers on the county administrative board and in cross -sectoral working groups are a natural part of your work. In addition to your managerial assignment you will also work with other tasks that are included in the operation of the function or unit. Depending on your background and competence, the data may vary but will constitute approximately 50% of your working hours. Qualification you have college education in an area relevant to the service, for example as an agronomist or surveyor or other education that the employer considers equivalent. You have experience of personnel management and being manager and leader and are confident in that role. Furthermore, you have knowledge and experience of issues related to agriculture and food production and a good understanding of the conditions that apply to Swedish agriculture. If you have experience in support management or work at the authority, it is a merit. You are a responsive manager who is good at listening and who can create commitment to your employees. You communicate and handle any conflicts in a constructive way, are loyal to your mission and have a positive attitude towards your work.  You can weigh complex information and show judgment in statements, actions and decisions. The work requires that you are structured and can plan, organize and prioritize in an appropriate way, you set up and keep time frames for your work. In order to succeed in the role, it is important to be able to collaborate with both people on the unit and other units and to be able to see whole and take into account a larger perspective. We offer you meaningful work with varied tasks. You will make a difference for our county and society. The County Administrative Board is a broad authority, which means that you are constantly being given the opportunity to develop and learn new things. This applies in several policy areas. As an employer, we have a great focus on good employment conditions, active work environment work and health promotion wellness activities. We care about collaboration with our trade union parties and can offer distance work. Depending on service, it may include service in crisis staff and security rating. We usually start with probationary employment at permanent services.information on how we process your personal data can be found at www.lansstyrelsen.se/datasktkt

Position during hours day plus on-call duty one week out of 7. Position also open to candidates with disabilities.

cypher_result.j.description: We are looking for you with great interest in plant cultivation and future agriculture and who want to work in an engaging team with high tempo and many laughs. Welcome to us at the Housekeeping Society Skåne! The Housekeeping Society Skåne has been involved in the development of Sweden's agriculture for 200 years, which makes us a safe and stable employer with a lot of knowledge. We are the support of the farmers and conduct a very reputable field trial operation with about 450 attempts a year, where quality and development are guiding stars. If the service Housekeeping Society Skåne's focus is to carry out plant cultivation attempts with high scientific quality with modern equipment in all conceivable crops to benefit and profitability for Swedish Agriculture. With us you thus get an exciting role where the starting point in your work is to strive for quality and efficiency at all levels. We carry out field trials in, among other things, variety tasting, plant protection, weed control, plant nutrients, tillage and more.
