cypher_result.j.title: Försöksassistent
cypher_result.j.description: Department of Land and Environment Do you want to be part of the search for knowledge about how we produce food in the best sustainable way, with minimized negative environmental impact? Do you want varied work in an agricultural environment? Before 2025, we have several new exciting attempts where we need the help of interested seasonal staff. We have the greatest need during the period April-September. If you can only work part of this period, you are still welcome to apply. About the job The tasks are above all to help with tasks that occur in our plant cultivation experiments, such as weighing seed and fertilizer, measuring experimental areas, carrying out various agricultural measures, carrying out soil sampling and crop, i.a. frequent measurements of gas emissions. There is also some work with sample handling, packaging of samples and maintenance of equipment. During intensive periods in crop cultivation, some evening work may be relevant. Your background We are looking for you who are interested in experimental activities in agricultural crop cultivation and who preferably have some form of education in agriculture. Experience of driving tractors, agricultural implements, drones and various measuring equipment is advantageous. The work requires accuracy and the ability to understand both oral and written instructions in Swedish. B driving license is a requirement. In the selection, great importance was attached to the applicant's personal suitability. About usLanna research station outside Skara conducts field experiments for researchers within SLU and for other actors. The business has a strong focus on precision farming, plant nutrition and stable manure and has many long-term trials. Here there are unique facilities for measuring leaching and climate gases and several newly purchased special machines for advanced plant cultivation trials.  Within the trial operations at Lanna, two people work full-time and 1-2 seasonal employees with the field operations. There is also a part-time research leader and a couple of employees in agricultural operations. The Lanna research station is part of the Department of Soil and Environment, which is a leading soil science center, both nationally and internationally. We research the properties and basic functions of the soil, as well as study how environmental and climate changes affect the soil. Through research, environmental analysis and education, we contribute knowledge about future sustainable land use and develop new solutions as a basis for decisions in agriculture and forestry, as well as urban environments. The work environment at the department is international and we have approx. 100 employees. We form part of SLU's Land, Water and Environment Center (MVM center), with close contacts to environmental analysis and research on e.g. water, cycle and bioenergy. The business contributes to meeting national environmental and climate goals and the UN's global sustainability goals. The department is located at Campus Ultuna in Uppsala and at Skara. Read more about the department here (https://www.slu.se/mark). Read more about our benefits and what it's like to work at SLU at https://www.slu.se/om-slu/jobba-pa -slu/Location: Lanna, trial cultivation outside Lidköping Form of employment: Temporary employment approx. 6 months Scope: 60% - 100% Access: 2025-04-01 or according to agreement. Application: Welcome with your application via the application button below no later than 2025-01-31. Union contact persons: https://internt.slu.se/min-anstallning/facket/kontaktpersons/Sveriges lantbruksuniversitet (SLU) has a key role in the development of sustainable living, founded in science and education. Through our focus on the interplay between humans, animals and ecosystems and a responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable social development and good living conditions on our planet. The main locations are Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, but operations are also carried out at research stations, experimental parks and educational locations throughout the country. SLU has roughly 3,000 employees, 5,000 students and research students and a turnover of over three billion kroner. The university invests in attractive environments on its campus areas. We work for an equal and inclusive work environment where open conversations between people with different experiences lay the foundation for science, creativity and development. We therefore welcome people with different backgrounds and perspectives to apply for the current position.

cypher_result.j.title: Försökstekniker
cypher_result.j.description: The Department of Plant Production Ecology We are looking for an experimental technician for Röbäcksdalen's field research station, Umeå. Do you want to contribute to the development of Swedish agriculture by participating and testing agricultural issues in field experiments? Do you enjoy solving problems and are you service oriented? Then this position at SLU in Umeå could be something for you. We are now looking for an employee who can contribute to continued development and management of the business. Together with colleagues, you will carry out research-oriented special trials, testing of new breeding material of forage crops, straw grain and potatoes as well as long-range cultivation system, fertility and tillage trials. All this is carried out under field conditions within both conventional and organic cultivation systems. About the job The main work task will consist of the establishment and maintenance and harvesting of field trials in the field of crop cultivation, but participation in departmental joint activities and assisting and supervising temporary field staff are examples of other tasks that may occur .During the crop growing season, the work mainly takes place in the field. The tasks then mainly include planning and implementation of practical steps linked to the experiments. Important work steps are then tillage, sowing, crop protection measures and harvesting, but the work also consists of weighing seed and fertilizer, simpler measurements in the field, grading and sampling of soil and plant material. Between the growing seasons, we work at the experimental station mainly with result processing, follow-up and documentation of trials, planning for the coming season, technical maintenance of machines, development of trial methodology and planning of future trials together with researchers and other trial orderers. The work is teamwork, where responsibility is distributed within the group, and where communication and cooperation are crucial for a successful result. Please note that due to the relatively short growing season, the work is intensive, occasionally physically demanding and irregular working hours and overtime work occur during the growing season. Your background We are looking for you who:• is interested in research and development• appreciates collaborating with researchers and companies• is technically interested and who easily adopts new technology• wants to work practically on a agriculturally oriented experimental station• enjoys working outdoors• can work independently• is meticulous It is required that you:• be educated in the field of agriculture (agricultural high school or agrotechnician, land surveyor or agronomist training or equivalent)• have good computer skills• command spoken and written Swedish and can communicate in English• holds a B driving license It is advantageous if you have practical agricultural experience in crop cultivation or hold authorization to use plant protection products (class 1L-2L).We will attach great importance to your personal qualities, such as cooperativeness, accuracy and independence.About usThe Department of Plant Production Ecology contributes to solutions through research, collaboration and education about sustainable plant production. We train and research plants for food, feed and energy. The research examines how different production methods, cultivation environments and systems affect yields and other ecosystem services, as well as product quality and the surrounding environment. The department has operations in both Uppsala and Umeå and is also responsible for the Lövsta and Röbäcksdalen field stations. Röbäcksdalen is a research center close to the city that is a unique environment for applied research in environmental, ecological and agricultural sciences. cypher_result.j.title: Försökstekniker till Borgeby/Helgegården
cypher_result.j.description: We are looking for you with a great interest in the future of agriculture and who wants to work in an engaging team with a fast pace and lots of laughs. With us, you are offered an exciting opportunity to get a developing job in Swedish horticulture with an employer with long experience and a lot of knowledge. Welcome to us at Hushållningssällskapet Skåne!Hushållningssällskapet Skåne has for 200 years been involved in the development of Sweden's agriculture, which makes us a safe and stable employer with a lot of knowledge. We are the farmers' support and run a very reputable field trial operation with approx. 450 trials a year, where quality and development are guiding stars. About the service The Skåne Farming Society's focus is to carry out crop cultivation trials of high scientific quality with modern equipment in all imaginable crops for the benefit and profitability of Swedish Agriculture. As a test technician with us, you will thus get an exciting role where the starting point of your work is to strive for quality and efficiency at all levels. It is varied work where every day is unique and the challenges are many. We carry out field trials in areas such as variety testing, plant protection, weed control, plant nutrition, tillage and more. You will be part of a team of trial technicians who work closely together. We offer you stimulating and fun work with varying tasks throughout the year depending on the season. With us, you also get the opportunity to participate in developing the agriculture of the future! About you In order to succeed and thrive with us, you have an agricultural education or work experience in crop cultivation. B driving license is a requirement for the position, BE is desirable. We are looking for someone who has good knowledge of driving agricultural machinery and you should have a sprayer certificate. We are also looking for someone who has knowledge of pests and diseases in crop cultivation. As a person, you have a great interest in crop cultivation/agriculture. You are meticulous, committed and quality conscious. You have the ability and enjoy working both independently and together with others. Of course you are driven and like challenges. Location: Borgeby or Helgegården. The position begins as a trial employment for 6 months Questions about the position? Feel free to call us and we will tell you more. Ulrika Dyrlund Martinsson, head of field trials 010-4762031, ulrika.dyrlundmartinsson@hushallningssallskapet.se Andreas Andersson, field trial leader, 010-4762054, andreas.andersson@hushallningssallskapet.se Johan Meyer, field trial leader, 010-4762038, johan.meyer@hushallningssallskapet.seDoes that sound interesting? Submit your application today as selection takes place continuously. Welcome with your application!RequirementsAgricultural education or work experience in crop cultivationB driver's license Meritorious BE driver's license Spraying certificateKnowledge of pests and diseases in crop cultivationExperience in machine serviceGood knowledge of driving agricultural machineryAbout the employer - Husthalningsällskapet SkåneHushållningsällskapet is part of Sweden's history. The history stretches all the way back to 1791, when the country's first Household Society was established on Gotland. When we arrived over two hundred years ago, it was in a different Sweden, where agriculture formed the basis for the entire nation's prosperity. Back then, when famine was a reality in many Swedish households, new knowledge was needed for a more rational food production. Today, we continue to be an important actor that develops the green business life and to manage the earth's resources. Today, the Housekeeping Society consists of 15 independent societies that operate all over the country (the Housekeeping Society in Skåne is one of these). Just over 700 employees deal with advice, training, research and field trials and we have approx. 30,000 members. Our customers are in agriculture, forestry, public activities and other industries, mainly in rural areas. Together, we offer knowledge for the country's future. Please read more about us at https://hushallningssallskapet.se/

cypher_result.j.description: About the company Roslätt farm, with a long history, is located in a very attractive landscape with meadows, forest groves and coastal forests down towards Yddingesjön in the east. The family farm is located in beautiful natural surroundings, where we run a versatile business with a focus on sustainability and tradition. We are now looking for an independent and responsible farm manager who wants to live on the farm and be an important part of our team in an inspiring and varied work environment. We offer good working conditions and a stable and long-term job. Your duties As farm manager you will have overall responsibility for the daily operation and maintenance of the farm. You will be the one who makes sure that everything from buildings and land to gardens, crops and deer fences are looked after in the best way. You will have varied and independent work, where you both plan and carry out tasks. You cooperate with other staff on the farm.- Daily supervision of buildings, machines, land and gardens.- Responsible for gardening, crops and deer fences depending on the season.- Carry out simple repairs on buildings, machines and equipment.- Manage certain purchases.- On on the farm there is a straw boiler that requires some supervision. - Be available for urgent matters and problems that may arise. Your background/Your characteristics We are looking for you who want to live in the country and live life in in nature! You have experience in farm work, agriculture or similar tasks. Are handy and self-motivated and have good knowledge of maintenance of buildings and machines. It is important that you are flexible and prepared to take overall responsibility for the management of the farm. You will thrive best if you are responsible, solution-oriented and confident in organizing your work. Meriting is if you have a hunting degree and chainsaw training. Information and contact Living on the farm This position includes living on the farm, which gives you the opportunity to quickly get to duties and be available when needed. We offer well-equipped accommodation, 6 rooms and kitchen, which is close to the work area. Here you have the opportunity to enjoy both nature and work without having to travel far. Rent according to agreement, where the accommodation is part of the package as Farm Manager. Car and fuel are included in the service. Farming and hunting are leased out. An external actor is responsible for the farm's forestry. If you have questions about the position or accommodation, please contact Lisbeth Ahlkvist, 046-5408592. We are deeply convinced that local anchoring, long-term customer relations and competent employees are the key to successful collaborations in the recruitment and staffing industry. With a presence in 14 locations in Sweden, a turnover of around SEK 400 million and around 800 dedicated employees, we strive to be a reliable partner. Read more at www.wikan.se

cypher_result.j.title: Jordbruksverket söker säsongsanställda till växtskyddscentralerna!
cypher_result.j.description: The Swedish Agency for Agriculture exists to promote increased and sustainable food production and good animal welfare throughout Sweden. We contribute to a living countryside. About 1,850 people work with us. The head office is in Jönköping, but we also have large regional operations. We work actively to ensure that our employees are sustainable and happy at work! We invest long-term in our employees and want them to develop together with us! We offer a good working environment with generous benefits with up to 35 vacation days, wellness allowance and wellness time. In a large part of our employment, we offer flexible working hours, the opportunity to work mobile and work part of the working time remotely. Read more about what it's like to work at the Swedish Agricultural Agency on our website: www.jordbruksverket.se/jobbahosossARBETSUPPGIFTERNu we are looking for you who want to combine your interest in plant protection with an educational and fun job during the spring and summer semesters!The work at the plant protection centers mainly involves recurring gradations of plant pests in fields during the season, which is part of our forecasting and warning activities. The work may also include various sampling and inventories in the field for specific pests and resistance surveys. In the office and lab, you will work with compilation of results and disease and insect diagnostics. You may also have the opportunity to participate in field walks and information meetings for advisors and farmers. The agricultural crops we work with are straw, oilseeds, legumes, potatoes, corn and sugar beet. In fruit and berries, we focus mostly on apples and strawberries, and for outdoor vegetables we are mostly out in the largest crop groups; cabbage, carrots and onions. The plant protection centers are located in different parts of the country and are part of the advisory unit's work. We are looking for seasonal employees for the offices in Kalmar, Skara, Linköping, Uppsala and Landskrona. The work within Greppa Näringen mainly involves measuring nitrogen uptake in fields in southern Sweden and calculations and compilation of results. The goal is to provide a decision-making basis for adapted fertilization. Here is our need for the 2025 season: Plant Protection Center Landskrona, agriculture1-2 people, approximately 1 April to 31 October, full-time1-2 people, approximately 1 June to 31 August, full-time Plant Protection Center Landskrona, garden (free-range vegetables , fruit, berries)1 person, approximately April 1 to September 30, full-time1 person, approximately June 1 to August 31, full-time Plant Protection Center Kalmar, agriculture1 person, approximately April 1 to October 31, full-time1 person, approximately June 1 to August 31, full-time Plant Protection Center Skara, agriculture1 person, approximately May 1 to August 15, full-time1 person, approximately June 1 to August 15, full-time Plant Protection Center Linköping, agriculture1-2 people, approximately April 1 to October 15, full-time Plant Protection Center Uppsala, agriculture1 person, approx. 1 March to 30 September, full-time1 person, approx. 1 May to 15 August, full-timeGreppa Näringen, Landskrona1 person, approx. 1 April to 18 June, 50% Please read more about the plant protection centers at www.jordbruksverket.se/ plants/cultivation/plant protection/currently from the plant protection centers. QUALIFICATIONSWe are looking for you who have work experience connected to agriculture or the green sector, mainly in crop cultivation or professional horticulture. You get to the fields by car, therefore a B driver's license is a requirement. The work requires that you can understand and express yourself well in spoken and written Swedish. It is advantageous if you attend or have completed a post-secondary green education, which we judge to be relevant, or if you have previous experience from having worked at a plant protection centre. We also see it as meritorious if you have knowledge of diseases and plant pests under Nordic conditions and experience monitoring these in the field. You are a structured person who takes responsibility for your task and completes what you start. You are flexible and collaborative, and adapt to find win-win solutions for the whole team. Welcome with your application. Preferably as soon as possible because we interview and make the selection continuously! However, final information will be given after the application period has expired. OTHER Locations are Landskrona, Kalmar, Skara, Linköping and Uppsala. When you register your application, you will have to answer a number of questions. cypher_result.j.title: Lantbrukare med huvudansvar för jordbruk och djurhållning
cypher_result.j.description: Tasks: We now need to supplement the workforce with you who want to contribute to the development of the cultural reserve Stensjö village. It is a unique opportunity to, together with colleagues on site and with the support of management advice and external expertise, participate in the development work and work towards the cultural-historical target image. During the changes of the seasons, you will contribute to recreating the experience of old-time small farms in the Småland forest region. The position involves primary responsibility for agriculture and animal husbandry in a landscape characterized by natural grazing, mowing fields, small fields and large forest areas. All cultivation is organic. You must be prepared to take on managerial responsibilities. The permanent staff at the farm consists of four people with different areas of responsibility (agriculture, forestry, garden, landscape), one of whom is site manager with overall responsibility for the property. During the growing season, the workforce is supplemented by one to two seasonal workers. The animal supervision on the weekends rotates between the staff so that work takes place according to schedule every third to fourth weekend. Common, ongoing work tasks consist of all tasks occurring within a farm with an ecological orientation and a focus on cultural-historical landscape care. An important task is to continuously document the work that is done. Passing on knowledge of the uniqueness of Stensjö village to visitors and groups is also part of the work. Participation in management councils and ongoing contacts with the County Administrative Board regarding issues relating to the cultural reserve are included, as well as administrative work and authority contacts related to the duties, such as EU and other applications, reporting and registration. Programs used at Stensjö include Dataväxt, Växa Sverige, CDB, Elitlamm etc. About Stensjö village Stensjö village comprises 576 hectares of which 14 hectares are arable, 81 hectares of pasture, 417 hectares of forest and 44 hectares of impediment. The large contiguous areas with natural pastures are distinctive for Stensjö village. A typical feature is the kilometre-long hedgerows that enclose holdings, pastures and cattle lanes. Small fields, mowing fields, pastures and open fields with forest grazing characterize the landscape. The village's great importance lies in the fact that houses and property form a unit that is original. Residential houses and outbuildings, a total of about 50 in number, are gathered in a cluster village, which was common in many places in Småland before legal transfer was carried out in the 19th century. In the village there are about fifteen cows and a bull of the red kulla breed as well as about 30 Helsingo sheep, some pigs and chickens. During the summer months, hired cows walk in the forest pastures. The field cultivation consists of paddy, potatoes and cultivated crops, mainly older cereals but also flax. The land has been cultivated organically since the Vitterhetsakademien took over the property in the 1960s. Since 2020, Stensjö village is a cultural reserve. The management plan aims to show Stensjö as it looked at the turn of the century in 1900. The land types that existed at that time should be well represented in the form of pastures, fodder dikes, gardens, ancient fields with cereal crops, natural hay fields and forest pastures. Long-term work is underway where the management plan is the guiding principle with the aim of recreating an older land use. Stensjö village is to be developed into a knowledge and development center for historic landscape use. The management plan can be found on the website under the Management plan and documents tab. To support the work, there is a management council that meets at Stensjö twice a year. The maintenance council consists of 5-7 people with experience in practical landscape and garden maintenance and building maintenance, as well as representatives for research in relevant areas. Administrative support such as finance, communication etc. can be found at the Vitterhetsakademien's office in Stockholm. Qualifications Requirements for the position You must have documented, solid experience in crop cultivation and animal husbandry Ability to work both independently and together with others Good verbal and written communication skills in Swedish Experience in administration and authority contacts regarding farm support, animal husbandry, EU applications etc. Driving license BMeritandEducation in agriculture and animal husbandryEducation/experience in organic farming with crop rotations Experience of work management Education/experience of: Landscape care with a cultural-historical focus, scythes Work with horses Forestry with clear cutting methods Machine maintenance Building care/property care with an antiquarian focus Experience of museum operations and outward-looking, public activities Basic interest and knowledge of small farms; nature, history and culture, and preferably more specifically about Småland's conditions Driving license BEChainsaw driving license A and BHunting licensePersonal characteristicsWe attach great importance to personal suitability. You can work independently and intensively when required, but also be a good colleague and partner with Stensjö's best interests at heart in all internal and external contexts. You have a great sense of responsibility and can flexibly change between the various tasks. Employment and other information about the work The position is a permanent, full-time position that begins with a six-month probationary period. The work involves scheduled working hours, which includes work on evenings, weekends and public holidays. The academy applies individual salary setting. The workplace is Stensjö village, 10 km north of Oskarshamn. There is an opportunity to live in Stensjö village. The Vitterhetsakademien's office is in Stockholm. Support functions such as finances, administration, communication, IT support, archives, etc. is there. The property manager, who is the immediate manager, has his main place of work in Stockholm but is on site in Stensjö village several times a year. In between, meetings and contact take place via Teams and telephone. Collaboration and meetings with colleagues at the other cultural properties take place regularly, including in connection with joint property meetings twice a year. The members of the Vitterhetsakademie have a great interest in the cultural properties and many regularly visit Stensjö village. There is guest accommodation for them at each cultural property, which enables overnight stays.

cypher_result.j.title: Operations manager SLU Lanna Property

We are looking for you who have a great interest in plant cultivation and want to contribute to SLU's promise of science and education for sustainable living. About the job You are offered varied work with great personal responsibility and many exciting development opportunities both within SLU and in the industry. As operations manager, you are responsible for the property's operations, which start from the Lanna research station west of Skara. You lead the day-to-day work and are active in the field yourself. You are also driving the strategic work on the property and have budget responsibility. As operations manager, you have many contacts within the university, with landowners, various authorities and the public. Together with the operations managers on the other properties and the agricultural manager, you also develop SLU's agricultural operations. Your background We are looking for you who want to drive and develop agricultural enterprises. You have higher education in the field of agriculture, or have acquired equivalent knowledge through experience. You are experienced and knowledgeable when it comes to crop cultivation, operational economics, machinery and maintenance. You are interested in agricultural data and technology development, and are used to working with planning and follow-up tools for plant cultivation. Knowledge of forestry is an advantage and we would like you to have chainsaw driver's license A & B. You enjoy the role of planning and leading the work and developing the work team. You are a good communicator and have the ability to create trust, collaborate and develop relationships with others, both in Swedish and English. We would like to see that you have an interest in sustainability issues in agriculture. You have a B driving license and authorization for plant protection 1L-2L. About us The Lanna property comprises approximately 310 ha of conventional crop cultivation distributed over Lanna, Brogården and Götala in Lidköping and Skara municipalities. Crop cultivation produces cereals, sorghum and oilseeds sales and roughage to the Götala research center. The business is based in Lanna, but also has staff quarters and a workshop in Götala, where SLU also uses approx. 170 ha of forest under the auspices of the property. In addition to this, the property is responsible for certain maintenance of green areas for SLU Skara. In addition to the operations manager, two machine operators also work on the Lanna property. The Lanna property belongs to SLU's agricultural operation, which has a total of 11 employees on SLU's four properties Ultuna, Alnarp, Lanna (Skara) and Hallfreda (Gotland). The agricultural operation's mission is to cultivate and manage some of SLU's main research and teaching resources: the earth, the forest and its data. All employees are offered a security package including wellness compensation. Through our focus on the interplay between humans, animals and ecosystems and a responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable social development and good living conditions on our planet. The main locations are Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, but operations are also carried out at research stations, experimental parks and educational locations throughout the country. SLU has roughly 3,000 employees, 5,000 students and PhD students and a turnover of over three billion kroner. The university invests in attractive environments on its campus areas. cypher_result.j.title: PhD Student in Plant Genetics and Breeding
cypher_result.j.description: Department of Plant BreedingThe Department of Plant Breeding focuses on research, education, and innovation that are strategically critical to society's long-term supply of food, industrial raw materials, and energy. We contribute to the efficient and sustainable production of food, feed, and industrial products through our state-of-the-art research targeting plants. our goal is to meet the increasing demands for these resources while making plant production increasingly environmentally friendly and energy efficient. Through our concerted efforts, we expand knowledge that contributes to sustainable societal development. In collaboration with growers and industries involved in crop cultivation, we are actively shaping what will be served on consumer plates in the future. Our department has grown numerically in recent years, with international employees and PhD students accounting for a highly significant proportion. Research activities at the department include population genetics of various crop species, development of omics-based breeding tools, marker-aided selection, genomic prediction, and crossbreeding for crop improvement.More information about the department can be found here:https://www.slu.se/en/departments/plant-breeding/Read more about our benefits and what it is like to work at SLU at https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/Name of research project/thesis: Population genetics, comparative genomics, marker-trait association analysis and development of speed breeding methods to improve yield and quality in red clover.Research subject: Agricultural Science Description:Currently, the Department is conducting several research projects on crops that have a significant impact on Swedish agriculture. A number of these projects are funded by SLU GroGrund - the Swedish Centre for Breeding of Food Crops: https://www.slu.se/en/Collaborative-Centres-and-Projects/grogrund/One of these projects is "Building Efficient Breeding Programs in Forages: BreedForage". Red clover, the most important forage legume crop in Sweden, is one of the target crops of this project. Currently, the Department is seeking a PhD student to join the research team in this project, which focuses on red clover forage yields and forage quality.The PhD student who will hold this position will be actively engaged in various project activities including•  Crossbreeding•  Phenotyping•  Comparative genomics and allele mining,•  Population genetics and marker-trait association analyses•  Genomic prediction•  Protocol development for speed breeding.•  The PhD student will conduct various hands-on activities in the laboratory, greenhouse, and field.Qualifications:We seek a highly motivated candidate with a master's degree in plant genetics and breeding, plant biology, or a related field. The candidate should have•  Adequate knowledge of conventional and genomics-driven plant breeding methods, genomics, and molecular markers.•  A well-developed understanding and skills in various statistical software applications, including R •  Experience working with plants under field and greenhouse conditions is required•  Experience in bioinformatics and quantitative genetics analysis is an advantage.•  research experience with red clover or other legume species is favourable.The PhD students will work with researchers from different departments at SLU as well as industrial partners, which makes the ability to collaborate essential. Hence, it is of great importance that the candidate has effective communication and collaboration skills.The ability to write and communicate effectively in English is a prerequisite while communicating in Scandinavian languages is an advantage.Applicants should demonstrate a high level of scientific curiosity and possess favorable personal characters.Place of work: AlnarpForms for funding or employment:Employment (4 years)Starting date:July 1st, 2025 or according to agreementApplication:Click the "Apply" button to submit your application. The deadline is 2025-03-15.To qualify for third-cycle (Doctoral) courses and study programmes, you must have a second-cycle (Master's) qualification. Alternatively, you must have conducted a minimum of four years of full-time study, of which a minimum of one year at second-cycle level.Applicants will be selected based on their written application and CV, degree project, copies of their degree certificate and transcript of records from previous first and second-cycle studies at a university or higher education institution, two personal references, and knowledge of English. More information about the English language requirements can be found here: https://www.slu.se/en/education/programmes-courses/doctoral-studies/application-admission-doctoral-studies/Please note that applicants invited to interview must submit attested copies of their degree certificate, or equivalent, a transcript of records from previous first and second-cycle studies at a university or higher education institution. Applicants who are not Swedish citizens need to submit an attested copy of their passport's information page containing their photograph and personal details.Read about the PhD education at SLU at www.slu.se/en/education/programmes-courses/doctoral-studies/Academic union representatives:https://internt.slu.se/en/my-employment/employee-associations/kontaktpersoner-vid-rekrytering/The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and the responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable societal development and good living conditions on our planet. Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden.SLU has around 3,000 employees, 5,000 students and doctoral students and a turnover of over SEK 3 billion. Our most important goal is to reduce recidivism - to break the vicious cycle. If we succeed in that, society will be safer and more secure for everyone. We are the authority responsible for prisons, probation, custody and client transport. Do you want to know more? Hear what our employees think about working within the Correctional Service: https://www.kriminalvarden.se/jobba-hos-oss/We are now looking for a new colleague for Svartsjö agriculture, which belongs to the Stockholm West business area, located in Ekerö municipality. It is possible to get to work via both the south and west side of Stockholm. About 170 employees and ten managers manage, lead and develop the business, which receives approx. 270 inmates. Agriculture is part of the clients' daily occupation during its execution. The farm covers 400 hectares, of which 310 hectares are arable land and 90 hectares are pasture. Farming includes 250 hectares of grain and 60 hectares of paddy, as well as fodder crops such as wheat, oats, peas, broad beans and canola.  The farm has a breeding herd of the Hereford breed. We get around 75 calves per season and have around 160 animals in total. The machinery park is modern with GPS technology and a workshop for service. The business also includes firewood production, vegetable growing, green area maintenance and carpentry. There are well-equipped staff areas with gyms and charging stations. This entity supports breeders and the progression of human food and follows a constant logic of performance and innovation. To guarantee the replacement of one of their employees, it is looking for a Quality Facilitator (fresh workshop and vegetable processing) on ​​a fixed-term contract, position in Lamballe. Are you looking for a fixed-term job opportunity within a company belonging to an agricultural group (animal nutrition, vegetable processing and packaging)? Then this Quality Facilitator position may interest you.Reporting to the QHSE Manager of the Food Division and in collaboration with the QHSE team, you are responsible for field quality monitoring of the fresh potato activity.Your missions consist of: Controlling and ensure the quality of products (particularly in terms of health) and hygiene-related services, Manage complaints and listen to customers, Contribute to updating and monitoring the HACCP system and the single document (DU),Be a driving force in achieving QHSE objectives,Implement control plans,Research the causes and implement and monitor corrective and preventive actions,Provide internal training (reception, HACCP, etc.),Ensure the field application of good QHSE practices by all teams, Monitoring quality records and traceability data, Reporting on your activity using indicators and dashboards. Minimum Bac +2 training in QHSE areas in the industrial sector, you ideally have at least a first experience in a similar position in an agri-food environment. You have a good command of quality standards and are comfortable with IT tools. Field profile, you are rigorous, pragmatic and proactive. You have excellent interpersonal skills and appreciate teamwork. Position also open to candidates with disabilities.

cypher_result.j.title: Researchers in ecosystem services in strip cultivation
cypher_result.j.description: The Department of Bio Systems and Technology Som Jobs It is important to reduce the unilateral cultivation of a few crops in large fields, and instead increase the diversity of crops to benefit biodiversity and increase ecosystem services such as biological control. In addition, a greater variety of cultivated crops is promising to increase the return and/or reduce the dependence on pesticides. In this project we will assess whether strip cultivation, where two or more crops are grown next to each other in strips adapted to the width of modern sowing machines, can strengthen biological control, reduce the use of pesticides and maintain harvests compared to when each crop is grown alone on the field. In addition, we will validate the experiment with trials on farms, where farmers themselves decide the management. We are looking for a motivated person with a few years of experience as a researcher and with the ambition of an academic career, who also has a great interest in developing knowledge about the effect of the strip cultivation on biological Control of pests and the return on economically important agricultural crops. The candidate is expected to investigate what potential strip cultivation in practically applicable care has to mitigate the harvest loss of the pest. This means, among other things, planning a cultivation attempt at the university's experimental station, field work, collaboration with Swedish and international partners and to investigate agricultural acceptance of innovative cultivation systems such as strip cultivation. We attach great importance to personal fitness and are looking for you who have good cooperative ability but also be able to work independently. You are looking for you who have: • Doctorate in biology with a focus on insect ecology and their ecosystem services in diversified cultivation systems, or equivalent • demonstrated research experience in the subjects insect pollination and biological control of pests, insect diversity in legumes and rapeseed and effects of co -cultivation • High skills in statistical processing and handling of ecological data • showed ability to publish research results in international scientifically examined magazines • Excellent knowledge in written and oral communication in English and oral Communication in Swedish • Effective communication skills, a strong work ethic and shown experience in collaborating with stakeholders outside the academy • Granted applications with the Research Council are qualified if you also have: • Experience in international collaborations • Experience in project planning, field work and project management • Experience in supervision T .ex. Students' degree projecting Oss research at the Department of Bio Systems and Technology explores the interaction between land, plants, animals, environment, climate and people in systems for sustainable production of food and renewable raw materials. The department has a broad expertise in agricultural and horticultural science and delivers research-based knowledge in teaching and through active collaboration and dense dialogue with stakeholders. We are currently about 60 employees including researchers, doctoral students and support staff. External web leaf more about our benefits and what it is like to work at SLU at https://www.slu.se/om-su/jobba-pa-slu/placing:alnarpansting form:Stidsvidarest position. SLU may apply probationary employment. Swap: 100%access: April 1, 2025 application: The application must be written in English and contain in) a depiction of scientific interests and justification for why this employment is sought (max one page); ii) Brief project plan (max two pages); iii) Curriculum Vitae including a full publication list, which distinguishes scientifically reviewed articles from other publications. /Contact persons/Swedish University of Agriculture (SLU) has a key role in the development of sustainable life, founded in science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and a responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable social development and good living conditions on our planet. The main places are Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, but operations are also conducted at research stations, subject parks and places of education throughout the country. The university is investing in attractive environments in its campus areas. We therefore welcome people with different backgrounds and perspectives to apply for the current employment.

cypher_result.j.title: Sales manager north, Väktodling
cypher_result.j.description: Are you passionate about Swedish agriculture, are you a good leader with a strong business sense? Do you want to work in a driving role in crop cultivation and be active in the market? Then there is the chance to become our new sales manager at Swedish Agro!WHAT WILL YOU BE A PART OF?Swedish AgroSwedish Agro is undergoing strong growth and we are now looking for a driven sales manager in the field of crop cultivation with a location in one of our locations Skänninge, Skara, Enköping or Kumla . Swedish Agro is also looking for a trained Safety Advisor, which is meritorious competence for this position. At Swedish Agro, we create value for Swedish agriculture by being a comprehensive supplier for the individual farmer and offering inputs, feed and machinery of the highest quality. We represent the industry's leading machinery brands CLAAS, HORSCH, METSJÖ, RAUCH, SPEARHEAD, SCANSTONE, AVR, AGXEED and DALBO and have one of Europe's most modern feed factories that manufacture feed for several animal species. We have a common belief that we are stronger together and work for the long term, quality and profitability. YOUR AREA OF RESPONSIBILITY As a sales manager, you run the day-to-day sales, which means that you lead and support around 10 plant cultivation salespeople in their work by being a sounding board for business decisions. The role means that you will drive sales efficiency, coach both new and experienced salespeople and manage change processes within the organization. Support for the sellers includes follow-up of key figures, development of existing staff and conducting employee interviews. In the role, you will also have product manager responsibility for mineral fertilizers within Swedish Agro, and we thus see that you are to some extent active in the market with own customer responsibility and own sales targets. You thus have your own sales responsibility and work flexibly with the opportunity to both be out in the field and work from the office. As a sales manager, you report to the Sales Manager for plant cultivation Sweden. YOUR PROFILE As a person, you are driven and interested in business towards agriculture in order to create added value together with the customer and our salespeople. Experience or training in agriculture is essential to assume the role of Sales Manager in crop cultivation at Swedish Agro. Furthermore, we see that you are thorough, responsive and structured in your way of working and have a great interest in motivating and developing others. To thrive in the role, you have a coaching and supportive leadership style where you encourage your employees to take responsibility and initiative in their roles. You are also used to effectively, clearly and transparently communicating and reporting to management. We place great emphasis on your personal qualities and driving forces. Furthermore, we see that you have: At least 3-5 years of experience in the agricultural industry Experience in sales or trade (B2B) Proven leadership skills Merit with post-secondary education focusing on agronomist/farm manager/agrotechnician or similar Merit with experience in personnel responsibility Good knowledge of Swedish both verbally and writing B driving license WE OFFER Stronger together At Swedish Agro, our foundation is based on cooperation and we have a fundamental belief that we are stronger together. We thus offer a workplace where we develop together - across departments, skills and national borders. Our employees are our most important resource and we strive to create the best conditions for well-being, commitment and influence. ARE YOU INTERESTED? How to apply If you think the position sounds exciting, please send your application today or as soon as possible by clicking on "APPLY". We expect to hold interviews continuously and may stop the search when the right candidate has been found. If you have any questions about the position, please contact Patrik Persson, Sales Manager, Swedish Agro on 072-535 30 17. AN INTERNATIONAL GROUP We want to create value! For agriculture, for the farmer and for our employees. Swedish Agro is part of the Danish Agro group, with more than 5,000 colleagues spread over 100 companies in 15 countries. From the field to the screen, our employees are at the core of our ability to create value and develop the agriculture of the future and ensure that we can play a decisive role in the industry's digital and green transition - and that we help the farmer grow world-class food every day. We do this by strengthening, growing and developing the industry - and not least each other. And we need you too! Are you more curious about the Danish Agro group? Watch our group film here!

cypher_result.j.title: Seasonal employee for organic vegetable cultivation on southern Gotland
cypher_result.j.description: For the 2025 season we are looking for a new employee. We are looking for a positive and driven seasonal employee. We think you are responsive and can work independently but at the same time work well in groups. The employment period is from April to the end of August. The service is about 75% but varies slightly over the season. We can tell you more about how we intend to put up the season if we call you interview. Work details depend on where in the season we are located, it can be everything possible from sowing and planting to weed cleaning and harvest of vegetables. We grow both outdoors and in greenhouses. Above all, you will help us in the crops in harvesting and polishing vegetables, clearing weeds, managing tomatoes in greenhouses, so and planting plants. During the summer season it can be high tempo and you need to enjoy working with the body as it is a physical job. Qualifications you should have a great interest in cultivation and vegetables. Education and/or experience in vegetable cultivation is a big plus but no requirement. We are primarily based on personal fitness and interest. If we can offer you who work with us is the opportunity to learn about a commercial vegetable cultivation of two people with broad knowledge, education and experience. We have run our business for nine years and grow more than 150 different types of vegetables organically and KRAV-certified. We are passionate about being able to grow good food that is produced with consideration. Good taste, quality and biodiversity are our key words. Our farm shop is the heart of our business. We will start to interview interviews as the applications come in and if we find the right person we can hire before the application time expires, so do not wait to submit your application. Welcome with your application! Mvh Andrea and Viktor

cypher_result.j.title: Stable technician
cypher_result.j.description: Röbäcksdalen's research barn We are a happy bunch looking for another colleague to strengthen our team. We are looking for you who are self-motivated, responsible and meticulous and want to work as a stable technician in the barn at Röbäcksdalen in Umeå. In order for you to thrive with us, it is an advantage that you have social skills and can easily work in a changing environment. As change is part of everyday life, it is important that you can look up and see the big picture. About the job We are looking for you with a great interest in animals who want to work with the usual chores in a dairy cow herd such as supervision in stables and on pasture, cleaning, registrations, administration, sampling and feeding. The daily work is interspersed with tasks linked to various research projects. The work is scheduled with weekend and standby work. There is also the opportunity for the right person to grow in the role with increased responsibility. Your background You must have practical experience as well as theoretical knowledge of milk production. We attach great importance to personal qualities such as cooperation, independence, and initiative and organizational skills. You must be interested in working with researchers and interns. B driving license is a requirement. It is advantageous if you have taken the semi-final course and/or are used to drug handling and record keeping, as well as if you have experience driving a tractor. About us SLU Röbäcksdalen runs a modern farm with milk production and crop cultivation. On the farm today there are approximately 110 dairy cows with recruitment, and the crop production consists of 250 hectares of fields where we grow fodder, grain and green fodder. Agriculture also includes experimental activities, as we are part of Sweden's University of Agriculture. But in the main, we carry out modern milk production with a high degree of automation and milking in pits managed by a team of seven employees. cypher_result.j.title: Substitute Cultivation coordinator/project manager
cypher_result.j.description: Do you want to help shape the sustainable society of the future? Södertälje municipality is looking for a creative and innovative person for the role of cultivation coordinator/cultivation project manager. The assignment is a temporary position starting no later than January 2025. Here you get the chance to influence how we protect our farmland and promote local food production, all in line with the municipality's goal of becoming climate neutral by 2030. The position is located at the park and landscape unit at the Community Planning Office. In the unit, we are a total of 14 people who work on issues related to park planning, ecosystem services, pollination, cultivation coordination and much more. We enjoy being together very well on the unit and have a kind climate where we care for each other, our differences and where we are happy to cooperate. Among your colleagues at the unit, you will find people with roles such as landscape architect, park engineer, administrator, coordinator and unit manager. We all work together towards the municipality's overall goals in ecological, social and financial sustainability. With us, you have the opportunity to contribute to a truly sustainable society. About the Service As part of the continuous work with sustainability, a municipality-wide cultivation strategy with accompanying action plan has been adopted, with the aim of showing how the municipality, based on its various roles and functions, should promote local cultivation and protect the arable land. As Cultivation Coordinator/Cultivation Project Manager, you will play a key role in implementing and following up on our cultivation strategy. You will lead projects that integrate cultivation into community planning, support professional horticulture and agriculture, and develop recreational and complementary cultivation. Your work will contribute to ensuring long-term sustainable production methods that benefit biodiversity and create sustainable cycles of nutrients and water. Your tasks will include: - Implementation of Strategy: Implement measures according to the cultivation strategy and action plan to achieve the municipality's overall goals. - Coordination: Work cross-sectorally with various committees and companies to ensure effective implementation of the strategy. - Advice and Support: Continue to develop systems for cultivation advice and grants and support professional horticulture and agriculture. - Communication: Inform and inspire citizens and stakeholders about the possibilities for local cultivation. Who are you? We are looking for you who have: - Education and/or experience in agronomy, environmental science, park planning, gardener or similar field in the green industry. - Experience in project management and cross-sector collaboration. - Ability to express yourself well in Swedish, both orally and in writing. - Good knowledge of digital tools. - B driver's license. Meritorious: - Previous work in the public sector or with sustainability issues. - Experience of strategic planning in agriculture or horticulture. - Interest in social sustainability and community development. - Experience of/knowledge of application processes for external funds and grants relevant to the service. Personal characteristics: You are structured, creative, results-oriented and have a strong ability to collaborate and find new innovative solutions. You can easily create contact with other people and are good at communicating both internally and externally. You are passionate about sustainable development and always have the citizens' best interests in mind when you take on projects. We attach great importance to your personal qualities. We offer you You will sit in our modern city hall a stone's throw from the center of Södertälje with good communication options such as buses and commuter trains and with a fantastic view of both the city and the canal. We sit in an open office landscape, but also offer the possibility of remote work for a certain part of your working time. We apply annual working hours, which means that you have a certain flexibility in how you allocate your working hours. The position is a temporary position until and including 15-01-2026. Each day passes approx 6,000 people to their jobs in Södertälje municipality. We have many different roles with us and want to offer you a meaningful job where you get the opportunity to contribute to society while feeling joy. As an employee with us, you get the opportunity to develop and make a real impression. As an employee of Södertälje municipality, you are offered, among other things, safe employment conditions, a generous wellness allowance and the opportunity to exchange the holiday allowance for extra days off. Within certain businesses, there is also the possibility of some flexibility regarding working hours and working methods. We have a large range of training and skills-enhancing efforts for you as an employee. For more detailed information about our benefits, please read more on our external website: https://www. soder waist. se/admanerWelcome to us! Other Selection and interviews will take place continuously during the application period. Södertälje municipality works with competence-based recruitment methodology with the aim of countering discrimination and promote diversity in the workplace. Employment with us can mean placement in a security class. A security check with a register check according to the Security Protection Act (2018:585) may therefore be carried out before a decision on employment. Swedish citizenship is required for some of our duties in security class. We are happy to receive calls from you who are interested in the job, but we refuse you who sell advertisements and recruitment services.

cypher_result.j.title: Syngenta Group China Scientist
cypher_result.j.description: 公司描述Syngenta Group is a global leader in agriculture; rooted in science and dedicated to bringing plat potential to life. A core player in the field of agricultural technology and life science innovation, and one of the world's largest agricultural innovation and technology companies, our products and services cover the entire chain of crop protection, seeds, crop nutrition and modern agricultural platforms. With a history dating back more than 250 years, the Group employs nearly 60,000 people worldwide and operates in more than 100 countries. We work together to solve one of humanity's most pressing challenges: growing more food with fewer resources, supporting the transformation of global agrifood systems through scientific and technological innovation, and improving crop yields and product quality. We rely on green and efficient agricultural inputs and technical solutions to promote sustainable agricultural development and benefit farmers, society and the planet. As one of the four business units of Syngenta Group, Syngenta Group China is committed to becoming the most innovative global ag tech company in China with the mission of bringing modern agriculture to more farmers and consumers. 职位描述Are you passionate about revolutionizing agriculture through cutting-edge science and technology? Syngenta Group China is seeking brilliant minds for our prestigious Scientists Program! We are recruiting high potential young talent from top universities worldwide to build a high-quality research team with strong skills. Designed with a 24-month project cycle for development, we strive to cultivate researchers with global perspectives and innovation drive, preparing expertise needed for future growth. cypher_result.j.title: Technical Sales Representative
cypher_result.j.description: Company DescriptionSyngenta Seeds is one of the world's largest developers and producers of seed for farmers, commercial growers, retailers, and small seed companies. Syngenta seeds improve the quality and yields of crops. High-quality seeds ensure better and more productive crops, which is why farmers invest in them. Advanced seeds help mitigate risks such as disease and drought and allow farmers to grow food using less land, less water, and fewer inputs. Syngenta Seeds brings farmers more vigorous, stronger, resistant plants, including innovative hybrid varieties and biotech crops that can thrive even in challenging growing conditions. Syngenta Seeds is headquartered in the United States. Our employees reflect the diversity of our customers, the markets where we operate and the communities which we serve. No matter what your position, you will have a vital role in safely feeding the world and taking care of our planet. cypher_result.j.title: Växa is looking for an Expert in sustainability
cypher_result.j.description: Väx's department for Knowledge & Development strives for a very high level of competence in the most important subject areas linked to milk and beef production. We play an important role by monitoring research results and making them available to the Swedish agricultural companies in the form of services and tools. We also carry out assignments and investigations for authorities, food companies and other actors in the food chain. Our development department also carries out its own projects, both in collaboration with researchers and more applied at the farm level. Our work contributes to the development of Swedish agriculture by providing a varied and innovative range of services that provide increased profitability and productivity, good animal health and a reduced climate footprint.Knowledge & Development is now strengthening the team for Sustainability and is looking for an expert with competence in the field, preferably with special interest in forage and crop cultivation. Our new expert will step up for colleagues in several of our ongoing projects, where we support various companies and organizations within the agricultural and food industry in their sustainability work. You will thus have a key role in ensuring our future level of competence and contribute to meeting the increased demand for specialist competence in the area of ​​sustainability. Our new expert will work together with existing colleagues to create the conditions for profitable and sustainable agriculture. In your assignment as an Expert in sustainability at Växa, you will, among other things: Initiate, lead and participate in projects, mainly in the area of ​​sustainability Collaborate with, and carry out assignments for, industrial customers, universities, authorities and industry organizations Monitor and compile research in various areas of sustainability linked to , e.g. climate impact from plant cultivation and feed supply, soil health, biological diversity and carbon storage Conduct environmental monitoring and competitive analysis Convey knowledge internally and externally Together in Växas' sustainability team develop the internal and external sustainability work Together with other departments, develop the range of services and tools As the current position is newly established, you will have great opportunities to shape the position based on your knowledge and your way of working. To fit the role, we want you to: Have an academic degree in a relevant field ; e.g. agronomist or equivalent Has at least 3 years of work experience in a relevant field Has knowledge in climate impact from agriculture, preferably with a focus on crop cultivation and/or fodder supply Has a good command of Swedish and English both verbally and in writing It is further meritorious if you: Have knowledge in soil health, carbon storage and biological diversity Has knowledge in LCA Has knowledge in climate calculations Has previous work experience from work as a consultant or equivalent Has experience of practical work on a farm with milk or beef production Have a PhD in a relevant field We attach great importance to your personal qualities such as your own drive and initiative. We believe that you find it easy to collaborate with colleagues who have many different skills and perspectives, as well as that you are development-oriented, solution-oriented and business-minded.Scope and place of placement Full-time and permanent with placement at one of Växas' operating locations. The position involves a number of travel days per year in Sweden and abroad. Salary according to agreement. For more information, please contact Head of Sustainability Malin Hidgård, malin.hidgard@vxa.se 073-073 31 27 Union contact person: Jessica Stenvall, jessica.stenvall@vxa.se 070-269 29 15 Application no later than 2024-11 -15 Interviews may take place continuously and the position may be filled before the last one application day. Welcome with your application!

cypher_result.j.title: Vi söker två agronomer eller lantmästare med jordbruksföretaget i fokus
cypher_result.j.description: The Swedish Board of Agriculture is available to promote increased and sustainable food production and good animal welfare throughout Sweden. We contribute to a living countryside. About 1850 people work with us. The head office is located in Jönköping but we also have large regional operations. We work actively to make our employees sustainable and enjoy the job! We invest long -term in our employees and want them to develop together with us! We offer a good working environment with generous benefits with up to 35 holiday days, wellness allowance and wellness time. In a large part of our employment, we offer a flexible working time, the opportunity to work mobile and work parts of the working hours at a distance. Read more about what it is like to work at the Swedish Agricultural Agency on our website: www.jordbruksverket.se/jobbahosjabräktorsverket is responsible for the official the statistics on agriculture, horticulture and for aquaculture. We are now looking for two new employees who will work on an agricultural economic survey that is currently being developed to also include environmental and social dimensions. The survey is EU regulated in Regulation (EU) 1217/2009, and is used to model, investigate and evaluate the common agricultural policy. Your work means, among other things, that you: • collect the large amount of information needed in the survey from the farmers themselves, subcontractors or from registers. • analyzes the activities of the agricultural companies from a holistic perspective to quality ensure that all tasks are reasonable and consistent • continuously develops and improves the models included in the survey to better describe the agricultural companies. • Produces statistics, feedback reports to participating companies and spreads results from the survey • Has contact with farmers, the European Commission, subcontractors, register holders and other stakeholders. It is important that you understand the farmer's conditions and have the ability to create good cooperation with the farmers who Participates in the survey. You help them receive added value from participating. The basis you process is part of a complex whole with a comprehensive formula device in several steps. You will work closely with your team of 7-8 colleagues. Qualification for this service we are looking for you who is an agronomist, preferably with a focus on business economics or pets, is a landlord or at least has a philosophy bachelor's degree combined with long experience in agricultural conditions . It is a requirement that you have good knowledge of the Office package. You have a good ability to express yourself in speech and writing in Swedish to be able to collaborate with farmers and present results in an easily understandable way. It is a merit if you have experience working with farmers in the areas of economy, technology, plant cultivation or pet management. We attach great importance to your personal abilities and are looking for you who have a genuine interest in and have a sense of numbers. cypher_result.j.title: Work with plant protection - three services in our socially important business
cypher_result.j.description: The Swedish Agency for Agriculture exists to promote increased and sustainable food production and good animal welfare throughout Sweden. We contribute to a living countryside. About 1,750 people work with us. The head office is in Jönköping, but we also have large regional operations. Read more about what it's like to work at Jordbruksverket on our website: www. the agricultural agency. se/jobbahososs As an advisor in plant protection, you will be part of the plant protection center in Skara, which is part of the environment and climate knowledge hub and works to actively influence and contribute to sustainable plant protection and a competitive, profitable and increased food production. We work in teams and help each other with the tasks that need to be carried out. The colleagues in the environment and climate knowledge hub are mainly located regionally at the Swedish Agency for Agriculture's three advisory units. This position is located at the plant protection advisory unit, which includes the plant protection centre. At the plant control unit, where the administrative positions are located, we are responsible for managing, among other things the rules for seed and against plant pests. This means everything from EU and international work, to national regulations and decisions, together with a lot of guidance, information and preparedness work. At the unit, we are 18 employees divided into two teams. We work both directly with industry players, industry organizations and in collaboration with the government office and other member states. JOB TASKS Do you have a good knowledge of the challenges of plant cultivation and want to work for robust and sustainable plant protection? Do you want to contribute to us being able to continue growing crops for feed and food in Sweden even in the event of social disturbances and in a changed climate? Then you can become one of our new colleagues! The Swedish Agency for Agriculture has an important task in both working with preventive plant protection and combating plant pests that are already present here, partly through regulations and partly through advice and skills development. We are now advertising three positions with the following tasks: 1. Advisor crop protection, agriculture - Skara• compile and convey Swedish and international experiences and results in the field of plant protection to the consultancy, • support the consultancy with increased competence through newsletters, control recommendations, courses, field trips and conferences, • follow the development of plant pests during the season within the Swedish Agency for Agriculture's forecasting activities for various pests, • increase awareness of difficult-to-control weeds and spread knowledge about sustainable cultivation systems, • be an important part of various projects within preparedness to ensure that we can maintain Swedish food production2. Plant pest manager - Jönköping/Landskrona• guide and inform about our rules against quarantine pests, • strengthen our preparedness for and manage possible outbreaks, • contribute to planning and developing our inventory of quarantine pests. Together with the colleagues at the plant regulation unit, you protect Sweden against the introduction of new plant pests. The work involves a mixture of situations that requires quick responses and planned work with processes based on scouting and reflection. 3. Manager robust crop cultivation - Jönköping• what abilities are needed to run the business, • what vulnerabilities exist and • what we need to do to increase our ability. Together with colleagues, you contribute to making our socially important business more robust with rules and guidance both on seed and combating plant pests. This is to reduce our vulnerability and strengthen our preparedness to face new as well as ongoing challenges. QUALIFICATIONSWe are looking for you who have an academic education as an agronomist, hortologist, farm manager, horticultural engineer or equivalent and a good knowledge of crop cultivation in Sweden. You need a good ability to express yourself verbally and in writing, in both Swedish and English to be successful in the role of administrator or advisor. The roles have different qualifying requirements, where the personal abilities we are looking for may differ, depending on the nature of the role and task. For advisers in crop protection, in addition to the requirements above, you need to have experience of working as a plant cultivation adviser under Nordic conditions and good knowledge of plant pests and integrated plant protection in agricultural crops. You are structured and used to planning your work, are confident in your professional role and find solutions to get ahead even in uncertain contexts. You stay up-to-date by monitoring the world around you and find it easy to put forward your case and win respect. 2. For plant pest manager, you need to be structured, analytical and communicative. cypher_result.title: Summer job 2025;     Tractor driver for Widegrens Gård on Gotland
cypher_result.description: About usWidegrens Gård on Gotland specializes in the organic cultivation of potatoes, carrots and onions with our own packing plant where we wash, sort and pack the products. In addition to this, there is also the cultivation of grain and rapeseed. Our carrot packing house is in Atlingbo and our potato and onion packing house is in Follingbo. The cultivation, which is completely organic, is spread over central Gotland. We are today 45 employees who work together all year round towards high goals. Today, 12 machine operators work in our cultivation team, led by our team leader Marcus and cultivation manager Jakob. In the summer, we are reinforced by around 180 summer workers in manual cleaning of our organic cultivations. the coffee room. We are a smoke-free company. As an employee with us, you get the work and protective clothing you need in your role with us. We have a management team that is seen continuously where we constantly try to develop and improve the company. The management team includes the following roles CEO, cultivation manager, HR manager, Team leader Sylfaste, Team leader Atlingbo, Team leader Cultivation, We ourselves would like to describe ourselves as a stable growing company where much is still undone and the opportunities are great. We are informal and straightforward with a short chain of command in a flat structure. We are aware that our employees are the most important thing we have and that it is people who build the company. Together as a team, we try to implement the goals and visions we have for the business. About the position Until the summer of 2025, we are looking for tractor drivers for summer jobs to cover vacation times for our regular staff and to catch up when the field work is most intensive. You should be very interested of crop cultivation and agricultural machinery. Inspired by the feeling of being part of a larger work team where you share challenges together, strive towards high goals without having far to laugh. The work consists of many different tasks in crop cultivation where you contribute to trying to get the crop to reach its full potential. We solve a large part of the tasks in teams, but there are also many tasks that are solved on your own when you get warm in your clothes. It is a prerequisite that you have experience of driving agricultural machinery, that you can perform them with skill without damaging either the crop, the machine or the surroundings. Your attitude and desire to develop with us is strong and the commitment to do your best is a matter of course. .The position can be filled before the application deadline.Joining date for the position by agreement based on how your conditions look like for the coming summer.Salary according to increase.For the right applicant who currently does not live on Gotland, we can actively help find accommodation through our local network, several people in our existing team have come from the mainland in recent years. The application is emailed to jobb@widegrens.se
