cypher_result.title: Tractor and machine operator for Widegrens Gård on Gotland
cypher_result.description: About usWidegrens Gård on Gotland specializes in the organic cultivation of potatoes, carrots and onions with our own packing plant where we wash, sort and pack the products. In addition to this, there is also the cultivation of grain and rapeseed. Our carrot packing house is in Atlingbo and our potato and onion packing house is in Follingbo. The cultivation, which is completely organic, is spread over central Gotland. We are today 45 employees who work together all year round towards high goals. Today, 12 machine operators work in our cultivation team, led by our team leader Marcus and cultivation manager Jakob. In the summer, we are reinforced by around 180 summer workers in manual cleaning of our organic cultivations. the coffee room. We are a smoke-free company. As an employee with us, you get the work and protective clothing you need in your role with us. We have a management team that is seen continuously where we constantly try to develop and improve the company. The management team includes the following roles CEO, cultivation manager, HR manager, Team leader Sylfaste, Team leader Atlingbo, Team leader Cultivation, We ourselves would like to describe ourselves as a stable growing company where much is still undone and the opportunities are great. We are informal and straightforward with a short chain of command in a flat structure. We are aware that our employees are the most important thing we have and that it is people who build the company. Together as a team, we try to implement the goals and visions we have for the business. You who apply to us should enjoy teamwork in a lively environment with lots of humor and laughter in a serious world between too little or too much rain at the right or wrong time. About the positionWe are now looking for new important pieces of the puzzle for our cultivation team! The team currently consists of 12 machine operators, but when this year's cultivation season is over, two valued employees in the team move on to their own businesses. It is the most common reason that people leave us, they come from agricultural school or another job and stay with us for a few years and then move on to their own business. You should be very interested in crop cultivation and agricultural machinery. Inspired by the feeling of being part of a larger work team where you share challenges together, strive towards high goals without having far to laugh. The work consists of many different tasks in crop cultivation such as, for example, rotary harrowing, sowing of root vegetables, planting potatoes and onions, stone rowing, mechanical weed control, harrowing, chopping, milling and cupping, ploughing, cultivation, sowing of cereals, harvesting of potatoes and root vegetables, transport of products from fields to our cold storage, moving and commissioning irrigation machines and much more. The growing season with us runs roughly between 1 April- 15 November and as a machine operator with us, during this period you are basically all the time in a tractor in a field to help the crops reach their full potential. At other times of the year, it is service and maintenance of the machinery in the workshop, improvements to outbuildings, trucking and transport between our various warehouses. We solve a large part of the tasks in teams, but there are also many tasks that are solved on your own when you have warmed up in the clothes. It is a prerequisite that you have experience driving agricultural machines, that you can drive them skillfully without damaging either the crop, the machine or the surroundings. Your attitude and desire to develop with us is strong and the commitment to do your part the best is a matter of course. You are welcome to describe yourself as driven, humorous, in a good mood even if you are busy and that you have your heart in the relationship with colleagues, products and partners. The position is a full-time position all year round. the application is positive. The position can be filled before the application deadline. Entry date for the position by agreement based on how your conditions look today but no later than 15 March 2025. Salary according to increase. For the right applicant who does not currently live on Gotland, we can actively help find accommodation through our local network, several people in our existing team have come from the mainland in recent years. The application is emailed to jobb@widegrens.se

cypher_result.o.label: animal behaviourist
cypher_result.o.description: Animal behaviourists work with animals and people to study, observe, assess and understand animal behaviour in relation to specific factors and to prevent or address inappropriate or problematic behaviours within individual animals through the development of suitable environments and management regimes, in accordance with national legislation.

cypher_result.o.label: animal care attendant
cypher_result.o.description: Animal care attendants provide routine care for non-production animals, which may include feeding, watering, cleaning, exercise and enrichment, grooming, training and monitoring of the health and welfare, in accordance with national legislation.

cypher_result.o.label: veterinary medicine lecturer
cypher_result.o.description: Veterinary medicine lecturers are subject professors, teachers, or lecturers, and often doctors who instruct students who have obtained an upper secondary education diploma in their own specialised field of study, veterinary medicine, which is predominantly academic in nature. They work with their university research assistants and university teaching assistants for the preparation of lectures and of exams, for grading papers and exams, for leading laboratory practices, and for leading review and feedback sessions for the students. They also conduct academic research in their respective field of veterinary medicine, publish their findings and liaise with other university colleagues.

cypher_result.o.label: animal artificial insemination technician
cypher_result.o.description: Animal artificial insemination technicians are in charge of the impregnation of an animal using collected semen, in accordance with national legislation.

cypher_result.o.label: live animal transporter
cypher_result.o.description: Live animal transporters provide transport and transfer for live animals, including the monitoring of the health and welfare of animals, the planning of, and preparation for journeys, and loading and unloading of animals, according to national and international legislation.

cypher_result.o.label: animal trainer
cypher_result.o.description: Animal trainers train animals and/or animal handlers for general and specific purposes, including assistance, security, leisure, competition, transportation, obedience and routine handling, entertainment and education, in accordance with national legislation.

cypher_result.o.label: animal therapist
cypher_result.o.description: Animal therapists provide a therapeutic treatment following veterinary diagnosis or referral.

cypher_result.o.label: animal handler
cypher_result.o.description: Animal handlers are in charge of handling animals in a working role and continue the training of the animal, in accordance with national legislation.

cypher_result.o.label: veterinary nurse
cypher_result.o.description: Veterinary nurses support animals undergoing veterinary treatment and give advice to veterinary clients in the promotion of animal health and disease prevention in accordance with national legislation.

cypher_result.o.label: alternative animal therapist
cypher_result.o.description: Alternative animal therapists investigate sick or injured small and large animals and provide an alternative healing treatment. They may use homeopathy or acupuncture and other alternative medicines or methods to heal the animal. Alternative animal therapists also advise treatments which strengthen the self-healing powers of animals.

cypher_result.o.label: veterinary technician
cypher_result.o.description: Veterinary technicians provide the technical and administrative support to the veterinarian in accordance with national legislation.

cypher_result.o.label: animal welfare inspector
cypher_result.o.description: Animal welfare inspectors investigate alleged reports of animal cruelty or neglect, rescue or collect animals in immediate or potential risk, liaise with internal and external agencies and other animal welfare establishments, educate and advise owners and carers of animals, seek to improve or maintain the welfare of the animal(s), and prevent or alleviate suffering.

cypher_result.o.label: specialised veterinarian
cypher_result.o.description: Specialised veterinarians are professionals with a comprehensive scientific education. They have the authority to carry out, in an independent, ethical and personally responsible capacity, all aspects of veterinary medicine, in the interest of the health and welfare of animals and public health in accordance with national and international legislation. In addition they need a recognized qualification and/or experience in a specific species and/or veterinary procedure.

cypher_result.o.label: animal embryo transfer technician
cypher_result.o.description: Animal embryo transfer technicians aid and support the carrying out of embryo transfer under veterinary supervision in accordance with national legislation.

cypher_result.o.label: official veterinarian
cypher_result.o.description: Official veterinarians are professionals with a comprehensive scientific education. They have the authority to carry out, in an independent, ethical and personally responsible capacity all veterinary activities with particular focus on the health and welfare of animals and public health in accordance with national and international legislation. They are responsible for national animal disease eradication programmes, the protection of public health and food or animal inspection, animal movements, and import and export of live animals and their products.

cypher_result.o.label: general veterinarian
cypher_result.o.description: General veterinarians are professionals with a comprehensive scientific education. They have the authority to carry out, in an independent, ethical and personally responsible capacity, all aspects of veterinary medicine, in the interest of the health and welfare of animals and public health in accordance with national and international legislation. The generalist veterinarian can work with any species, however they may choose to work with a single species or types such as equine, companion or production animals.

cypher_result.j.title: Djurskyddshandläggare med fokus på lantbrukets djur
cypher_result.j.description: The county board is the government's representative in the county and coordinates the regional development work. We work with issues relating to environmental and nature conservation, rural areas, social planning, animal protection, preparedness, equality, integration and cultural environment. We work actively for the county's development and coordinate various social sectors. In our work, we protect legal certainty, openness, equal treatment and good service. The County Administrative Board in Halland County has its office in central Halmstad and we are today approx. 230 employees. For more information see our website, www.lansstyrelsen.se/halland. Halland is an expansive county with extensive animal husbandry of various kinds where the County Administrative Board is the regional expert authority in, among other things, animal protection, infection control, feed and food. We are looking for one or more animal protection officers there the position/s are located at the Veterinary Unit, where we have approximately 20 employees. A large part of the unit's activities includes animal welfare control. We are now looking for an animal welfare officer with a permanent position. Job duties We offer stimulating and varied work where you will mainly work with animal welfare control of the farm's animals. Within animal welfare control, you work with routine checks, notification checks and follow-ups of previously identified deficiencies. You carry out the checks on the farms normally as a sole administrator. You are responsible for the entire case management such as control, drawing up control reports, registration, injunctions and any other decisions. You may also carry out controls within feed and food in primary production, transport inspections, answer the public's questions and receive notifications in the unit's contact phone for animal welfare. The position may also involve other tasks that occur, such as work with food supply and drinking water. You will be part of a work group and have a close collaboration with approx. 9 people. Other work areas within the unit may also be relevant and you therefore need to have an interest and desire to develop within the unit's other operational areas as well. Qualifications You have an academic education that is relevant to the work , for example pet agronomist specializing in farm animals, farm manager specializing in animal production or other education and experience that the employer deems appropriate. We would like to see that you have experience with livestock-producing animals by having worked on a farm, been an advisor, worked as an animal welfare inspector or similar. It is positive if you have experience of having worked with preparedness issues in food and drinking water. This position requires that you have good computer skills and basic knowledge of Microsoft Office. A B driver's license is required for this position. As the work as an animal welfare officer can sometimes be psychologically stressful, it is important that you have personal maturity, are confident in yourself and can distinguish between the personal and the exercise of authority. You need to be good at working independently and that you are calm, stable and controlled in stressful and pressured situations and you must have an empathic ability so you can put yourself in someone else's perspective. It is also important that you are service-oriented and accommodating while at the same time being a strong person who is able to set the requirements needed to achieve good animal husbandry within the framework of the legislation. It is important that you have the ability to work quickly and efficiently with the legislation in focus. As a large part of the tasks are based on good communication skills, it is important that you can express yourself well in speech and writing. We attach great importance to your personal suitability and your ability to contribute to a good work environment. Other We can offer:- A exciting workplace with broad competence - An opportunity to contribute to important social tasks - Possibility of remote work if the business allows - Wellness with wellness hour We know that diversity enriches and are looking for you who can complement our team with your competence, experience and personality. We ask you to apply for the position through the link in this advertisement to facilitate our handling of incoming applications and to ensure the quality of our selection process. It is of the utmost importance that you are thorough when you fill in your application, as it is assessed against an established skills profile as well as against other applicants. The application for the position is made via our recruitment system. We have actively selected media for advertising and refrain from all offers of advertising and recruitment assistance in connection with this recruitment. The County Administrative Board applies a six-month trial period for this employment. The position may be placed in security class and in in that case, we carry out a security check with a register check in accordance with the provisions of the Security Protection Act before the position is taken up. You will be part of the County Administrative Board's crisis management and war organization. This means that you will be placed at war. You can find information about how we handle your personal data at www.lansstyrelsen.se/dataskydd.

Focus is profitable solutions delivering food and ecosystem services in various parts of the food sector.In Swedish poultry and pig production, feed accounts for the majority of both the production costs and the global warming potential. The animals' feed conversion ratio and the choice of feed ingredients thus have a significant impact on the production's climate impact. In addition to the climate impact, contributions to biodiversity, circularity, competition between feed and food, and self-sufficiency are important sustainability parameters. Future animal production needs feed that can meet these upcoming challenges without losing profitability and competitiveness. Possible strategies could include a higher proportion of feed ingredients produced from side streams and materials unsuitable for human consumption.This project aims to develop and evaluate new feed compositions with the goal of reduced environmental impact, increased self-sufficiency, and increased use of feed ingredients produced from side streams, all while maintaining good profitability.Work tasks: The work involves planning, organizing, and doing practical work while conducting animal trials at SLU's research facility Swedish Livestock Research Centre. The doctoral student is also expected to participate in teaching activities at both undergraduate and advanced levels.Qualifications:At the time of employment, a degree at advanced level is required for the position. We are looking for a candidate with a degree in Agricultural Science, a Master's degree in Animal Science, Biology, or another relevant field. You must also have documented good knowledge in written and spoken English. Knowledge of Swedish or other Nordic languages is considered an advantage. A driver's license for car is also an advantage.Previous experience in statistical data analysis, working with databases and sustainability assessments, strong computer skills, and working with pigs or poultry and their feeding is considered advantageous. An interest in Swedish animal production is also seen as a merit.Great importance will be placed on strong collaboration skills, the ability to work independently, and personal suitability for the tasks.Place of work: UppsalaForms for funding or employment:Employed as PhD student 100 % full-time (4 years education)Starting date:According to agreement.Application:Click the "Apply" button to submit your application. Alternatively, you must have conducted a minimum of four years of full-time study, of which a minimum of one year at second-cycle level.Applicants will be selected based on their written application and CV, degree project, copies of their degree certificate and transcript of records from previous first and second-cycle studies at a university or higher education institution, two personal references, and knowledge of English. cypher_result.j.description: The county board's approximately 300 employees work as the government's representative at regional level. Our mission is to develop the county and work to ensure that the national political goals have an impact in the county. We work to be an authority free from discrimination and want to take advantage of the qualities that diversity brings to the business. The rural unit is one of the county board's seven units with approximately 40 employees. The unit is responsible for project and investment support, animal and area-based support, advice and courses for agricultural companies, supervision in agriculture, register checks on animals, land acquisition permits for agricultural and forestry properties and monitoring of basic paid services. Within the unit there is also the Interreg Sweden Norway program for which the County Administrative Board of Jämtland County is the managing authority. The unit has overall responsibility for rural issues and is responsible for the agricultural and rural focus in the cross-sector collaboration at the County Board. We work with experts in these fields who are happy to share their knowledge. We work with respect, professionalism and openness for the county's residents - together for a sustainable future! The county. This includes, among other things, counseling and skills-enhancing activities aimed at the county's farmers. Our current pet consultant is now retiring and we are therefore looking for her successor who wants to work with skills development for the county's farmers with a focus on the farm's animal husbandry. Job duties You will be part of a group that works with planning, implementing and leading skills development within the common agricultural policy in the form of advice, courses and information to farmers. The work entails partly independently carrying out competence-enhancing initiatives such as courses, counseling and farm meetings with exchange of experience and partly coordinating other actors that the county administrative board has procured for various activities. You write applications for project funds and, together with colleagues, carry out the procurement of competence development efforts. The work includes financial accounting and reporting of measures taken. You collaborate with industry actors and organizations and have close cooperation with other county administrative boards as well as with various functions at our county administrative board. You may be part of cross-sectoral groups where you need to be able to combine your expertise with a holistic perspective. You participate in the work of responding to referrals and contributing with the perspective of agriculture on various issues. Depending on experience and competence, other tasks at the unit may also be part of the position. Your work is independent and requires you to be self-motivated, results-oriented and good at collaborating and creating relationships. You are sensitive to the needs of different clients. In your dialogue with farmers, you need to be service-oriented and have a good understanding of the companies' conditions in the county and have the ability to see the whole. You have a few years of work experience, experience from consultancy and government work is advantageous. You have work experience with a focus on agriculture and farm animals. If you also have experience in project management and work with skills development, as well as experience in working with small business owners, this is advantageous. You have the ability to communicate clearly in both speech and writing and have an established network within the agricultural industry. You are structured and solution-oriented with good computer skills. The position involves travel, mainly in the county, but longer trips with overnight stays also occur. A driver's license for a passenger car is required. We offer you meaningful work with varied tasks. You will make a difference to our county and society. The County Board is a broad authority, which means that you constantly have the opportunity to develop and learn new things. This applies in several policy areas. As an employer, we have a strong focus on good employment conditions, active work environment work and health-promoting wellness activities. We are keen on cooperation with our union partners and can offer remote work. In case of permanent employment at the County Board, you will be placed at war with the authority. Depending on the service, this may include serving in crisis staff and security classification. We usually start with trial employment for permanent positions. You can find information about how we process your personal data at www.lansstyrelsen.se/dataskydd

cypher_result.j.description: Aquila Rh Lons Le Saunier, local player in permanent, fixed-term and temporary recruitment, is looking for one of its clients in the Louhannais sector, an agricultural equipment company to equip, repair, maintain tractors and equipment for tillage, haymaking, crushing, maintenance ... and on the other hand, professional solutions such as tubular, fencing, watering... and everything necessary for the management of amateur breeding, an experienced agricultural mechanicYour missionsAn agricultural mechanic is a professional specialized in maintenance, repair and servicing of agricultural machinery. He works on various types of equipment, such as tractors, combines, seeders, and other machines used in agriculture. This role is crucial to ensure the proper functioning of agricultural equipment, minimize downtime and guarantee the productivity of agricultural operations. Required Skills and Qualities1. Maintenance and Repair: Carry out preventive and corrective maintenance on agricultural machinery, replacing worn parts and adjusting settings. Diagnose breakdowns and carry out the necessary repairs to ensure the proper functioning of the equipment.2. Preventive Maintenance: Carry out regular checks to ensure the good condition of machines and prevent breakdowns. Implement a maintenance plan and ensure that interventions are carried out on time.3. Installation and Commissioning: Install new equipment and machines on farms, ensuring their conformity and proper functioning. Train users in the use of machines and basic maintenance.4. Parts Stock Management: Monitor and manage the stock of spare parts and consumables necessary for machine maintenance. Order parts and materials according to the needs identified during interventions.5. Compliance with Safety Standards: Work in accordance with the safety rules in force, using appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE). Raise users' awareness of safety when using machines. ConclusionThe agricultural mechanic plays a crucial role in the maintenance and proper functioning of equipment used in the agricultural sector. His mastery of repair techniques, his sense of observation and his commitment to respecting safety standards are essential to guarantee the productivity and safety of agricultural operationsPosition to be filled quickly on a permanent contractSalary to be defined during an interview40 Hours per week + bonusesIntegration within a team of 10 people Prerequisites B license required Profile sought Diploma: Generally, a CAP, BEP, or Bac Pro in agricultural mechanics, maintenance of agricultural equipment, or agricultural equipment. A BTS Maintenance of agricultural equipment or Agroequipment is a plus.Experience: Practical experience in the workshop or in the field, often acquired through apprenticeship or internships, is essential.Specific KnowledgeAgricultural equipment: Knowledge of the different types of agricultural machinery (tractors, combine harvesters, sprayers, etc.) and their operation. Safety: Knowledge of safety rules, both for work in the workshop and for interventions in the field. cypher_result.j.title: Chef till funktionen Jordbrukarstöd
cypher_result.j.description: The County Administrative Board's approximately 300 employees work as the government's representative at regional level. Our mission is to develop the county and work to ensure that the national political goals have an impact in the county. We work to be an authority free from discrimination and want to safeguard the qualities that diversity adds the business. The country countryside unit is one of the County Administrative Board's seven units with approximately 40 employees. The unit is responsible for project and investment support, animal and area-based support, advice and courses for agricultural companies, supervision in agriculture, register checks on animals, land acquisition permits for agricultural and forestry properties and monitoring of basic payment services. Within the unit there is also Interreg Sweden the Norway program for which the County Administrative Board of Jämtland County is the managing authority. The unit has overall responsibility for rural issues and is responsible for agricultural and rural focus in the cross-sectoral cooperation on the county administrative board. With us, experts work in these areas who are happy to share their knowledge. We work with respect, professionalism and openness to the county's residents - together for a sustainable future! Descriptions The newly formed function of agricultural support we are now looking for a manager. The function consists of between 10 -15 Employees depending on the season and work mainly with handling and control of animal and area-based support for agriculture, register checks on animals and land acquisition permits for agricultural and forestry properties. The function also participates in cross -sectoral collaborations on the county administrative board and acts as experts when answering referrals and when preparing various issues linked to the county's agriculture. Work tasks as a function manager will be your role to lead the work based on our assignment and in accordance with the county administrative board's overall priorities. In daily work, you are a present manager who practices a trust -based leadership to create a good workplace for your employees and colleagues. You have target and results responsibility for the function and work closely with the unit manager and deputy unit manager on issues related to financial follow-up and strategic planning. You are part of the unit's management team and together with other managers take overall responsibility for the unit's operations and development. Collaborations with other function managers on the county administrative board and in cross -sectoral working groups are a natural part of your work. In addition to your managerial assignment you will also work with other tasks that are included in the operation of the function or unit. Depending on your background and competence, the data may vary but will constitute approximately 50% of your working hours. Qualification you have college education in an area relevant to the service, for example as an agronomist or surveyor or other education that the employer considers equivalent. You have experience of personnel management and being manager and leader and are confident in that role. Furthermore, you have knowledge and experience of issues related to agriculture and food production and a good understanding of the conditions that apply to Swedish agriculture. If you have experience in support management or work at the authority, it is a merit. You are a responsive manager who is good at listening and who can create commitment to your employees. You communicate and handle any conflicts in a constructive way, are loyal to your mission and have a positive attitude towards your work.  You can weigh complex information and show judgment in statements, actions and decisions. The work requires that you are structured and can plan, organize and prioritize in an appropriate way, you set up and keep time frames for your work. In order to succeed in the role, it is important to be able to collaborate with both people on the unit and other units and to be able to see whole and take into account a larger perspective. We offer you meaningful work with varied tasks. You will make a difference for our county and society. The County Administrative Board is a broad authority, which means that you are constantly being given the opportunity to develop and learn new things. This applies in several policy areas. As an employer, we have a great focus on good employment conditions, active work environment work and health promotion wellness activities. We care about collaboration with our trade union parties and can offer distance work. Depending on service, it may include service in crisis staff and security rating. We usually start with probationary employment at permanent services.information on how we process your personal data can be found at www.lansstyrelsen.se/datasktkt

cypher_result.j.title: Foreman, Agricultural machinery
cypher_result.j.description: Are you technically interested with experience in servicing and repairing heavy machinery and motivated by leading work and engaging others? Then there is now the chance to become our new foreman at Swedish Agro in Skara!WHAT WILL YOU BE A PART OF?Swedish AgroAt Swedish Agro, we create value for Swedish agriculture by being a comprehensive supplier for the individual farmer and offering inputs, feed and machinery of the highest quality. We represent the industry's leading brands CLAAS, HORSCH, METSJÖ, RAUCH, SPEARHEAD, SCANSTONE, AVR, AGXEED and DALBO and have one of Europe's most modern feed factories and manufacture feed for several animal species. We have a common belief that we are stronger together and work for the long term, quality and profitability. We continue to grow and are now looking for a second foreman for our team in Skara, which is one of our largest facilities in the country. As a foreman, you will be a key person in the workshop by leading and driving the business forward in close cooperation and will be part of a committed team that is passionate about agriculture and our customers. YOUR PRIMARY WORK TASKS Technical guidance with a focus on service As a foreman, you will be responsible for lead and distribute the work in the workshop and out in the field by supporting the entire department in the technical work. In this role, you are part of the workshop management, which consists of the workshop manager and two foremen, where you work together with the service department's 10 technicians towards clear qualitative goals. We work in a technologically modern environment that requires qualifications to administer business systems and digital aids.  Your tasks will include: Plan and lead the work in the workshop and out in the field Close cooperation with the workshop manager, sales, spare parts and other departments in the company Contact with customers Administer work orders Lead and participate in readiness during high season Machine logisticsYOUR PROFILEProblem solver who likes to lead and collaborateWe are looking for you who have a great technical interest and knowledge of heavy machinery. As a person, you like to have a lot of balls in the air, work in a varied role and have the ability to see solutions instead of problems. Collaboration comes easily to you where you have clear leadership and enjoy guiding, engaging and supporting people around you to create a good team spirit. To succeed in the role, we believe that you are motivated by challenges, have a strong drive of your own where responsibility and development are something that you are attracted to. We would like to see that you have a strong technical interest and a broad knowledge of agricultural machinery. If you have experience in agriculture, we also see that as an advantage. Furthermore, we see that you have: Experience from the agricultural/machinery industry Meritorious with technical training, preferably heavy vehicles/agricultural machinery High social skills with an understanding of customers' needs and wishes Are computer literate and a good administrator Good knowledge of Swedish and English in speech and writing B driver's license is a requirement WE OFFER Stronger together At Swedish Agro, our foundation is based on cooperation and we have a fundamental belief that we are stronger together. We thus offer a workplace where we develop together - across departments, skills and national borders. Our employees are our most important resource and we strive to create the best framework for well-being, development and influence. With us, you get the opportunity to undergo internal and external training so that you gain knowledge of the latest technology - we work with the most high-tech the products on the market with well-known brands ARE YOU INTERESTED? How to apply If you think the position sounds exciting, please send your application and CV today or as soon as possible by clicking "APPLY". We expect to hold interviews continuously and we stop the search when the right candidate has been found. We believe that diversity strengthens the solution of tasks. We therefore invite all interested parties - regardless of background - to apply for the position. We hope to hear from you! AN INTERNATIONAL GROUP We want to create value! For agriculture, for the farmer and for our employees. Swedish Agro is part of the Danish Agro group, with more than 5,000 colleagues spread over 100+ companies in 15 countries. From the field to the screen, our employees are at the core of our ability to create value and develop the agriculture of the future and ensure that we can play a decisive role in the industry's digital and green transition - and that we help the farmer grow world-class food every day. We do this by strengthening, growing and developing the industry - and not least each other. And we need you too! Are you more curious about the Danish Agro group? Watch our group film here!

cypher_result.j.title: Försökstekniker till Sandbygård
cypher_result.j.description: We are looking for you with a great interest in the future of agriculture and who wants to work in an engaging team with a fast pace and lots of laughs. With us, you are offered an exciting opportunity to get a developing job in Swedish horticulture with an employer with long experience and a lot of knowledge. Welcome to us at Hushållningssällskapet Skåne!Hushållningssällskapet Skåne has for 200 years been involved in the development of Sweden's agriculture, which makes us a safe and stable employer with a lot of knowledge. We are the farmers' support and conduct a very reputable field trial operation with approx. 450 trials a year, where quality and development are the guiding stars. About the service The Skåne Farming Society's focus is to carry out crop cultivation trials of high scientific quality with modern equipment in all imaginable crops for the benefit and profitability of Swedish Agriculture. As a test technician with us, you will thus get an exciting role where the starting point of your work is to strive for quality and efficiency at all levels. It is varied work where every day is unique and the challenges are many. We carry out field trials in areas such as variety testing, plant protection, weed control, plant nutrition, tillage and more. You will be part of a team of trial technicians who work closely together. We offer you stimulating and fun work with varying tasks throughout the year depending on the season. With us, you also get the opportunity to participate in developing the agriculture of the future! About you In order to succeed and thrive with us, you have an agricultural education or work experience in crop cultivation. You have good knowledge of driving agricultural machinery and you should have a sprayer certificate. B driving license is a requirement for the position, BE is desirable. It is advantageous if you have knowledge of pests and diseases in crop cultivation. If you have experience in machine service, we also see that as a plus. As a person, you have a great interest in crop cultivation/agriculture. You are meticulous, committed and quality conscious. You have the ability and enjoy working both independently and together with others. Of course you are driven and like challenges. Location: You start from our experimental station at Sandbygård. The work at our second trial station at Helgegården will occur. The position begins as a trial position for 6 months Questions about the position? Feel free to call us and we will tell you more. Ulrika Dyrlund Martinsson, head of field trials, 010 - 476 20 31, ulrika.dyrlund-martinsson@hushallningssallskapet.se or Andreas Andersson, field trial leader, 010 - 4762054, andreas.andersson@hushallningssallskapet.se Does it sound interesting? Submit your application today as selection takes place continuously. Welcome with your application!RequirementsAgricultural education or work experience in crop cultivationGood knowledge of driving agricultural machineryB driver's licenseMeriting BE driver's licenseSpray certificateKnowledge of pests and diseases in crop productionExperience in machine serviceAbout the employer - The SkåneHushållningssallskapet The Hushållningssallskapet is part of Sweden's history. The history stretches all the way back to 1791, when the country's first Household Society was established on Gotland. When we arrived over two hundred years ago, it was in a different Sweden, where agriculture formed the basis for the entire nation's prosperity. Back then, when famine was a reality in many Swedish households, new knowledge was needed for a more rational food production. Today, we continue to be an important actor that develops the green business life and to manage the earth's resources. Today, the Housekeeping Society consists of 15 independent societies that operate all over the country (the Housekeeping Society in Skåne is one of these). Just over 700 employees deal with advice, training, research and field trials and we have around 30,000 members. Our customers are in agriculture, forestry, public activities and other industries, mainly in rural areas. Together, we offer knowledge for the country's future. Please read more about us at https://hushallningssallskapet.se/

cypher_result.j.title: Head of culture M/F
cypher_result.j.description: Ready to cultivate performance together and reap success? We are looking for a Cultivation Manager (M/F) for a permanent contract to be filled as soon as possible near Amiens (80). cypher_result.j.title: Naturbrukskolan Uddetorp is looking for agricultural operations personnel
cypher_result.j.description: With the goal - We develop world-class competence for a sustainable future and the good life, the Natural Resources Management runs education in youth high school, adapted high school, adult education and vocational college. The natural farming schools Svenljunga, Sötåsen, Uddetorp and the University of Applied Sciences function as competence centers for the growth and development of the green industries. Together with business and researchers, the administration runs energy projects and experimental activities at the forefront of schools. The Naturbruksförvaltningen is part of the Västra Götaland region. On the outskirts of Skara, nestled in greenery and surrounded by rolling fields, is the Naturbruksskolan Uddetorp. Here we run a conventional farm with the help of a solid machinery park and the latest technology for sustainable crop cultivation. The school has 200 hectares of fields, 16 hectares of natural pasture and 60 hectares of its own forest. The farm also has 65 dairy cows, 60 young animals and 8 ewes with lambs. At Uddetorp, we offer the focus on agriculture. The school is growing and is popular to apply to. We have 184 high school students and nearly 300 adult students at the facility. Description With us you get a chance to make a difference and contribute to development. At our school, the next generation is trained in the green industry. We are looking for you who are development and goal-oriented, meticulous and who enjoy being in a changing everyday life together with students and colleagues. You also have good, both theoretical and practical knowledge in agriculture. We put the students and their knowledge development at the center. You therefore need to be sensitive to their needs, conditions and experiences. You are characterized by openness, non-prestige and have a great desire for development and cooperation. Tasks Together with the team, you will plan and carry out customary tasks within the school's agriculture, as well as with crop cultivation, machinery and with the farm's animals. You will also, together with the work team and other vocational teachers, instruct/teach students when they come out into agriculture to learn the craft to become the next generation of farmers. Qualifications Master farmer, agrotechnician or equivalent skills Solid professional experience in agriculture Driving license authorization B with manual gearbox Meritorious qualifications Driving license motor- clearing chainsawExperience of digitization in agriculture such as auto control, etc. We place great emphasis on personal suitability. Conditions The employment is a temporary position during the period February-November 2025 which may be extended with 100% employment rate, holiday service. Evening and weekend duty may occur. In order to get a job within our school operations, an extract from the charge register must be presented, you apply for one via the police's website. Selection and recruitment may take place continuously during the application period, so apply already today and no later than December 1. Welcome with your application! cypher_result.j.title: Summer job 2025;     Tractor driver for Widegrens Gård on Gotland
cypher_result.j.description: About usWidegrens Gård on Gotland specializes in the organic cultivation of potatoes, carrots and onions with our own packing plant where we wash, sort and pack the products. In addition to this, there is also the cultivation of grain and rapeseed. Our carrot packing house is in Atlingbo and our potato and onion packing house is in Follingbo. The cultivation, which is completely organic, is spread over central Gotland. We are today 45 employees who work together all year round towards high goals. Today, 12 machine operators work in our cultivation team, led by our team leader Marcus and cultivation manager Jakob. In the summer, we are reinforced by around 180 summer workers in manual cleaning of our organic cultivations. the coffee room. We are a smoke-free company. As an employee with us, you get the work and protective clothing you need in your role with us. We have a management team that is seen continuously where we constantly try to develop and improve the company. The management team includes the following roles CEO, cultivation manager, HR manager, Team leader Sylfaste, Team leader Atlingbo, Team leader Cultivation, We ourselves would like to describe ourselves as a stable growing company where much is still undone and the opportunities are great. We are informal and straightforward with a short chain of command in a flat structure. We are aware that our employees are the most important thing we have and that it is people who build the company. Together as a team, we try to implement the goals and visions we have for the business. About the position Until the summer of 2025, we are looking for tractor drivers for summer jobs to cover vacation times for our regular staff and to catch up when the field work is most intensive. You should be very interested of crop cultivation and agricultural machinery. Inspired by the feeling of being part of a larger work team where you share challenges together, strive towards high goals without having far to laugh. The work consists of many different tasks in crop cultivation where you contribute to trying to get the crop to reach its full potential. We solve a large part of the tasks in teams, but there are also many tasks that are solved on your own when you get warm in your clothes. It is a prerequisite that you have experience of driving agricultural machinery, that you can perform them with skill without damaging either the crop, the machine or the surroundings. Your attitude and desire to develop with us is strong and the commitment to do your best is a matter of course. .The position can be filled before the application deadline.Joining date for the position by agreement based on how your conditions look like for the coming summer.Salary according to increase.For the right applicant who currently does not live on Gotland, we can actively help find accommodation through our local network, several people in our existing team have come from the mainland in recent years. cypher_result.description: The county board's approximately 300 employees work as the government's representative at regional level. Our mission is to develop the county and work to ensure that the national political goals have an impact in the county. We work to be an authority free from discrimination and want to take advantage of the qualities that diversity brings to the business. The rural unit is one of the county board's seven units with approximately 40 employees. The unit is responsible for project and investment support, animal and area-based support, advice and courses for agricultural companies, supervision in agriculture, register checks on animals, land acquisition permits for agricultural and forestry properties and monitoring of basic paid services. Within the unit there is also the Interreg Sweden Norway program for which the County Administrative Board of Jämtland County is the managing authority. The unit has overall responsibility for rural issues and is responsible for the agricultural and rural focus in the cross-sector collaboration at the County Board. We work with experts in these fields who are happy to share their knowledge. We work with respect, professionalism and openness for the county's residents - together for a sustainable future! The county. This includes, among other things, counseling and skills-enhancing activities aimed at the county's farmers. Our current pet consultant is now retiring and we are therefore looking for her successor who wants to work with skills development for the county's farmers with a focus on the farm's animal husbandry. Job duties You will be part of a group that works with planning, implementing and leading skills development within the common agricultural policy in the form of advice, courses and information to farmers. The work entails partly independently carrying out competence-enhancing initiatives such as courses, counseling and farm meetings with exchange of experience and partly coordinating other actors that the county administrative board has procured for various activities. You write applications for project funds and, together with colleagues, carry out the procurement of competence development efforts. The work includes financial accounting and reporting of measures taken. You collaborate with industry actors and organizations and have close cooperation with other county administrative boards as well as with various functions at our county administrative board. You may be part of cross-sectoral groups where you need to be able to combine your expertise with a holistic perspective. You participate in the work of responding to referrals and contributing with the perspective of agriculture on various issues. Depending on experience and competence, other tasks at the unit may also be part of the position. Your work is independent and requires you to be self-motivated, results-oriented and good at collaborating and creating relationships. You are sensitive to the needs of different clients. In your dialogue with farmers, you need to be service-oriented and have a good understanding of the companies' conditions in the county and have the ability to see the whole. You have a few years of work experience, experience from consultancy and government work is advantageous. You have work experience with a focus on agriculture and farm animals. If you also have experience in project management and work with skills development, as well as experience in working with small business owners, this is advantageous. You have the ability to communicate clearly in both speech and writing and have an established network within the agricultural industry. You are structured and solution-oriented with good computer skills. The position involves travel, mainly in the county, but longer trips with overnight stays also occur. A driver's license for a passenger car is required. We offer you meaningful work with varied tasks. You will make a difference to our county and society. The County Board is a broad authority, which means that you constantly have the opportunity to develop and learn new things. This applies in several policy areas. As an employer, we have a strong focus on good employment conditions, active work environment work and health-promoting wellness activities. We are keen on cooperation with our union partners and can offer remote work. In case of permanent employment at the County Board, you will be placed at war with the authority. Depending on the service, this may include serving in crisis staff and security classification. We usually start with trial employment for permanent positions. cypher_result.title: Business manager for the new center for sustainable primary production
cypher_result.description: The unit for cooperation and development Do you want to take a key role in the development of knowledge for a sustainable primary production of food? Through an investment in the future, in collaboration between Sparbanken Skåne and SLU, this knowledge center is now being established, which will take advantage of Skåne's excellent conditions for sustainable food production through knowledge, innovation and new technical opportunities in collaboration between academia and the agricultural and horticultural industries. We are now looking for you to lead the center's development from the start, in close collaboration with SLU's research and education and with the support of management functions. You will be the operative spider in the network to take advantage of synergies and secure progress in the business. Read more in SLU's press release: 50 million invested in new knowledge center for sustainable food production in Alnarp | Externwebben (slu.se) About the job SLU and Sparbanken Skåne's center for sustainable primary production The formation of the center will promote sustainable primary production and work for a robust food chain that benefits economic growth and development in Scania in the long term. Through outstanding research and education, the center will collaborate with business and public actors to develop, disseminate and utilize knowledge and new solutions for a transition that balances economic, ecological and social sustainability. The center has four overarching goal areas for the operation.• Increased knowledge and innovation for increased sustainability in primary production• Increased collaboration in research and development• Higher level of technology in research, education and industry• Strengthen Skåne's contribution to the development of primary production in Sweden The center shall contribute to creating collaborations in order to make use of competence and resources which, in the long run, lead to even more results in primary production companies and in research and education. Duties Your area of ​​responsibility as business manager is to, in dialogue with management functions, be responsible for the centre's whole and sub-projects and to be the contact person towards Sparbanken Skåne and other partners to ensure business progress and goal achievement. A particular focus is to • develop the center with support from the steering group and advisory board • ensure the center's progress in line with the operational plan where coordination of sub-activities and utilization of synergies within the center and with other activities is included as a significant part • represent the center in contacts within and outside SLU • work to ensure that the business can be strengthened by, for example, taking initiatives for collaborations with relevant actors and research applications for supplementary funding• work actively for the business's contribution to making a difference for primary producers in Skåne• work for the center's mutual benefit for academia and practice Your manager is the head of unit at the unit for collaboration and development. Your background As an applicant for the position, you must have an academic degree in subject areas relevant to the future development of primary production and related areas. You must have experience of having coordinated collaborations in a leading position and also have worked in or in contact with academic environments. You must have documented leadership experience with financial responsibility. You must be responsive and goal-oriented with an inclusive, communicative and process-oriented way of working. Furthermore, you must be a driven person who is used to working independently while participating in teamwork. Good ability to express oneself verbally and in writing in Swedish and English is a requirement. As networking is an important part of the work, a driver's license is a requirement.  For us, personal suitability is crucial. About us LTV Faculty - Landscape Architecture, Horticulture and Plant Production Science The center has its organizational home at the LTV Faculty. World-leading research in landscape architecture, horticultural science and plant production is conducted here. The faculty offers several educational programs, including the agriculturist program, the horticultural engineering program, and the agroecology program. The LTV faculty is mostly located in Alnarp, in the middle of Sweden's most dynamic agricultural, horticultural and food region. The position will have its operational residence at the unit for collaboration and development in Alnarp. The unit is a cooperation-supporting resource with the task of developing and supporting SLU's internal and external cooperation in order to strengthen the quality and social relevance of SLU's research, education and environmental analysis. Since the cooperation should lead to mutual benefit, the activity should also contribute to knowledge-driven development of companies and relevant organizations in society. At SLU, you take your walk-and-talk meetings and lunchtime walks in the unique Alnarpsparken. Watch the film about our campus at https://www.slu.se/alnarpsfilmen Read more about our benefits and what it's like to work at SLU at https://www.slu.se/om-slu/jobba-pa-slu/ Location: Alnarp Form of employment: Permanent employment. SLU applies 6 month trial employment Scope: 100% or according to agreement Access: According to agreement Application: Welcome with your application via the application button below no later than 2024-10-31. Union contact persons: https://internt.slu.se/min-anstallning/facket/kontaktpersons/ The Swedish University of Agriculture (SLU) has a key role in the development of sustainable living, founded in science and education. Through our focus on the interplay between humans, animals and ecosystems and a responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable social development and good living conditions on our planet. The main locations are Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, but operations are also carried out at research stations, experimental parks and educational locations throughout the country. SLU has just over 3,000 employees, 5,000 students and research students and a turnover of over three billion kroner. The university invests in attractive environments on its campus areas. We work for an equal and inclusive work environment where open conversations between people with different experiences lay the foundation for science, creativity and development. We therefore welcome people with different backgrounds and perspectives to apply for the current position.

The function also participates in cross -sectoral collaborations on the county administrative board and acts as experts when answering referrals and when preparing various issues linked to the county's agriculture. Depending on your background and competence, the data may vary but will constitute approximately 50% of your working hours. Qualification you have college education in an area relevant to the service, for example as an agronomist or surveyor or other education that the employer considers equivalent. You have experience of personnel management and being manager and leader and are confident in that role. Furthermore, you have knowledge and experience of issues related to agriculture and food production and a good understanding of the conditions that apply to Swedish agriculture. If you have experience in support management or work at the authority, it is a merit. You are a responsive manager who is good at listening and who can create commitment to your employees. cypher_result.title: Employees plant cultivation attempts
cypher_result.description: We are looking for you with great interest in plant cultivation and future agriculture and who want to work in an engaging team with high tempo and many laughs. We offer you an exciting opportunity to get a developing work in Swedish plant cultivation from an employer with long experience and a lot of knowledge. Welcome to us at the Housekeeping Society Skåne! The Housekeeping Society Skåne has been involved in the development of Sweden's agriculture for 200 years, which makes us a safe and stable employer with a lot of knowledge. We are the support of the farmers and conduct a very reputable field trial operation with about 450 attempts a year, where quality and development are guiding stars. If the service Housekeeping Society Skåne's focus is to carry out plant cultivation attempts with high scientific quality with modern equipment in all conceivable crops to benefit and profitability for Swedish Agriculture. With us you thus get an exciting role where the starting point in your work is to strive for quality and efficiency at all levels. It is a varied work where every day is unique and the challenges are many. We carry out field trials in, among other things, variety tasting, plant protection, weed control, plant nutrients, tillage and more. You will be part of a team of experimental techniques that work closely together. We offer you a stimulating and fun work with varying tasks during the year depending on the season. With us you also get the opportunity to be involved in developing the agriculture of the future! If you succeed and thrive with us, you have an agricultural education or work experience in plant cultivation. B-driving license is a requirement for the service, pray is desirable. If you have good knowledge of performing agricultural machines and syringe certificates, we see it as a merit. It is also a merit if you have knowledge of pests and diseases of plant cultivation. As a person, you have great interest in plant cultivation/agriculture with a curiosity and desire to learn. You are careful, committed and quality conscious. You have the ability and enjoy working both independently and with others. Of course, you are driven and like challenges Please call us and we will tell you more. Ulrika Dyrlund Martinsson, Head of Department for Field Experiments 010-4762031, Ulrika.dyrlundmartinsson@hushallningssallskapet.se Andreas Andersson, field trial leader, 010-4762054, andreas.andersson@hushallningssallset. Kapet.se Does that sound interesting? Submit your application today when selection is ongoing. Welcome with your application! Requirement training alternative work experience in plant cultivation borne-corporate driving license syringe certificate about pests and diseases in plant cultivation experience of machine service goods knowledge of performing agricultural machines-the employer-the Housekeeping Society. History extends all the way back to 1791, when the country's first housekeeping company was established on Gotland. When we arrived over two hundred years ago it was in another Sweden, where agriculture formed the basis for the whole nation's prosperity. Then, when the famine was a reality in many Swedish households, new knowledge was needed for a more rational food production. Today we continue to be an important player that develops the green business community and to maintain the earth's resources. Today, the Housekeeping Society consists of 15 independent societies that operate throughout the country (the Housekeeping Society in Skåne is one of these). More than 700 employees deal with counseling, education, research and field experiments and we have about 30,000 members. Our customers are in agriculture, forest, public operations and other industries, mainly in the countryside. Together we offer knowledge for the country's future. Read more about us at https://hushallningssallskapet.se/

cypher_result.title: Foreman, Agricultural machinery

Then there is now the chance to become our new foreman at Swedish Agro in Skara!WHAT WILL YOU BE A PART OF?Swedish AgroAt Swedish Agro, we create value for Swedish agriculture by being a comprehensive supplier for the individual farmer and offering inputs, feed and machinery of the highest quality. We represent the industry's leading brands CLAAS, HORSCH, METSJÖ, RAUCH, SPEARHEAD, SCANSTONE, AVR, AGXEED and DALBO and have one of Europe's most modern feed factories and manufacture feed for several animal species. We have a common belief that we are stronger together and work for the long term, quality and profitability. We continue to grow and are now looking for a second foreman for our team in Skara, which is one of our largest facilities in the country. As a foreman, you will be a key person in the workshop by leading and driving the business forward in close cooperation and will be part of a committed team that is passionate about agriculture and our customers. YOUR PRIMARY WORK TASKS Technical guidance with a focus on service As a foreman, you will be responsible for lead and distribute the work in the workshop and out in the field by supporting the entire department in the technical work. In this role, you are part of the workshop management, which consists of the workshop manager and two foremen, where you work together with the service department's 10 technicians towards clear qualitative goals. We work in a technologically modern environment that requires qualifications to administer business systems and digital aids.  Your tasks will include: Plan and lead the work in the workshop and out in the field Close cooperation with the workshop manager, sales, spare parts and other departments in the company Contact with customers Administer work orders Lead and participate in readiness during high season Machine logisticsYOUR PROFILEProblem solver who likes to lead and collaborateWe are looking for you who have a great technical interest and knowledge of heavy machinery. As a person, you like to have a lot of balls in the air, work in a varied role and have the ability to see solutions instead of problems. Collaboration comes easily to you where you have clear leadership and enjoy guiding, engaging and supporting people around you to create a good team spirit. To succeed in the role, we believe that you are motivated by challenges, have a strong drive of your own where responsibility and development are something that you are attracted to. We would like to see that you have a strong technical interest and a broad knowledge of agricultural machinery. If you have experience in agriculture, we also see that as an advantage. Furthermore, we see that you have: Experience from the agricultural/machinery industry Meritorious with technical training, preferably heavy vehicles/agricultural machinery High social skills with an understanding of customers' needs and wishes Are computer literate and a good administrator Good knowledge of Swedish and English in speech and writing B driver's license is a requirement WE OFFER Stronger together At Swedish Agro, our foundation is based on cooperation and we have a fundamental belief that we are stronger together. We thus offer a workplace where we develop together - across departments, skills and national borders. Our employees are our most important resource and we strive to create the best framework for well-being, development and influence. With us, you get the opportunity to undergo internal and external training so that you gain knowledge of the latest technology - we work with the most high-tech the products on the market with well-known brands ARE YOU INTERESTED? How to apply If you think the position sounds exciting, please send your application and CV today or as soon as possible by clicking "APPLY". We expect to hold interviews continuously and we stop the search when the right candidate has been found. We believe that diversity strengthens the solution of tasks. We therefore invite all interested parties - regardless of background - to apply for the position. We hope to hear from you! AN INTERNATIONAL GROUP We want to create value! For agriculture, for the farmer and for our employees. Swedish Agro is part of the Danish Agro group, with more than 5,000 colleagues spread over 100+ companies in 15 countries. From the field to the screen, our employees are at the core of our ability to create value and develop the agriculture of the future and ensure that we can play a decisive role in the industry's digital and green transition - and that we help the farmer grow world-class food every day. We do this by strengthening, growing and developing the industry - and not least each other. And we need you too! Are you more curious about the Danish Agro group? Watch our group film here!

Then this position at SLU in Umeå could be something for you. We are now looking for an employee who can contribute to continued development and management of the business. cypher_result.title: Lantbrukare med huvudansvar för jordbruk och djurhållning
cypher_result.description: Tasks: We now need to supplement the workforce with you who want to contribute to the development of the cultural reserve Stensjö village. It is a unique opportunity to, together with colleagues on site and with the support of management advice and external expertise, participate in the development work and work towards the cultural-historical target image. During the changes of the seasons, you will contribute to recreating the experience of old-time small farms in the Småland forest region. The position involves primary responsibility for agriculture and animal husbandry in a landscape characterized by natural grazing, mowing fields, small fields and large forest areas. All cultivation is organic. You must be prepared to take on managerial responsibilities. The permanent staff at the farm consists of four people with different areas of responsibility (agriculture, forestry, garden, landscape), one of whom is site manager with overall responsibility for the property. During the growing season, the workforce is supplemented by one to two seasonal workers. The animal supervision on the weekends rotates between the staff so that work takes place according to schedule every third to fourth weekend. Common, ongoing work tasks consist of all tasks occurring within a farm with an ecological orientation and a focus on cultural-historical landscape care. An important task is to continuously document the work that is done. Passing on knowledge of the uniqueness of Stensjö village to visitors and groups is also part of the work. Participation in management councils and ongoing contacts with the County Administrative Board regarding issues relating to the cultural reserve are included, as well as administrative work and authority contacts related to the duties, such as EU and other applications, reporting and registration. Programs used at Stensjö include Dataväxt, Växa Sverige, CDB, Elitlamm etc. About Stensjö village Stensjö village comprises 576 hectares of which 14 hectares are arable, 81 hectares of pasture, 417 hectares of forest and 44 hectares of impediment. The large contiguous areas with natural pastures are distinctive for Stensjö village. A typical feature is the kilometre-long hedgerows that enclose holdings, pastures and cattle lanes. Small fields, mowing fields, pastures and open fields with forest grazing characterize the landscape. The village's great importance lies in the fact that houses and property form a unit that is original. Residential houses and outbuildings, a total of about 50 in number, are gathered in a cluster village, which was common in many places in Småland before legal transfer was carried out in the 19th century. In the village there are about fifteen cows and a bull of the red kulla breed as well as about 30 Helsingo sheep, some pigs and chickens. During the summer months, hired cows walk in the forest pastures. The field cultivation consists of paddy, potatoes and cultivated crops, mainly older cereals but also flax. The land has been cultivated organically since the Vitterhetsakademien took over the property in the 1960s. Since 2020, Stensjö village is a cultural reserve. The management plan aims to show Stensjö as it looked at the turn of the century in 1900. The land types that existed at that time should be well represented in the form of pastures, fodder dikes, gardens, ancient fields with cereal crops, natural hay fields and forest pastures. Long-term work is underway where the management plan is the guiding principle with the aim of recreating an older land use. Stensjö village is to be developed into a knowledge and development center for historic landscape use. The management plan can be found on the website under the Management plan and documents tab. To support the work, there is a management council that meets at Stensjö twice a year. The maintenance council consists of 5-7 people with experience in practical landscape and garden maintenance and building maintenance, as well as representatives for research in relevant areas. Administrative support such as finance, communication etc. can be found at the Vitterhetsakademien's office in Stockholm. Qualifications Requirements for the position You must have documented, solid experience in crop cultivation and animal husbandry Ability to work both independently and together with others Good verbal and written communication skills in Swedish Experience in administration and authority contacts regarding farm support, animal husbandry, EU applications etc. Driving license BMeritandEducation in agriculture and animal husbandryEducation/experience in organic farming with crop rotations Experience of work management Education/experience of: Landscape care with a cultural-historical focus, scythes Work with horses Forestry with clear cutting methods Machine maintenance Building care/property care with an antiquarian focus Experience of museum operations and outward-looking, public activities Basic interest and knowledge of small farms; nature, history and culture, and preferably more specifically about Småland's conditions Driving license BEChainsaw driving license A and BHunting licensePersonal characteristicsWe attach great importance to personal suitability. You can work independently and intensively when required, but also be a good colleague and partner with Stensjö's best interests at heart in all internal and external contexts. You have a great sense of responsibility and can flexibly change between the various tasks. Employment and other information about the work The position is a permanent, full-time position that begins with a six-month probationary period. The work involves scheduled working hours, which includes work on evenings, weekends and public holidays. The academy applies individual salary setting. The workplace is Stensjö village, 10 km north of Oskarshamn. There is an opportunity to live in Stensjö village. The Vitterhetsakademien's office is in Stockholm. Support functions such as finances, administration, communication, IT support, archives, etc. is there. The property manager, who is the immediate manager, has his main place of work in Stockholm but is on site in Stensjö village several times a year. In between, meetings and contact take place via Teams and telephone. Collaboration and meetings with colleagues at the other cultural properties take place regularly, including in connection with joint property meetings twice a year. The members of the Vitterhetsakademie have a great interest in the cultural properties and many regularly visit Stensjö village. There is guest accommodation for them at each cultural property, which enables overnight stays.

cypher_result.title: Operations manager SLU Lanna Property

As an operations manager at Lanna property, you have a unique opportunity to develop our operations in close proximity to research, experiments and students. We are looking for you who have a great interest in plant cultivation and want to contribute to SLU's promise of science and education for sustainable living. About the job You are offered varied work with great personal responsibility and many exciting development opportunities both within SLU and in the industry. As operations manager, you are responsible for the property's operations, which start from the Lanna research station west of Skara. You lead the day-to-day work and are active in the field yourself. You are also driving the strategic work on the property and have budget responsibility. As operations manager, you have many contacts within the university, with landowners, various authorities and the public. Together with the operations managers on the other properties and the agricultural manager, you also develop SLU's agricultural operations. Your background We are looking for you who want to drive and develop agricultural enterprises. You have higher education in the field of agriculture, or have acquired equivalent knowledge through experience. You are experienced and knowledgeable when it comes to crop cultivation, operational economics, machinery and maintenance. You are interested in agricultural data and technology development, and are used to working with planning and follow-up tools for plant cultivation. Knowledge of forestry is an advantage and we would like you to have chainsaw driver's license A & B. You enjoy the role of planning and leading the work and developing the work team. You are a good communicator and have the ability to create trust, collaborate and develop relationships with others, both in Swedish and English. We would like to see that you have an interest in sustainability issues in agriculture. You have a B driving license and authorization for plant protection 1L-2L. About us The Lanna property comprises approximately 310 ha of conventional crop cultivation distributed over Lanna, Brogården and Götala in Lidköping and Skara municipalities. Crop cultivation produces cereals, sorghum and oilseeds sales and roughage to the Götala research center. The business is based in Lanna, but also has staff quarters and a workshop in Götala, where SLU also uses approx. 170 ha of forest under the auspices of the property. In addition to this, the property is responsible for certain maintenance of green areas for SLU Skara. In addition to the operations manager, two machine operators also work on the Lanna property. The Lanna property belongs to SLU's agricultural operation, which has a total of 11 employees on SLU's four properties Ultuna, Alnarp, Lanna (Skara) and Hallfreda (Gotland). The agricultural operation's mission is to cultivate and manage some of SLU's main research and teaching resources: the earth, the forest and its data. All employees are offered a security package including wellness compensation. cypher_result.title: PhD Student in Plant Genetics and Breeding
