We contribute to the efficient and sustainable production of food, feed, and industrial products through our state-of-the-art research targeting plants. our goal is to meet the increasing demands for these resources while making plant production increasingly environmentally friendly and energy efficient. Through our concerted efforts, we expand knowledge that contributes to sustainable societal development. In collaboration with growers and industries involved in crop cultivation, we are actively shaping what will be served on consumer plates in the future. Our department has grown numerically in recent years, with international employees and PhD students accounting for a highly significant proportion. Research activities at the department include population genetics of various crop species, development of omics-based breeding tools, marker-aided selection, genomic prediction, and crossbreeding for crop improvement.More information about the department can be found here:https://www.slu.se/en/departments/plant-breeding/Read more about our benefits and what it is like to work at SLU at https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/Name of research project/thesis: Population genetics, comparative genomics, marker-trait association analysis and development of speed breeding methods to improve yield and quality in red clover.Research subject: Agricultural Science Description:Currently, the Department is conducting several research projects on crops that have a significant impact on Swedish agriculture. A number of these projects are funded by SLU GroGrund - the Swedish Centre for Breeding of Food Crops: https://www.slu.se/en/Collaborative-Centres-and-Projects/grogrund/One of these projects is "Building Efficient Breeding Programs in Forages: BreedForage". Red clover, the most important forage legume crop in Sweden, is one of the target crops of this project. Currently, the Department is seeking a PhD student to join the research team in this project, which focuses on red clover forage yields and forage quality.The PhD student who will hold this position will be actively engaged in various project activities including•  Crossbreeding•  Phenotyping•  Comparative genomics and allele mining,•  Population genetics and marker-trait association analyses•  Genomic prediction•  Protocol development for speed breeding.•  The PhD student will conduct various hands-on activities in the laboratory, greenhouse, and field.Qualifications:We seek a highly motivated candidate with a master's degree in plant genetics and breeding, plant biology, or a related field. Hence, it is of great importance that the candidate has effective communication and collaboration skills.The ability to write and communicate effectively in English is a prerequisite while communicating in Scandinavian languages is an advantage.Applicants should demonstrate a high level of scientific curiosity and possess favorable personal characters.Place of work: AlnarpForms for funding or employment:Employment (4 years)Starting date:July 1st, 2025 or according to agreementApplication:Click the "Apply" button to submit your application. cypher_result.title: Researchers in ecosystem services in strip cultivation
cypher_result.description: The Department of Bio Systems and Technology Som Jobs It is important to reduce the unilateral cultivation of a few crops in large fields, and instead increase the diversity of crops to benefit biodiversity and increase ecosystem services such as biological control. In addition, a greater variety of cultivated crops is promising to increase the return and/or reduce the dependence on pesticides. In this project we will assess whether strip cultivation, where two or more crops are grown next to each other in strips adapted to the width of modern sowing machines, can strengthen biological control, reduce the use of pesticides and maintain harvests compared to when each crop is grown alone on the field. In addition, we will validate the experiment with trials on farms, where farmers themselves decide the management. We are looking for a motivated person with a few years of experience as a researcher and with the ambition of an academic career, who also has a great interest in developing knowledge about the effect of the strip cultivation on biological Control of pests and the return on economically important agricultural crops. The candidate is expected to investigate what potential strip cultivation in practically applicable care has to mitigate the harvest loss of the pest. This means, among other things, planning a cultivation attempt at the university's experimental station, field work, collaboration with Swedish and international partners and to investigate agricultural acceptance of innovative cultivation systems such as strip cultivation. We attach great importance to personal fitness and are looking for you who have good cooperative ability but also be able to work independently. You are looking for you who have: • Doctorate in biology with a focus on insect ecology and their ecosystem services in diversified cultivation systems, or equivalent • demonstrated research experience in the subjects insect pollination and biological control of pests, insect diversity in legumes and rapeseed and effects of co -cultivation • High skills in statistical processing and handling of ecological data • showed ability to publish research results in international scientifically examined magazines • Excellent knowledge in written and oral communication in English and oral Communication in Swedish • Effective communication skills, a strong work ethic and shown experience in collaborating with stakeholders outside the academy • Granted applications with the Research Council are qualified if you also have: • Experience in international collaborations • Experience in project planning, field work and project management • Experience in supervision T .ex. Students' degree projecting Oss research at the Department of Bio Systems and Technology explores the interaction between land, plants, animals, environment, climate and people in systems for sustainable production of food and renewable raw materials. The department has a broad expertise in agricultural and horticultural science and delivers research-based knowledge in teaching and through active collaboration and dense dialogue with stakeholders. We are currently about 60 employees including researchers, doctoral students and support staff. External web leaf more about our benefits and what it is like to work at SLU at https://www.slu.se/om-su/jobba-pa-slu/placing:alnarpansting form:Stidsvidarest position. SLU may apply probationary employment. Swap: 100%access: April 1, 2025 application: The application must be written in English and contain in) a depiction of scientific interests and justification for why this employment is sought (max one page); ii) Brief project plan (max two pages); iii) Curriculum Vitae including a full publication list, which distinguishes scientifically reviewed articles from other publications. /Contact persons/Swedish University of Agriculture (SLU) has a key role in the development of sustainable life, founded in science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and a responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable social development and good living conditions on our planet. The main places are Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, but operations are also conducted at research stations, subject parks and places of education throughout the country. cypher_result.title: Substitute Cultivation coordinator/project manager
cypher_result.description: Do you want to help shape the sustainable society of the future? Södertälje municipality is looking for a creative and innovative person for the role of cultivation coordinator/cultivation project manager. The assignment is a temporary position starting no later than January 2025. Here you get the chance to influence how we protect our farmland and promote local food production, all in line with the municipality's goal of becoming climate neutral by 2030. The position is located at the park and landscape unit at the Community Planning Office. In the unit, we are a total of 14 people who work on issues related to park planning, ecosystem services, pollination, cultivation coordination and much more. We enjoy being together very well on the unit and have a kind climate where we care for each other, our differences and where we are happy to cooperate. Among your colleagues at the unit, you will find people with roles such as landscape architect, park engineer, administrator, coordinator and unit manager. We all work together towards the municipality's overall goals in ecological, social and financial sustainability. With us, you have the opportunity to contribute to a truly sustainable society. About the Service As part of the continuous work with sustainability, a municipality-wide cultivation strategy with accompanying action plan has been adopted, with the aim of showing how the municipality, based on its various roles and functions, should promote local cultivation and protect the arable land. As Cultivation Coordinator/Cultivation Project Manager, you will play a key role in implementing and following up on our cultivation strategy. You will lead projects that integrate cultivation into community planning, support professional horticulture and agriculture, and develop recreational and complementary cultivation. Your work will contribute to ensuring long-term sustainable production methods that benefit biodiversity and create sustainable cycles of nutrients and water. Your tasks will include: - Implementation of Strategy: Implement measures according to the cultivation strategy and action plan to achieve the municipality's overall goals. - Coordination: Work cross-sectorally with various committees and companies to ensure effective implementation of the strategy. - Advice and Support: Continue to develop systems for cultivation advice and grants and support professional horticulture and agriculture. - Communication: Inform and inspire citizens and stakeholders about the possibilities for local cultivation. Who are you? We are looking for you who have: - Education and/or experience in agronomy, environmental science, park planning, gardener or similar field in the green industry. - Experience in project management and cross-sector collaboration. - Ability to express yourself well in Swedish, both orally and in writing. - Good knowledge of digital tools. - B driver's license. Meritorious: - Previous work in the public sector or with sustainability issues. - Experience of strategic planning in agriculture or horticulture. - Interest in social sustainability and community development. - Experience of/knowledge of application processes for external funds and grants relevant to the service. Personal characteristics: You are structured, creative, results-oriented and have a strong ability to collaborate and find new innovative solutions. You can easily create contact with other people and are good at communicating both internally and externally. You are passionate about sustainable development and always have the citizens' best interests in mind when you take on projects. We attach great importance to your personal qualities. We offer you You will sit in our modern city hall a stone's throw from the center of Södertälje with good communication options such as buses and commuter trains and with a fantastic view of both the city and the canal. We sit in an open office landscape, but also offer the possibility of remote work for a certain part of your working time. We apply annual working hours, which means that you have a certain flexibility in how you allocate your working hours. The position is a temporary position until and including 15-01-2026. Each day passes approx 6,000 people to their jobs in Södertälje municipality. We have many different roles with us and want to offer you a meaningful job where you get the opportunity to contribute to society while feeling joy. As an employee with us, you get the opportunity to develop and make a real impression. As an employee of Södertälje municipality, you are offered, among other things, safe employment conditions, a generous wellness allowance and the opportunity to exchange the holiday allowance for extra days off. Within certain businesses, there is also the possibility of some flexibility regarding working hours and working methods. We have a large range of training and skills-enhancing efforts for you as an employee. For more detailed information about our benefits, please read more on our external website: https://www. soder waist. se/admanerWelcome to us! Other Selection and interviews will take place continuously during the application period. Södertälje municipality works with competence-based recruitment methodology with the aim of countering discrimination and promote diversity in the workplace. Employment with us can mean placement in a security class. A security check with a register check according to the Security Protection Act (2018:585) may therefore be carried out before a decision on employment. Swedish citizenship is required for some of our duties in security class. We are happy to receive calls from you who are interested in the job, but we refuse you who sell advertisements and recruitment services.

cypher_result.title: Syngenta Group China Scientist
cypher_result.description: 公司描述Syngenta Group is a global leader in agriculture; rooted in science and dedicated to bringing plat potential to life. A core player in the field of agricultural technology and life science innovation, and one of the world's largest agricultural innovation and technology companies, our products and services cover the entire chain of crop protection, seeds, crop nutrition and modern agricultural platforms. With a history dating back more than 250 years, the Group employs nearly 60,000 people worldwide and operates in more than 100 countries. We work together to solve one of humanity's most pressing challenges: growing more food with fewer resources, supporting the transformation of global agrifood systems through scientific and technological innovation, and improving crop yields and product quality. We rely on green and efficient agricultural inputs and technical solutions to promote sustainable agricultural development and benefit farmers, society and the planet. We are recruiting high potential young talent from top universities worldwide to build a high-quality research team with strong skills. cypher_result.title: Växa is looking for an Expert in sustainability
cypher_result.description: Väx's department for Knowledge & Development strives for a very high level of competence in the most important subject areas linked to milk and beef production. We play an important role by monitoring research results and making them available to the Swedish agricultural companies in the form of services and tools. We also carry out assignments and investigations for authorities, food companies and other actors in the food chain. Our development department also carries out its own projects, both in collaboration with researchers and more applied at the farm level. Our work contributes to the development of Swedish agriculture by providing a varied and innovative range of services that provide increased profitability and productivity, good animal health and a reduced climate footprint.Knowledge & Development is now strengthening the team for Sustainability and is looking for an expert with competence in the field, preferably with special interest in forage and crop cultivation. Our new expert will step up for colleagues in several of our ongoing projects, where we support various companies and organizations within the agricultural and food industry in their sustainability work. You will thus have a key role in ensuring our future level of competence and contribute to meeting the increased demand for specialist competence in the area of ​​sustainability. Our new expert will work together with existing colleagues to create the conditions for profitable and sustainable agriculture. In your assignment as an Expert in sustainability at Växa, you will, among other things: Initiate, lead and participate in projects, mainly in the area of ​​sustainability Collaborate with, and carry out assignments for, industrial customers, universities, authorities and industry organizations Monitor and compile research in various areas of sustainability linked to , e.g. climate impact from plant cultivation and feed supply, soil health, biological diversity and carbon storage Conduct environmental monitoring and competitive analysis Convey knowledge internally and externally Together in Växas' sustainability team develop the internal and external sustainability work Together with other departments, develop the range of services and tools As the current position is newly established, you will have great opportunities to shape the position based on your knowledge and your way of working. To fit the role, we want you to: Have an academic degree in a relevant field ; e.g. agronomist or equivalent Has at least 3 years of work experience in a relevant field Has knowledge in climate impact from agriculture, preferably with a focus on crop cultivation and/or fodder supply Has a good command of Swedish and English both verbally and in writing It is further meritorious if you: Have knowledge in soil health, carbon storage and biological diversity Has knowledge in LCA Has knowledge in climate calculations Has previous work experience from work as a consultant or equivalent Has experience of practical work on a farm with milk or beef production Have a PhD in a relevant field We attach great importance to your personal qualities such as your own drive and initiative. We believe that you find it easy to collaborate with colleagues who have many different skills and perspectives, as well as that you are development-oriented, solution-oriented and business-minded.Scope and place of placement Full-time and permanent with placement at one of Växas' operating locations. The position involves a number of travel days per year in Sweden and abroad. Salary according to agreement. For more information, please contact Head of Sustainability Malin Hidgård, malin.hidgard@vxa.se 073-073 31 27 Union contact person: Jessica Stenvall, jessica.stenvall@vxa.se 070-269 29 15 Application no later than 2024-11 -15 Interviews may take place continuously and the position may be filled before the last one application day. Welcome with your application!

cypher_result.description: The Swedish Board of Agriculture is available to promote increased and sustainable food production and good animal welfare throughout Sweden. We contribute to a living countryside. About 1850 people work with us. The head office is located in Jönköping but we also have large regional operations. We work actively to make our employees sustainable and enjoy the job! We invest long -term in our employees and want them to develop together with us! We offer a good working environment with generous benefits with up to 35 holiday days, wellness allowance and wellness time. In a large part of our employment, we offer a flexible working time, the opportunity to work mobile and work parts of the working hours at a distance. Read more about what it is like to work at the Swedish Agricultural Agency on our website: www.jordbruksverket.se/jobbahosjabräktorsverket is responsible for the official the statistics on agriculture, horticulture and for aquaculture. We are now looking for two new employees who will work on an agricultural economic survey that is currently being developed to also include environmental and social dimensions. The survey is EU regulated in Regulation (EU) 1217/2009, and is used to model, investigate and evaluate the common agricultural policy. Your work means, among other things, that you: • collect the large amount of information needed in the survey from the farmers themselves, subcontractors or from registers. • analyzes the activities of the agricultural companies from a holistic perspective to quality ensure that all tasks are reasonable and consistent • continuously develops and improves the models included in the survey to better describe the agricultural companies. • Produces statistics, feedback reports to participating companies and spreads results from the survey • Has contact with farmers, the European Commission, subcontractors, register holders and other stakeholders. It is important that you understand the farmer's conditions and have the ability to create good cooperation with the farmers who Participates in the survey. You help them receive added value from participating. The basis you process is part of a complex whole with a comprehensive formula device in several steps. You will work closely with your team of 7-8 colleagues. Qualification for this service we are looking for you who is an agronomist, preferably with a focus on business economics or pets, is a landlord or at least has a philosophy bachelor's degree combined with long experience in agricultural conditions . It is a requirement that you have good knowledge of the Office package. You have a good ability to express yourself in speech and writing in Swedish to be able to collaborate with farmers and present results in an easily understandable way. It is a merit if you have experience working with farmers in the areas of economy, technology, plant cultivation or pet management. We attach great importance to your personal abilities and are looking for you who have a genuine interest in and have a sense of numbers. You need to have an analytical ability where you can handle large and complicated substrates with many connections and addictions in a structured way. At the same time, you need to be curious and understand how the figures are related to farmers' daily activities. Contact with the farmers who participate in the survey is the basis for your work. We attach great importance to being accommodating and can create long -term confidence in the dialogue with farmers. You take responsibility for pushing your work forward. The place of placement is primarily Jönköping. In the alternative, placement at one of the Swedish Agricultural Agency's regional offices may be possible. You are stable in your role as an advisor and can handle stress in a constructive way. Environmental monitoring in the field of plant protection is also an important part of the work. For the second position, you are required to have experience and interest in working in a lab and knowledge of diagnostics for fungi and insects. cypher_result.title: Work with plant protection - three services in our socially important business
cypher_result.description: The Swedish Agency for Agriculture exists to promote increased and sustainable food production and good animal welfare throughout Sweden. We contribute to a living countryside. About 1,750 people work with us. The head office is in Jönköping, but we also have large regional operations. Read more about what it's like to work at Jordbruksverket on our website: www. the agricultural agency. se/jobbahososs As an advisor in plant protection, you will be part of the plant protection center in Skara, which is part of the environment and climate knowledge hub and works to actively influence and contribute to sustainable plant protection and a competitive, profitable and increased food production. We work in teams and help each other with the tasks that need to be carried out. The colleagues in the environment and climate knowledge hub are mainly located regionally at the Swedish Agency for Agriculture's three advisory units. This position is located at the plant protection advisory unit, which includes the plant protection centre. At the plant control unit, where the administrative positions are located, we are responsible for managing, among other things the rules for seed and against plant pests. This means everything from EU and international work, to national regulations and decisions, together with a lot of guidance, information and preparedness work. At the unit, we are 18 employees divided into two teams. We work both directly with industry players, industry organizations and in collaboration with the government office and other member states. JOB TASKS Do you have a good knowledge of the challenges of plant cultivation and want to work for robust and sustainable plant protection? Do you want to contribute to us being able to continue growing crops for feed and food in Sweden even in the event of social disturbances and in a changed climate? Then you can become one of our new colleagues! The Swedish Agency for Agriculture has an important task in both working with preventive plant protection and combating plant pests that are already present here, partly through regulations and partly through advice and skills development. We are now advertising three positions with the following tasks: 1. Advisor crop protection, agriculture - Skara• compile and convey Swedish and international experiences and results in the field of plant protection to the consultancy, • support the consultancy with increased competence through newsletters, control recommendations, courses, field trips and conferences, • follow the development of plant pests during the season within the Swedish Agency for Agriculture's forecasting activities for various pests, • increase awareness of difficult-to-control weeds and spread knowledge about sustainable cultivation systems, • be an important part of various projects within preparedness to ensure that we can maintain Swedish food production2. Plant pest manager - Jönköping/Landskrona• guide and inform about our rules against quarantine pests, • strengthen our preparedness for and manage possible outbreaks, • contribute to planning and developing our inventory of quarantine pests. Together with the colleagues at the plant regulation unit, you protect Sweden against the introduction of new plant pests. The work involves a mixture of situations that requires quick responses and planned work with processes based on scouting and reflection. 3. Manager robust crop cultivation - Jönköping• what abilities are needed to run the business, • what vulnerabilities exist and • what we need to do to increase our ability. Together with colleagues, you contribute to making our socially important business more robust with rules and guidance both on seed and combating plant pests. This is to reduce our vulnerability and strengthen our preparedness to face new as well as ongoing challenges. QUALIFICATIONSWe are looking for you who have an academic education as an agronomist, hortologist, farm manager, horticultural engineer or equivalent and a good knowledge of crop cultivation in Sweden. You need a good ability to express yourself verbally and in writing, in both Swedish and English to be successful in the role of administrator or advisor. The roles have different qualifying requirements, where the personal abilities we are looking for may differ, depending on the nature of the role and task. The following paragraphs clarify which requirements are specifically aimed at a particular service. 1. For advisers in crop protection, in addition to the requirements above, you need to have experience of working as a plant cultivation adviser under Nordic conditions and good knowledge of plant pests and integrated plant protection in agricultural crops. You are structured and used to planning your work, are confident in your professional role and find solutions to get ahead even in uncertain contexts. You stay up-to-date by monitoring the world around you and find it easy to put forward your case and win respect. 2. For plant pest manager, you need to be structured, analytical and communicative. It is advantageous to have knowledge of plant pests, gardening, plant cultivation or forests in Nordic conditions, and if you have experience of government work. 3. For manager of robust crop cultivation, we are looking for you who is structured, stable and has an easy time collaborating and communicating with others, both customers and other actors. You have previous experience of government work and we would like you to have experience of work in civil defence. OTHER Location of the services is presented below:1. Plant protection advisers are primarily located in Skara, but Linköping can also be an option. 2. Pest control officers are based in Jönköping or Landskrona. 3. Handler robust crop cultivation is located in Jönköping. For all three positions, the opportunity to work part of the working time remotely is offered. Do you have questions about any of the services? 1. For plant protection advisers, contact Anna Larsson or Anders Arvidsson. 2. For plant pest managers, contact Carin Bunnvik. 3. For managers robust plant cultivation, contact Carin Bunnvik or Klara Ekengard. For us, it is important that all skills in the labor market are utilized. Yes, the occupation **Crop production worker** requires several other skills and knowledge areas. Based on the provided data, these include:

### **Knowledge**
*   **Agroecology:** Applying ecological and agronomic concepts to agricultural production.
*   **Agronomy:** Combining agricultural production with the protection and regeneration of the natural environment.
*   **Conservation agriculture:** Techniques for sustainable soil and land use (minimum soil disturbance, permanent soil cover).
*   **Crop production principles:** Growing crops, natural cycles, nursing nature, and requirements for seeds/plants.
*   **Fertilisation principles:** Study of plant and soil structure in agronomical production.
*   **Integrated pest management:** Sustainable prevention/suppression of harmful organisms.
*   **Pest control in plants:** Identifying pest types and using conventional or biological control methods.
*   **Plant disease control:** Identifying plant diseases and implementing control methods.
*   **Plant harvest methods:** Timing and equipment for different crops.
*   **Plant propagation:** Methods, materials, and health/quality criteria for seeds.
*   **Plant species:** Characteristics of various plants, trees, and shrubs.
*   **Soil structure:** Understanding soil types in relation to plant growth.
*   **Technical equipment for crop production:** Maintenance and adjustment of machinery.
*   **Quality criteria for storage facilities:** Standards for ventilation, fireproofing, and locking systems.
*   **Types of storage facilities:** Devices used for holding information/products and their quality criteria.
*   **Watering principles:** Systems for supplying water (pipes, sprinklers, etc.).
*   **Organic farming:** Principles, techniques, and regulations.
*   **Hydroponics and Aeroponics:** Specialized cultivation methods without soil.
*   **Ecology:** Interaction of organisms with the ambient environment.

### **Skills/Competences**
*   **Assign duties to agriculture workers:** Supervise cultivation, irrigation, harvesting, and equipment maintenance.
*   **Maintain technical equipment:** Inventory management and ordering supplies.
*   **Operate agricultural machinery:** Using tractors, balers, sprayers, combines, etc.
*   **Drive agricultural machines:** Moving equipment in fields and transporting crops.
*   **Prepare planting area:** Fertilizing, mulching, and preparing seeds/plants.
*   **Grow plants:** Carrying out growing activities and control measures.
*   **Propagate plants:** Applying specific propagation methods like grafting or generative propagation.
*   **Execute fertilisation:** Performing tasks manually or with equipment according to regulations.
*   **Irrigate soil:** Using pipes/ditches and maintaining pump systems.
*   **Apply sustainable tillage techniques:** Using conservation or no-till farming to minimize soil impact.
*   **Apply alternate wetting and drying techniques:** Specifically for rice cultivation.
*   **Manage crop rotation:** Planning to optimize soil nutrients and combat pests.
*   **Execute disease and pest control activities:** Using biological or conventional methods and handling pesticides.
*   **Use pest detection sensors:** Utilizing technology to monitor insect pests.
*   **Monitor fields:** Forecasting crop growth and estimating weather damage.
*   **Harvest crop:** Mowing, picking, or cutting products manually or with machinery.
*   **Prepare equipment for harvest:** Ensuring machinery and facility readiness.
*   **Store crops/products:** Ensuring hygiene, temperature, and climate regulation in storage.
*   **Maintain storage facilities:** Managing temperature, air conditioning, and cleaning.
*   **Preserve crop:** Assessing quality for storage.
*   **Perform on-farm product processing:** Transforming raw farm products into elaborated goods.
*   **Use agricultural information systems and databases:** Planning and managing enterprise operations.
*   **Present the farm facilities:** Customer-adapted presentations of farm processes.
*   **Provide agri-touristic services:** Hosting leisure activities, guided tours, or selling local products.
*   **Cultivate crops for biomass:** Processes related to bio-mass production.

cypher_result.j.title: Animal welfare officer
cypher_result.j.description: When you work at the county board, you get to use your knowledge at the country's broadest authority. The county board is the state's representative in the county and ensures that national goals are achieved. Taking regional conditions into account, we make trade-offs between different societal interests. This is through collaboration between experts in a range of different fields and in collaboration with authorities, municipalities and organisations. At the county board, we create social benefit and influence social development, every day. It is an important assignment, a great responsibility and an inspiring opportunity. Let your knowledge become a force for Östergötland. We are looking for Östergötland is a vibrant agricultural county with extensive animal husbandry. We are now looking for an animal welfare officer to strengthen our unit. The position is a permanent, full-time position that begins with a 6-month trial period. Access as soon as possible and according to agreement. You will belong to the Animal Protection Unit, which has an expert function for the county board's assignments to operate throughout the food chain for healthy food, good animal welfare and protection of property and people in accordance with the Act on the Supervision of Dogs and Cats. A large part of the unit's activities includes animal welfare control. The unit for animal protection is included together with the unit for food, veterinary and game, the unit for agricultural support and the unit for rural areas in the department for animals, rural areas and food. Your duties As an animal welfare officer, you work with animal welfare cases of various nature. You will work with both routine inspections of the farm's animals and complaint cases about lack of animal protection, permits for professional activities with horses or companion animals, as well as subsequent processing of any decisions. You may also be needed for other tasks at the unit, such as enforcement of custody orders. Depending on your skills and education, other tasks may also become relevant within the department for animals, rural areas and food such as animal control, area control, primary production control or the like. Required requirements for the position - You have at least a bachelor's degree in agronomy, ethology and animal welfare, biology, farm manager or other education that we deem relevant. - You have experience and good knowledge of several different animal species. - You have a good ability to express yourself in Swedish in speech and writing. - You have good knowledge of the agricultural industry. - You have previous experience of official work in animal welfare. - You have good knowledge of the Office package. - You have good knowledge of Platina. - You have good knowledge of the animal welfare control register. - You have a B driving licence. Meritorious for the position - Documented experience of working with farm animals. - Good knowledge of English. - Good knowledge of administration and confidentiality. As a person - Do you have high cooperation skills by working well with other people. You relate to them in a responsive and flexible way. You listen, communicate and resolve conflicts in a constructive way. - Are you service oriented in that you are calm, attentive and accommodating in your treatment. You have an interest, desire and ability to help others and make an effort to deliver solutions. - Are you structured in that you plan, organize and prioritize your work effectively. You set and keep time frames. - Are you stable in that you are calm and controlled in stressful situations or pressured situations. You maintain a realistic perspective on situations and focus on the right things. - You have a high ability for oral communication, this is because you will have a lot of contact with animal keepers and sometimes also with the media. This means that you speak clearly, articulately and engaged in individual meetings and in small and large groups. You listen and are receptive to the other party and adapt to the situation. About us as an authority, our benefits and other conditions Östergötland County Administrative Board is a state authority and our office is located in central Linköping. As employed by us, you have, among other things, wellness hours, wellness allowance, extended parental allowance and flexible working hours. We offer the option of remote work up to two days a week on average if the business allows. For us, it is important that our workplace is characterized by consideration, respect and communication and according to the state's core values. Read more about us, our benefits, our core values ​​and what it's like to work with us. https://www. the county board. see/ostergotland/about-us/work-with-us. htmlThe County Administrative Board has an important coordinating role in the event of social disturbances, and thus all employees are included in the crisis and war organization. Some of our services are security classified, which means that a security check will then be carried out before employment. If you want to know more, contact Head of Unit, Helen Loor, tel. 010-223 52 59. Union representative for SACO is Magnus Roback, tel. 010-223 54 89 and for ST is Nina Stenmark, tel. 010-223 53 04. Welcome with your application, which you send via www. which one. com. Your application must have been received no later than 2024-11-14, enter ref no: 17395.

cypher_result.j.title: Distriktssäljare i Skåne
cypher_result.j.description: Stegra handles the entire recruitment process and all questions about the position and the application are made through Stegra. DeLaval does not accept any applications for this position themselves, but refers to responsible recruiter Lina Södergren via 076-020 25 14 alt. lina@stegra.nu. District salesman for SkåneNow we are looking for someone who has a genuine interest in Swedish agriculture and who wants to work in sales. Here you get the opportunity to work for a global company where you contribute to more sustainable food production. Does that sound interesting? Apply now! As we work with ongoing selection, the position may be filled before the application deadline, which is January 26, 2025, so apply today! About the role As a District Salesperson at DeLaval, you work independently and responsibly in a broad role with sales in the Skåne district. Here you act as support for your customers when it comes to planning facilities and systems for farmers. You are solution-oriented and persistent in the sales process where you coordinate and project manage the work for builders, authorities and advisory bodies. Your profile This is the role for you who have a genuine interest in and knowledge of Swedish agriculture and who are passionate about sales and advice. You have acquired knowledge and a good understanding of agriculture through work experience, studies or perhaps from growing up on or running a farm yourself. You are communicative and fearless in customer meetings. You have a sense of order and enjoy creating long-term relationships and are persistent during the sales process. To be successful in the role, we believe that you have a few years of work experience in sales or consultancy, preferably in the agricultural sector. Your first time at DeLaval you will receive extensive basic training at Hamragård in Tumba, joint trips with experienced colleagues as well as continuous further training which includes, among other things, training in CAD. About DeLaval DeLaval is a world leader in milking equipment with 4,300 employees in over 100 markets. For almost 130 years, they have developed solutions and service for efficient milk production. Their research and development aims to provide farmers with access to reliable and sustainable systems that promote animal health and the production of quality milk. DeLaval is a company in the Tetra Laval group. DeLaval Sales AB is part of Region Northern Europe and takes care of sales on the Swedish market. The company has approximately 180 employees. The head office is in Tumba, south of Stockholm, next to the Hamra research and development farm. The group's headquarters and factory for milking robots are also located here. Requirements Completed high school education Good knowledge of or previous experience in Swedish agriculture Work experience in sales or other relevant experience for the position Fluency in spoken and written Swedish Good knowledge of spoken and written English Driver's license B Meritorious post-secondary education in a relevant field for the position, such as for example agronomist or farm manager Sales / advisory experience in agriculture, animal husbandry or similar Experience in project management Knowledge of CAD Other Start date: By agreement Form of assignment: Permanent employment where you will be employed directly by DeLaval Location: You will start the position from home and live and work in Skåne You apply for the position by answering a few questions and attaching your CV or linking your Linkedin profile. Candidates who meet the basic requirements will receive a link to a personality test and a logical thinking test. Read more about why we use tests in our recruitment here. We then invite those who proceed to a digital interview. We work based on competence throughout the entire recruitment process. If you have questions about the position or the recruitment process, you are welcome to contact responsible recruiter Lina Södergren via 076-020 25 14 and lina@stegra.nu. Stegra handles the entire recruitment process and all questions about the position are answered by Stegra.

cypher_result.j.title: Djurskyddshandläggare med fokus på lantbrukets djur
cypher_result.j.description: The county board is the government's representative in the county and coordinates the regional development work. We work with issues relating to environmental and nature conservation, rural areas, social planning, animal protection, preparedness, equality, integration and cultural environment. We work actively for the county's development and coordinate various social sectors. In our work, we protect legal certainty, openness, equal treatment and good service. The County Administrative Board in Halland County has its office in central Halmstad and we are today approx. 230 employees. For more information see our website, www.lansstyrelsen.se/halland. Halland is an expansive county with extensive animal husbandry of various kinds where the County Administrative Board is the regional expert authority in, among other things, animal protection, infection control, feed and food. We are looking for one or more animal protection officers there the position/s are located at the Veterinary Unit, where we have approximately 20 employees. A large part of the unit's activities includes animal welfare control. We are now looking for an animal welfare officer with a permanent position. Job duties We offer stimulating and varied work where you will mainly work with animal welfare control of the farm's animals. Within animal welfare control, you work with routine checks, notification checks and follow-ups of previously identified deficiencies. You carry out the checks on the farms normally as a sole administrator. You are responsible for the entire case management such as control, drawing up control reports, registration, injunctions and any other decisions. You may also carry out controls within feed and food in primary production, transport inspections, answer the public's questions and receive notifications in the unit's contact phone for animal welfare. The position may also involve other tasks that occur, such as work with food supply and drinking water. You will be part of a work group and have a close collaboration with approx. 9 people. Other work areas within the unit may also be relevant and you therefore need to have an interest and desire to develop within the unit's other operational areas as well. Qualifications You have an academic education that is relevant to the work , for example pet agronomist specializing in farm animals, farm manager specializing in animal production or other education and experience that the employer deems appropriate. We would like to see that you have experience with livestock-producing animals by having worked on a farm, been an advisor, worked as an animal welfare inspector or similar. It is positive if you have experience of having worked with preparedness issues in food and drinking water. This position requires that you have good computer skills and basic knowledge of Microsoft Office. A B driver's license is required for this position. As the work as an animal welfare officer can sometimes be psychologically stressful, it is important that you have personal maturity, are confident in yourself and can distinguish between the personal and the exercise of authority. You need to be good at working independently and that you are calm, stable and controlled in stressful and pressured situations and you must have an empathic ability so you can put yourself in someone else's perspective. It is also important that you are service-oriented and accommodating while at the same time being a strong person who is able to set the requirements needed to achieve good animal husbandry within the framework of the legislation. It is important that you have the ability to work quickly and efficiently with the legislation in focus. As a large part of the tasks are based on good communication skills, it is important that you can express yourself well in speech and writing. We attach great importance to your personal suitability and your ability to contribute to a good work environment. Other We can offer:- A exciting workplace with broad competence - An opportunity to contribute to important social tasks - Possibility of remote work if the business allows - Wellness with wellness hour We know that diversity enriches and are looking for you who can complement our team with your competence, experience and personality. We ask you to apply for the position through the link in this advertisement to facilitate our handling of incoming applications and to ensure the quality of our selection process. It is of the utmost importance that you are thorough when you fill in your application, as it is assessed against an established skills profile as well as against other applicants. The application for the position is made via our recruitment system. We have actively selected media for advertising and refrain from all offers of advertising and recruitment assistance in connection with this recruitment. The County Administrative Board applies a six-month trial period for this employment. The position may be placed in security class and in in that case, we carry out a security check with a register check in accordance with the provisions of the Security Protection Act before the position is taken up. You will be part of the County Administrative Board's crisis management and war organization. This means that you will be placed at war. You can find information about how we handle your personal data at www.lansstyrelsen.se/dataskydd.

cypher_result.j.title: Expert/project manager in milk for sustainable animal production
cypher_result.j.description: Do you have knowledge of and experience in milk production? Do you want to work with the sustainable milk production of the future together with companies and the consultancy in the agricultural and animal sector? Then this could be a service for you! About us The government wishes to strengthen competitiveness in animal production for food by ensuring that the newest knowledge nationally and internationally is useful for Swedish producers. Knowledge hub animal production is a new unit within RISE that we are building together with experts in the field and who have competence in knowledge transfer, advice and communication. Together with the actors, we will identify the needs of animal production and develop models and advisory methods, which will put the knowledge to use by the farmer. The knowledge hub should not conduct research or advice itself, but be a link between the research and the advice and should collect knowledge from different areas and make it useful for advisory companies and the farmers. About the role We are now expanding our team with another expert in the field of milk production. As an expert in our team, you get the opportunity to work with acquisition, compilation and transfer of knowledge regarding milk production, animal health and welfare, breeding, feed, milk quality, new technology and entrepreneurship. This is for a future sustainable Swedish animal production, which contributes to good animal welfare and working environment, together with good profitability. You will be an important team player in a committed department with high competence and who values ​​working in close collaboration with both colleagues within RISE and with our partners. You will have an important key role where you gather and coordinate different competences in milk production with our experts, industry partners and other RISE competencies, to contribute to knowledge transfer based on the animal producer's current and future needs. The position is located in Uppsala or Lund and involves some travel, therefore a B driving license is a requirement. Who are you? You have an education at at least university level as an agronomist, veterinarian, farm manager or equivalent. You have experience and knowledge of the entire milk production process, i.e. knowledge within i.a. animal health, breeding, feed, production economics and management. We would like you to have experience of working interdisciplinary, as well as working with information delivery and identifying farmers' knowledge needs, in national/international projects. It is advantageous if you have several years of work experience in the field of milk production, information efforts/further training and counseling for agricultural entrepreneurs. As a person, you are focused, committed, driven and good at building relationships with e.g. You work goal-oriented and structured and have a strong ability to quickly absorb information and events. Your way of thinking is strategic and you have a good overall view. You are proactive and systematic in your way of working and like to think new things. Very good knowledge of Swedish and English, both spoken and written, is a requirement. What do we offer you? With us at RISE, you will get to work with an incredibly broad and exciting business. You will be part of a network of experts where you will be given the opportunity to exchange experience and develop skills as well as a valuable sounding board. You will collaborate with our researchers and experts in agricultural production. The culture is characterized by a positive spirit where everything is possible and where we work focused towards our common goals. You will work in a dynamic environment that gives you development opportunities both professionally and personally. At RISE, we want you to succeed and feel good, because when you succeed, you contribute to a sustainable future. Do you want to know more? Welcome to contact Jørgen Korning, Head of Unit, 070-313 6996. The deadline for applications is 10 November 2024. Interviews will take place continuously during and after the application period. Our union representatives are: Ingemar Petermann, SACO 010-2284122 and Linda Ikatti, 010-516 51 61. Calls from external recruitment companies and sellers are kindly avoided as we are subject to the Public Procurement Act.

cypher_result.j.title: Farm Veterinarian
cypher_result.j.description:
EPIROS SA, with a strong presence in the cheese industry and factories in Arta and Elassona, with a leading share in the Greek market and strong export activity, is looking for, on behalf of FARMA EPIROS:
Veterinarian
The position is full-time and will have the role of Scientific Manager for the Farms at Kampi Artas and Domokos Orchard.
 Purpose of the position:
The post holder is responsible for the primary care of a dairy goat or sheep (eg dystocia, C-sections, mastitis treatments) but in the overall supervision and guidance of the Farm Managers, in terms of animal nutrition, management births, the prevention of infectious and nutritional diseases, but also the wider hygiene of sheep and goats. 
Duties:

Creation and execution of vaccination plan.
Diagnosing diseases and determining the best treatment.
Ration monitoring and improvement suggestions.
Implementation and control of Farm procedures, related to the hygiene of sheep and goats.
Submission of proposals for the observance of the sanitary conditions of stables - livestock.
Recommendations to improve animal husbandry standards and/or unit procedures.

Necessary qualifications:

Veterinary Degree.
Professional License.
Minimum of 5 years of experience, preferably in sheep and goats.
Good knowledge of vaccination protocols.
Team spirit and effective communication skills.
Good knowledge of English language.
Good computer skills (MS Office, outlook).
Driver's license holder.
Possibility of travel within Greece, to our livestock units.

Provided:

Stable work environment.
Group insurance.
Training in modern sheep and goat management methods.
Development prospects.

Be part of our great team and send your CV!

cypher_result.j.description: About the company Roslätt farm, with a long history, is located in a very attractive landscape with meadows, forest groves and coastal forests down towards Yddingesjön in the east. cypher_result.j.title: Kundansvarig till Biototal Group i Skåne
cypher_result.j.description: About Biototal GroupWithin Biototal Group, we work for sustainable solutions between city and country with the goal of utilizing all resources so they are useful in the cycle. Through our work, we see a clear improvement when it comes to increased fertility. We are expanding and are therefore looking for another colleague located in Skåne. About the role: In the role of Customer Manager, you will be an intermediary to our customers such as farmers, treatment plants, industries and biogas plants. You run your work and dialogue with customers independently, while you have a committed and knowledgeable team behind you. Among other things, you will be responsible for the sale and mediation of residual products for recycling. You will also develop relationships with authorities, contractors and carriers. The work involves an exciting and varied everyday life where you will work both out in the field and from the office in Alnarp outside Malmö. Your field of work is mainly Skåne but can also be Blekinge or Halland, which means that travel is included in the work. Sometimes with an overnight stay. B driver's license is a requirement and a company car is provided. The position is a permanent position with a start according to agreement. A trial employment may be applied at the start of the employment. Your profile: We are looking for a relationship builder with great interest and knowledge in agriculture. If you have previous experience of building long-term customer relationships in an advisory or sales role towards farmers, that is a big advantage. We would like you to have knowledge in agronomy and a basic understanding of the processes in plant nutrition. Practical experience from agriculture is highly meritorious for the role. Most likely, you have a university education as an agronomist, farm manager, farm manager or agrotechnician, alternatively you have acquired the corresponding practical knowledge in crop cultivation in another way. You are good at communicating both verbally and in writing and building relationships with customers. Furthermore, you thrive in a role where you are both given the opportunity to work in the field and with planning and documentation. As a person, you have a positive attitude, are flexible and have the ability to take your own initiative and drive your work forward. You are also used to handling the Office package and digital tools. Our offer: We offer you a free job where you can work independently, with great opportunity to influence the path towards the goal. You get a bunch of nice and curious colleagues who are passionate about you creating together

cypher_result.j.title: Work with plant protection - three services in our socially important business

We work in teams and help each other with the tasks that need to be carried out. The colleagues in the environment and climate knowledge hub are mainly located regionally at the Swedish Agency for Agriculture's three advisory units. This position is located at the plant protection advisory unit, which includes the plant protection centre. At the plant control unit, where the administrative positions are located, we are responsible for managing, among other things the rules for seed and against plant pests. This means everything from EU and international work, to national regulations and decisions, together with a lot of guidance, information and preparedness work. At the unit, we are 18 employees divided into two teams. We work both directly with industry players, industry organizations and in collaboration with the government office and other member states. JOB TASKS Do you have a good knowledge of the challenges of plant cultivation and want to work for robust and sustainable plant protection? Do you want to contribute to us being able to continue growing crops for feed and food in Sweden even in the event of social disturbances and in a changed climate? Then you can become one of our new colleagues! The Swedish Agency for Agriculture has an important task in both working with preventive plant protection and combating plant pests that are already present here, partly through regulations and partly through advice and skills development. We are now advertising three positions with the following tasks: 1. Manager robust crop cultivation - Jönköping• what abilities are needed to run the business, • what vulnerabilities exist and • what we need to do to increase our ability. To transition into a role as an ecologist, you should focus on developing and demonstrating the following essential skills identified in the research:

### **Field and Research Skills**
*   **Conduct ecological research:** Gain experience performing research in the field or under controlled conditions using scientific methods.
*   **Conduct ecological surveys:** Learn to perform field surveys to collect data on the numbers and distribution of organisms.
*   **Analyse ecological data:** Become proficient in interpreting biological and ecological data, specifically using specialist software programs.
*   **Employ habitat survey techniques:** Master the use of tools like Geographic Information Systems (GIS), Global Positioning Systems (GPS), aerial photography, maps, and records to execute sampling strategies.
*   **Organism taxonomy:** Develop expertise in the science of classifying organisms.
*   **Measure trees:** Learn technical procedures for assessing tree health and growth, including using clinometers, tape measures, increment borers, and bark gauges.

### **Management and Environmental Application**
*   **Ecosystem management:** Apply approaches that optimize management strategies while considering the impacts on different elements of an ecosystem.
*   **Manage habitats:** Develop the ability to create and maintain natural habitats.
*   **Habitat restoration:** Learn the process of rehabilitating damaged ecosystems, including mitigating pollution, erosion, and deforestation, and re-establishing species.
*   **Agroecology:** Apply ecological and agronomic concepts to agricultural production systems.
*   **Environmental legislation:** Maintain a working knowledge of the environmental policies and laws applicable to your domain.

*   **Disciplinary expertise:** Demonstrate deep knowledge of your specific research area, including research ethics, integrity, and privacy/GDPR requirements.

*   **Communication:** Focus on your ability to draft scientific papers, disseminate results to the scientific community, and effectively communicate complex findings to a non-scientific audience.
*   **Project and Professional Management:** Enhance your ability to perform project management (budget, timeline, and resource allocation) and engage in lifelong learning through personal professional development.
*   **Collaboration:** Develop skills in mentoring others, promoting open innovation, and interacting professionally within diverse research environments.

Residential houses and outbuildings, a total of about 50 in number, are gathered in a cluster village, which was common in many places in Småland before legal transfer was carried out in the 19th century. In the village there are about fifteen cows and a bull of the red kulla breed as well as about 30 Helsingo sheep, some pigs and chickens. During the summer months, hired cows walk in the forest pastures. The field cultivation consists of paddy, potatoes and cultivated crops, mainly older cereals but also flax. The land has been cultivated organically since the Vitterhetsakademien took over the property in the 1960s. Since 2020, Stensjö village is a cultural reserve. The management plan aims to show Stensjö as it looked at the turn of the century in 1900. The land types that existed at that time should be well represented in the form of pastures, fodder dikes, gardens, ancient fields with cereal crops, natural hay fields and forest pastures. Long-term work is underway where the management plan is the guiding principle with the aim of recreating an older land use. Stensjö village is to be developed into a knowledge and development center for historic landscape use. The management plan can be found on the website under the Management plan and documents tab. To support the work, there is a management council that meets at Stensjö twice a year. The maintenance council consists of 5-7 people with experience in practical landscape and garden maintenance and building maintenance, as well as representatives for research in relevant areas. Administrative support such as finance, communication etc. can be found at the Vitterhetsakademien's office in Stockholm. Qualifications Requirements for the position You must have documented, solid experience in crop cultivation and animal husbandry Ability to work both independently and together with others Good verbal and written communication skills in Swedish Experience in administration and authority contacts regarding farm support, animal husbandry, EU applications etc. Driving license BMeritandEducation in agriculture and animal husbandryEducation/experience in organic farming with crop rotations Experience of work management Education/experience of: Landscape care with a cultural-historical focus, scythes Work with horses Forestry with clear cutting methods Machine maintenance Building care/property care with an antiquarian focus Experience of museum operations and outward-looking, public activities Basic interest and knowledge of small farms; nature, history and culture, and preferably more specifically about Småland's conditions Driving license BEChainsaw driving license A and BHunting licensePersonal characteristicsWe attach great importance to personal suitability. You can work independently and intensively when required, but also be a good colleague and partner with Stensjö's best interests at heart in all internal and external contexts. You have a great sense of responsibility and can flexibly change between the various tasks. Employment and other information about the work The position is a permanent, full-time position that begins with a six-month probationary period. The work involves scheduled working hours, which includes work on evenings, weekends and public holidays. The academy applies individual salary setting. The workplace is Stensjö village, 10 km north of Oskarshamn. There is an opportunity to live in Stensjö village. The Vitterhetsakademien's office is in Stockholm. Support functions such as finances, administration, communication, IT support, archives, etc. is there. The property manager, who is the immediate manager, has his main place of work in Stockholm but is on site in Stensjö village several times a year. In between, meetings and contact take place via Teams and telephone. Collaboration and meetings with colleagues at the other cultural properties take place regularly, including in connection with joint property meetings twice a year. The members of the Vitterhetsakademie have a great interest in the cultural properties and many regularly visit Stensjö village. There is guest accommodation for them at each cultural property, which enables overnight stays.

To pursue the career path of an **Agricultural Scientist**, you should focus on developing the following essential skills based on the provided data:

### **Research and Scientific Proficiency**
*   **Perform scientific research:** Use scientific methods to gain, correct, or improve knowledge through empirical observations.
*   **Research design:** Master the methods and techniques to conduct studies, including data collection, methodology, and analysis.
*   **Demonstrate disciplinary expertise:** Maintain deep knowledge in your specific research area, including scientific integrity, ethics, and privacy/GDPR requirements.
*   **Apply research ethics and scientific integrity:** Ensure all research activities avoid misconduct such as plagiarism, fabrication, or falsification.
*   **Conduct research across disciplines:** Utilize findings and data across various functional or disciplinary boundaries.
*   **Think abstractly:** Ability to use concepts to make generalizations and relate them to different events or experiences.

### **Data and Publication Management**
*   **Manage research data:** Produce, analyze, store, and maintain data in research databases, and support data re-use.
*   **Manage FAIR data:** Ensure data is Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, and Reusable.
*   **Manage intellectual property rights:** Protect products of the intellect from unlawful infringement.
*   **Draft scientific or academic papers:** Edit and write technical, scientific, or academic documentation.
*   **Write scientific publications:** Present hypotheses, findings, and conclusions professionally.
*   **Publish academic research:** Contribute to your field of expertise through books or journals.
*   **Manage open publications:** Use information technology to support research, manage institutional repositories, and measure research impact.

### **Project and Professional Management**
*   **Perform project management:** Plan and manage resources (budget, time, personnel) to achieve project goals.
*   **Apply for research funding:** Identify funding sources and prepare successful grant applications.
*   **Manage personal professional development:** Engage in lifelong learning, self-reflection, and career planning.
*   **Develop professional network:** Build alliances and collaborations with other researchers and stakeholders.
*   **Interact professionally:** Demonstrate collegiality, leadership, and the ability to give/receive feedback.
*   **Promote open innovation:** Collaborate with organizations outside your own to foster innovation.

### **Agricultural and Environmental Expertise**
*   **Agroecology:** Apply ecological and agronomic concepts to agricultural production systems.
*   **Bioeconomy:** Convert biological resources and waste into value-added products.
*   **E-agriculture:** Design and apply ICT solutions in fields like agriculture and forestry.
*   **Environmental legislation in agriculture:** Maintain awareness of policies and environmental impacts to adjust production accordingly.
*   **Advise on soil and water protection:** Advise on methods to prevent pollution and soil erosion.
*   **Create soil and plant improvement programmes:** Develop and advise on soil health and plant nutrition programs.
*   **Livestock farming systems:** Understand the allocation of resources in livestock husbandry.
*   **Agroforestry:** Integrate trees and woody perennials with cropland farming.

### **Communication and Impact**
*   **Communicate with a non-scientific audience:** Tailor scientific concepts for the general public using visual presentations.
*   **Increase the impact of science on policy and society:** Maintain relationships with policymakers to ensure evidence-informed decision-making.
*   **Promote the transfer of knowledge:** Facilitate the two-way flow of technology and expertise between research and industry/public sectors.
*   **Speak different languages:** Communicate effectively in one or more foreign languages.
*   **Synthesise information:** Critically read and summarize complex information from diverse sources.

Our mission is to develop the county and work to ensure that the national political goals have an impact in the county. We work to be an authority free from discrimination and want to take advantage of the qualities that diversity brings to the business. The rural unit is one of the county board's seven units with approximately 40 employees. The unit is responsible for project and investment support, animal and area-based support, advice and courses for agricultural companies, supervision in agriculture, register checks on animals, land acquisition permits for agricultural and forestry properties and monitoring of basic paid services. Within the unit there is also the Interreg Sweden Norway program for which the County Administrative Board of Jämtland County is the managing authority. The unit has overall responsibility for rural issues and is responsible for the agricultural and rural focus in the cross-sector collaboration at the County Board. We work with experts in these fields who are happy to share their knowledge. We work with respect, professionalism and openness for the county's residents - together for a sustainable future! The county. This includes, among other things, counseling and skills-enhancing activities aimed at the county's farmers. Our current pet consultant is now retiring and we are therefore looking for her successor who wants to work with skills development for the county's farmers with a focus on the farm's animal husbandry. Job duties You will be part of a group that works with planning, implementing and leading skills development within the common agricultural policy in the form of advice, courses and information to farmers. The work entails partly independently carrying out competence-enhancing initiatives such as courses, counseling and farm meetings with exchange of experience and partly coordinating other actors that the county administrative board has procured for various activities. You write applications for project funds and, together with colleagues, carry out the procurement of competence development efforts. The work includes financial accounting and reporting of measures taken. You collaborate with industry actors and organizations and have close cooperation with other county administrative boards as well as with various functions at our county administrative board. You may be part of cross-sectoral groups where you need to be able to combine your expertise with a holistic perspective. You participate in the work of responding to referrals and contributing with the perspective of agriculture on various issues. Depending on experience and competence, other tasks at the unit may also be part of the position. Your work is independent and requires you to be self-motivated, results-oriented and good at collaborating and creating relationships. You are sensitive to the needs of different clients. In your dialogue with farmers, you need to be service-oriented and have a good understanding of the companies' conditions in the county and have the ability to see the whole. You have a few years of work experience, experience from consultancy and government work is advantageous. You have work experience with a focus on agriculture and farm animals. If you also have experience in project management and work with skills development, as well as experience in working with small business owners, this is advantageous. You have the ability to communicate clearly in both speech and writing and have an established network within the agricultural industry. You are structured and solution-oriented with good computer skills. The position involves travel, mainly in the county, but longer trips with overnight stays also occur. A driver's license for a passenger car is required. We offer you meaningful work with varied tasks. You will make a difference to our county and society. The County Board is a broad authority, which means that you constantly have the opportunity to develop and learn new things. This applies in several policy areas. As an employer, we have a strong focus on good employment conditions, active work environment work and health-promoting wellness activities. We are keen on cooperation with our union partners and can offer remote work. In case of permanent employment at the County Board, you will be placed at war with the authority. Depending on the service, this may include serving in crisis staff and security classification. We usually start with trial employment for permanent positions. You can find information about how we process your personal data at www.lansstyrelsen.se/dataskydd

cypher_result.description: AGRICULTURAL BUSINESS ADMINISTRATION (M/F/D) The following part-time position (50%) is available at the Faculty of Sustainable Agriculture and Energy Systems, Campus Weihenstephan (Freising): AGRICULTURAL BUSINESS ADMINISTRATION (M/F/D), AGRICULTURAL MASTER/AGRICULTURAL MASTER ( M/F/D) OR TECHNICIAN / TECHNICIAN (M/F/D) FOR AGRICULTURE FOR THE EXPERIMENTAL SYSTEM “VEGETABLE PRODUCTION” Code number S314-AE The position is permanent. Your area of ​​responsibility: Participation in experimental and research projects in plant production, in particular independent work in setting up and carrying out field experiments, management of the areas and plant populations (arable farming, grassland) of the teaching and research station of the faculty to prepare experiments, independent implementation of production-technical measures Data collection and documentation Participation in the teaching and research station of the faculty (also in the area of ​​animal production) Employment requirements and others Information can be found until November 27, 2024 at www. hswt. de/working-at-the-hswt/ job offers. www. hswt. de
